paras.en: It’s increasingly accepted that stress can trigger systemic inflammation that then compromises the immune system. In theory, stressed caregivers should be inflamed. They’re not, researchers reported in 2020 in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. That study relied on data from more than 30,000 U.S. adults. In surveys taken in the early 2000s and the 2010s, participants indicated their caregiver status, type and intensity of care being given, and experiences of strain. They also provided blood samples.
paras.zh: 人们越来越认识到，压力会引发全身炎症，进而损害免疫系统。从理论上讲，承受压力的看护者应该会发炎。研究人员在 2020 年《美国国家科学院院刊》上报道称，事实并非如此。该研究依赖于 30,000 多名美国成年人的数据。在 2000 年代初期和 2010 年代进行的调查中，参与者表明了他们的护理人员状况、护理类型和强度以及紧张经历。他们还提供了血液样本。

paras.en: The scientists zoomed in on roughly 250 people who became regular caregivers and analyzed their blood samples for six inflammation-related biomarkers. Those biomarkers did not go up, on average, when people transitioned to caregiving, the team found. Nor did they go up relative to a matched control group of non-caregivers selected from the larger sample. Those findings held true for even the most stressed caregivers, including spouses caring for a partner with dementia.
paras.zh: 科学家们重点关注了大约 250 名成为定期护理人员的人，并分析了他们的血液样本中的 6 种与炎症相关的生物标志物。研究小组发现，当人们转向护理时，这些生物标记物平均并没有上升。相对于从较大样本中选出的非照顾者的匹配对照组，它们也没有上升。即使是压力最大的护理人员，包括照顾患有痴呆症的伴侣的配偶，这些发现也适用。

paras.en: How, though, are caregivers largely avoiding inflammation associated with chronic stress? “We don’t really know,” says gerontologist and clinical psychologist William Haley of the University of South Florida in Tampa. “There’s a lot of mysteries here.”
paras.zh: 然而，护理人员如何在很大程度上避免与慢性压力相关的炎症呢？ “我们真的不知道，”坦帕南佛罗里达大学的老年学家和临床心理学家威廉·黑利说。 “这里有很多谜团。”

paras.en: Eisenberger and colleagues theorize that the key to the caregiving paradox may lie in a biological system that evolved among mammals to protect offspring that remain helpless well after birth. That “mammalian caregiving system” seems to encourage caring and tamp down the normal stress response that tells people to flee danger, at least when their baby is involved, Eisenberger says.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格及其同事推测，照顾悖论的关键可能在于哺乳动物进化出的生物系统，以保护出生后仍无助的后代。艾森伯格说，这种“哺乳动物照顾系统”似乎鼓励照顾并抑制正常的压力反应，这种压力反应告诉人们要逃离危险，至少在涉及婴儿时是这样。

paras.en: Studies primarily in rodents hint at how that caregiving system works, Eisenberger notes. And emerging evidence in humans suggests that this system kicks on even in non-parenting contexts, such as holding onto a partner in pain or giving money to family. In preliminary work, Brown and colleagues even saw signs of it among strangers who bonded during an activity.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格指出，主要针对啮齿类动物的研究揭示了这一护理系统的运作方式。人类身上不断出现的证据表明，即使在非养育子女的情况下，这个系统也会发挥作用，比如在痛苦中抓住伴侣或给家人钱。在初步工作中，布朗和同事甚至在活动期间结识的陌生人中发现了这种迹象。

paras.en: Researchers are missing fascinating questions
paras.zh: 研究人员错过了一些有趣的问题

paras.en: The contradictory feelings Eisenberger experienced while caring for her dad are common. Caregivers can’t disentangle the advantages of the mammalian caregiving system from the strain of helping. Yet over half of caregivers surveyed by AARP reported that caring for a loved one gave them a sense of purpose.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格在照顾父亲时经历的矛盾感受很常见。护理人员无法将哺乳动物护理系统的优势与帮助的压力区分开来。然而，美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 调查显示，超过一半的护理人员表示，照顾亲人给了他们一种使命感。

paras.en: Ironically, minimizing potential positives to protect caregivers may do more harm than good, researchers say. Caregivers may hear only how awful their next several months or years may be. Others might run from the responsibility and later experience regret.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，讽刺的是，为了保护护理人员而最大限度地减少潜在的积极因素可能弊大于利。护理人员可能只会听到他们接下来的几个月或几年可能会多么糟糕。其他人可能会逃避责任，然后后悔。

paras.en: “What if we tell people that … helping others can be really fulfilling even if it can be stressful, too?” Eisenberger says.
paras.zh: “如果我们告诉人们......帮助他人可以真正让人感到满足，即使它也可能有压力呢？”艾森伯格说。

paras.en: Reticence around caregiving’s benefits has also hampered scientists’ ability to advise people undertaking such a difficult role, Eisenberger and colleagues note. Can feeling compassion for a sick loved one turn on the mammalian caregiving system, or does one have to provide care? What if someone has a fraught relationship with the sick family member? Ultimately, when does the stress of opting out of caregiving outweigh the stress of opting in? Framing caregiving as entirely negative means those questions rarely even get asked.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格和同事指出，对护理好处的沉默也阻碍了科学家为承担如此困难角色的人们提供建议的能力。对生病的亲人的同情可以开启哺乳动物的护理系统，还是必须提供护理？如果有人与生病的家庭成员关系紧张怎么办？最终，选择退出护理的压力何时超过选择接受护理的压力？将护理视为完全消极意味着这些问题很少被问到。

articles.title: A quake on Mars may have set these rocks rolling
articles.author: Katherine Kornei

paras.en: Earthquakes frequently trigger rock falls. Now there’s solid evidence marsquakes can send boulders tumbling, too.
paras.zh: 地震经常引发岩石坠落。现在有确凿的证据表明火星地震也会导致巨石翻滚。

paras.en: Scientists mined high-resolution imagery of the Red Planet taken shortly after a recent temblor and found hundreds of new imprints left by tumbling boulders, researchers report September 2 in npj Space Exploration. Such rockfalls can be used as a proxy for seismic data, which is difficult to collect across the solar system.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 2 日在 npj Space Exploration 上报告称，科学家们挖掘了最近一次地震后不久拍摄的这颗红色星球的高分辨率图像，发现了数百个翻滚巨石留下的新印记。这种落石可以用作地震数据的代理，而地震数据很难在整个太阳系中收集。

paras.en: The data were collected with NASA’s InSight lander, which touched down on Mars in 2018. Over the next four years, its seismometer detected more than a thousand marsquakes. Many of those temblors originated in a region known as Cerberus Fossae, just north of the Martian equator. That’s a dynamic landscape riddled with slopes, cracks and rocks on the move, says Vijayan, a planetary scientist at the Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad, India, who goes by a single name. “Thousands and thousands of boulders have fallen.”
paras.zh: 这些数据是通过 NASA 的 InSight 着陆器收集的，该着陆器于 2018 年登陆火星。在接下来的四年里，其地震仪检测到了一千多次火星地震。许多地震起源于火星赤道以北的一个名为塞伯鲁斯窝的地区。印度艾哈迈达巴德物理研究实验室的行星科学家维贾扬（Vijayan）说，这是一个动态的景观，布满了斜坡、裂缝和移动的岩石。 “成千上万的巨石倒塌了。”

paras.en: Vijayan and his collaborators focused on one well-detected marsquake captured by InSight that occurred in July 2019 just a few tens of kilometers from Cerberus Fossae. By comparing images taken in June 2019 and December 2020, the researchers discovered 27 new linelike features. Each was composed of tens to hundreds of distinct marks. These structures were most likely tracks created by boulders bouncing downhill, the team concluded.
paras.zh: Vijayan 和他的合作者重点研究了 InSight 捕捉到的一场地震，该地震发生在 2019 年 7 月，距离 Cerberus Fossae 仅几十公里。通过比较 2019 年 6 月和 2020 年 12 月拍摄的图像，研究人员发现了 27 个新的线状特征。每个标记都由数十到数百个不同的标记组成。研究小组得出结论，这些结构很可能是巨石下坡时留下的痕迹。

paras.en: Using historical imagery, the researchers calculated that only about two such features form each year on average in Cerberus Fossae. “We have statistics of previous boulder falls,” says Bivas Das, a seismologist at the Physical Research Laboratory and a member of the research team. Recording 27 new structures over a span of just 18 months is wholly unexpected, Das says. “That’s a big increase.” The nearby marsquake recorded by InSight was probably the instigator, the team concluded.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用历史图像计算出，Cerberus Fossae 每年平均只有大约两个这样的特征。 “我们有以前巨石坠落的统计数据，”物理研究实验室的地震学家、研究小组成员比瓦斯·达斯（Bivas Das）说。 Das 表示，在短短 18 个月内记录了 27 个新结构，这完全出乎意料。 “这是一个很大的增长。”研究小组得出结论，洞察号记录的附近的火星地震可能是始作俑者。

paras.en: Mysteries remain, however. All of the rockfalls occurred on the north side of a prominent valley in Cerberus Fossae, despite more boulders being located on the south side of the valley. “That puzzles us,” Vijayan says. The complex landscape of Cerberus Fossae might well alter how seismic waves travel, making it difficult to predict how shaking will impact different areas, he says. “The wave propagation is going to be complicated.”
paras.zh: 然而，谜团依然存在。尽管更多的巨石位于山谷的南侧，但所有落石都发生在塞伯鲁斯窝沟的一个著名山谷的北侧。 “这让我们感到困惑，”维贾扬说。他说，Cerberus Fossae 的复杂景观很可能会改变地震波的传播方式，从而很难预测震动将如何影响不同地区。 “波的传播将会很复杂。”

paras.en: Looking for such boulder falls elsewhere could help space exploration efforts, the team suggests. Human settlements would do best avoiding areas that are seismically active, and tumbling boulders can be the proverbial canaries in the coal mine, Vijayan says. “They’re like a proxy in the absence of seismic data.”
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，在其他地方寻找此类巨石坠落可能有助于太空探索工作。维贾扬说，人类住区最好避开地震活跃的地区，而翻滚的巨石可能是煤矿里众所周知的金丝雀。 “在缺乏地震数据的情况下，它们就像一个代理。”

articles.title: A Hot Bath May Lower Your Blood Pressure More Than a 30-Minute Workout Can, Study Reveals
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Taking a nice hot bath at the end of a long day is a wonderful way to unwind, but the end results can go way beyond simple relaxation.
paras.zh: 在漫长的一天结束后洗个热水澡是一种很好的放松方式，但最终的结果远远超出了简单的放松。

paras.en: In fact, the health benefits of sustained immersion in hot water can be truly surprising, and new research has just uncovered another remarkable effect of a good hot soak.
paras.zh: 事实上，持续浸泡在热水中对健康的好处确实令人惊讶，新的研究刚刚发现了良好的热水浸泡的另一个显着效果。

paras.en: In a study published in the European Journal of Applied Physiology, researchers found soaking in hot water for 30 minutes can trigger dramatic changes in the blood vessels beneath your skin, in some respects exceeding the effects produced by moderate exercise.
paras.zh: 在《欧洲应用生理学杂志》上发表的一项研究中，研究人员发现，在热水中浸泡 30 分钟可以引发皮肤下血管的巨大变化，在某些方面超过了适度运动所产生的效果。

paras.en: The hot water immersion even lowered people's blood pressure more than 30 minutes of moderate-intensity cycling.
paras.zh: 热水浸泡甚至可以降低中等强度骑行 30 分钟以上的血压。

paras.en: It's worth noting this was only a small experiment, and nobody's suggesting people should give up exercise to instead take more hot baths.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，这只是一个小实验，没有人建议人们应该放弃锻炼而多洗热水澡。

paras.en: But for people who may be unable to exercise, hot water immersion, or other forms of what's known as passive heat therapy, may be an important way of getting some of the same health benefits that exercise can provide.
paras.zh: 但对于无法锻炼的人来说，热水浸泡或其他形式的被动热疗法可能是获得与锻炼相同的健康益处的重要方法。

paras.en: "Exercise training is a well-established stimulus for improving vascular health, in part by enhancing endothelial function, arterial compliance, and microvascular responsiveness," researchers explain in a new paper, led by first author and exercise physiologist Kristanti Wigati from the University of Western Australia.
paras.zh: 研究人员在一篇由第一作者、西澳大利亚大学运动生理学家 Kristanti Wigati 领导的新论文中解释道：“运动训练是改善血管健康的一种公认的刺激措施，部分是通过增强内皮功能、动脉顺应性和微血管反应性。”

paras.en: "However, recent global estimates indicate that approximately 31 percent of adults worldwide do not meet physical activity guidelines, supporting the need to explore adjunct or alternative interventions for individuals who may struggle with regular exercise participation."
paras.zh: “然而，最近的全球估计表明，全世界大约 31% 的成年人不符合体育活动指南，这表明有必要为那些可能难以定期参与锻炼的个人探索辅助或替代干预措施。”

paras.en: Hot water immersion, like exercise itself, provides an increase in blood flow and shear stress along the inside walls of blood vessels, which triggers adaptations that improve vascular function.
paras.zh: 与运动本身一样，热水浸泡会增加血管内壁的血流量和剪切应力，从而引发改善血管功能的适应。

paras.en: Previous research in young healthy adults has shown that repeated hot water immersion can improve blood vessel function, reduce arterial stiffness, and help blood vessels widen through nitric oxide.
paras.zh: 此前针对年轻健康成年人的研究表明，反复热水浸泡可以改善血管功能，降低动脉僵硬度，并通过一氧化氮帮助血管扩张。

paras.en: "These findings suggest that hot water immersion may act as an 'exercise-like' vascular stimulus, but evidence in older individuals with risk factors for cardiovascular disease who are unable to engage in conventional exercise is lacking," the researchers note.
paras.zh: 研究人员指出：“这些研究结果表明，热水浸泡可能起到‘类似运动’的血管刺激作用，但缺乏针对患有心血管疾病危险因素且无法进行常规运动的老年人的证据。”

paras.en: To plug the gap, the researchers recruited 25 adults aged 45–70 with overweight or obesity, with an average age of 59.
paras.zh: 为了填补这一空白，研究人员招募了 25 名年龄在 45-70 岁之间超重或肥胖的成年人，平均年龄为 59 岁。

paras.en: During the experiment, each of the participants completed two different interventions, in a random order, and separated by at least 72 hours.
paras.zh: 实验期间，每位参与者以随机顺序完成两次不同的干预措施，且间隔至少 72 小时。

paras.en: In one intervention, participants sat chest-deep for 30 minutes in hot water, which was maintained at a temperature of 40 °C (104 °F).
paras.zh: 在一项干预措施中，参与者坐在齐胸深的热水中 30 分钟，热水温度保持在 40 °C (104 °F)。

paras.en: In the other intervention, participants performed a moderate-intensity exercise session, cycling for 30 minutes on a stationary exercise bicycle, with the intensity corresponding to 60–70 percent of their maximum heart rate.
paras.zh: 在另一项干预措施中，参与者进行了中等强度的锻炼，即骑固定健身自行车 30 分钟，强度相当于最大心率的 60-70%。

paras.en: The participants had their heart rate, mean arterial pressure, and core body temperature monitored during the tests, and researchers also assessed tiny blood vessels in the participants' skin, using a non-invasive technique called optical coherence tomography (OCT).
paras.zh: 在测试过程中，参与者的心率、平均动脉压和核心体温受到监测，研究人员还使用一种称为光学相干断层扫描（OCT）的非侵入性技术评估了参与者皮肤中的微小血管。

paras.en: Results showed that, compared to the exercise intervention, the hot water immersion produced significantly larger increases in blood vessel diameter, blood flow, and blood velocity, as well as the density of microvessels with detectable blood flow.
paras.zh: 结果显示，与运动干预相比，热水浸泡使血管直径、血流量、血速度以及可检测到血流量的微血管密度显着增加。

paras.en: An indication of this can be seen in an OCT-derived image from participants' forearms, which visibly shows increased blood flow activity in the microvascular network after hot water immersion.
paras.zh: 从参与者前臂的 OCT 图像中可以看出这一点，该图像明显显示热水浸泡后微血管网络中的血流活动增加。

paras.en: "These pronounced microvascular responses were accompanied by a larger elevation in core body temperature and greater reductions in systolic and diastolic blood pressure following hot water immersion, whereas moderate-intensity exercise elicited a higher heart rate response," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“这些明显的微血管反应伴随着热水浸泡后核心体温的更大升高以及收缩压和舒张压的更大降低，而中等强度的运动会引发更高的心率反应。”

paras.en: "Collectively, these findings suggest that the larger microvascular responses observed after hot water immersion likely reflect the combined effects of direct local skin heating and greater systemic thermal strain imposed by passive heating."
paras.zh: “总的来说，这些发现表明，热水浸泡后观察到的更大的微血管反应可能反映了直接局部皮肤加热和被动加热施加的更大的全身热应变的综合影响。”

paras.en: The researchers say that hot water immersion promotes the widening of blood vessels, a process called vasodilation, which facilitates heat dissipation by redistributing blood flow to the skin.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，热水浸泡会促进血管扩张，这一过程称为血管舒张，通过重新分配皮肤的血流来促进热量散发。

paras.en: While the findings suggest hot water immersion could potentially hold promise as a complementary way of providing a vascular stimulus, the researchers are careful to point out there's much we still don't know.
paras.zh: 虽然研究结果表明热水浸泡可能有望作为提供血管刺激的补充方式，但研究人员小心地指出，我们仍然不知道很多。

paras.en: That's especially so since the experiment here was matched for time (30 minutes for each intervention), but not for the levels of thermal strain experienced by the body.
paras.zh: 尤其如此，因为这里的实验与时间匹配（每次干预 30 分钟），但与身体经历的热应变水平不匹配。

paras.en: "Accordingly, the present findings should not be interpreted as indicating that hot water immersion is intrinsically superior to moderate-intensity exercise per se; rather, they reflect the greater thermal strain achieved during hot water immersion, which elicited substantial shear-mediated vascular stimuli in the absence of active muscle contraction," the authors explain.
paras.zh: “因此，目前的研究结果不应被解释为表明热水浸泡本质上优于中等强度运动本身；相反，它们反映了热水浸泡期间实现的更大的热应变，这在没有主动肌肉收缩的情况下引发了大量剪切介导的血管刺激，”作者解释道。

paras.en: "This may be particularly relevant for clinical populations who are unable to engage in regular exercise, suggesting that hot water immersion could serve as a complementary or alternative strategy to induce beneficial vascular stimuli."
paras.zh: “这可能与无法进行定期锻炼的临床人群特别相关，表明热水浸泡可以作为诱导有益血管刺激的补充或替代策略。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in the European Journal of Applied Physiology.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《欧洲应用生理学杂志》上。

articles.title: Sexually Transmitted Diarrhea Is Exploding in The US. And It's Growing Resistant to Medicine
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: A gut pathogen that causes diarrhea and vomiting is morphing into a dangerous and difficult-to-treat sexually transmitted infection (STI).
paras.zh: 一种引起腹泻和呕吐的肠道病原体正在演变成一种危险且难以治疗的性传播感染（STI）。

paras.en: In the United States, roughly 450,000 people acquire shigellosis each year, which can lead to dysentery.
paras.zh: 在美国，每年大约有 45 万人感染志贺氏菌病，这可能导致痢疾。

paras.en: Historically, this highly contagious bug has mostly been spread through contaminated food or water during travel, and among young children in day care.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，这种高度传染性的细菌主要是在旅行期间通过受污染的食物或水以及在日托中心的幼儿中传播的。

paras.en: But since the turn of the century or so, Shigella bacteria have emerged as a sexually transmitted infection as well.
paras.zh: 但自本世纪之交左右以来，志贺氏菌也已成为一种性传播感染。

paras.en: Shigella infections can make anyone sick, but they are now considered 'endemic' in some communities of gay, bisexual and other men who have sex with men (GBMSM).
paras.zh: 志贺氏菌感染可以使任何人生病，但在一些同性恋、双性恋和其他男男性行为者 (GBMSM) 社区中，志贺氏菌感染现在被认为是“流行病”。

paras.en: Several of the strains transmitted in these communities have grown resistant to multiple antibiotics.
paras.zh: 在这些社区传播的一些菌株已经对多种抗生素产生了耐药性。

paras.en: Some are now superbugs, on the brink of becoming untreatable.
paras.zh: 有些现在已经成为超级细菌，处于无法治疗的边缘。

paras.en: A recent analysis from the US CDC found that among nearly 17,000 Shigella isolates, versions that were extensively drug-resistant (XDR) rose from 2011 to 2023.
paras.zh: 美国疾病预防控制中心 (CDC) 最近的一项分析发现，在近 17,000 种志贺氏菌分离株中，从 2011 年到 2023 年，广泛耐药 (XDR) 的菌株有所增加。

paras.en: In 2011, isolates that were resistant to five commonly used antibiotics made up 0 percent of the samples. By 2023, they made up 8.5 percent.
paras.zh: 2011 年，对五种常用抗生素具有耐药性的菌株占样本的 0%。到 2023 年，这一比例将达到 8.5%。

paras.en: The vast majority of these drug-resistant versions had infected adult men, many of whom had not traveled internationally in recent months.
paras.zh: 这些耐药病毒绝大多数感染了成年男性，其中许多人最近几个月没有出国旅行。

paras.en: Molecular biologist Shangxin Yang says hospital workers at the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) are now seeing roughly one case of extensively drug-resistant Shigella a month.
paras.zh: 分子生物学家杨尚欣表示，加州大学洛杉矶分校 (UCLA) 的医院工作人员现在每月大约会发现一例广泛耐药志贺氏菌。

paras.en: In 2022, by comparison, they saw just one case all year.
paras.zh: 相比之下，2022 年他们全年只看到一例。

paras.en: "It's almost like an explosion of this pathogen in the community," Yang told CIDRAP News at the University of Minnesota.
paras.zh: 杨在明尼苏达大学告诉 CIDRAP 新闻：“这几乎就像这种病原体在社区中爆发一样。”

paras.en: Sexually transmissible shigellosis was first reported in 1974, but it represented a minority of cases at the time.
paras.zh: 性传播志贺氏菌病首次报道于 1974 年，但当时仅占少数病例。

paras.en: Now, emerging evidence suggests that sexual contact is a major route of transmission.
paras.zh: 现在，新的证据表明性接触是主要的传播途径。

paras.en: It's difficult to verify this information, however, as patients and clinicians may not realize that Shigella can be sexually transmitted, and sexual history may not be recorded.
paras.zh: 然而，很难验证这一信息，因为患者和临床医生可能没有意识到志贺氏菌可以通过性传播，并且可能不会记录性史。

paras.en: That said, according to US CDC data, more than a third of patients with extensively drug-resistant shigellosis were hospitalized, and nearly half of those with known HIV status had HIV.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，根据美国疾病预防控制中心的数据，超过三分之一的广泛耐药志贺氏菌病患者住院治疗，而已知艾滋病毒感染状况的患者中近一半患有艾滋病毒。

paras.en: "Together, it's a very concerning pattern of XDR Shigella strains that are being seen among vulnerable populations," epidemiologist Naeemah Logan from the CDC told CIDRAP News.
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心的流行病学家 Naeemah Logan 告诉 CIDRAP 新闻：“总而言之，在弱势人群中发现了一种非常令人担忧的 XDR 志贺氏菌菌株模式。”

paras.en: "This is by no means unique to the US, but really part of a broader global pattern."
paras.zh: “这绝不是美国独有的，而是更广泛的全球格局的一部分。”

paras.en: Geneticist Kate Baker from the University of Cambridge, senior author of a recent study in The Lancet Infectious Diseases, has identified a similar surge in the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 剑桥大学的遗传学家凯特·贝克（Kate Baker）是《柳叶刀传染病》最近一项研究的资深作者，她发现英国也出现了类似的激增。

paras.en: "Many men who have sex with men are unaware of the serious and increasing risk posed by sexually transmitted Shigella," said Baker in a July press release.
paras.zh: 贝克在 7 月份的新闻稿中表示：“许多男男性行为者并没有意识到性传播志贺氏菌带来的严重且日益增加的风险。”

paras.en: "This disease has gone from being relatively treatable with off-the-shelf drugs to being close to untreatable over the course of the last decade or so."
paras.zh: “在过去十年左右的时间里，这种疾病已经从相对可以用现成药物治疗到几乎无法治疗。”

paras.en: In March, the UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) warned that while most cases of Shigella resolve without treatment, more severe cases do require treatment, and "the options available are becoming limited."
paras.zh: 三月份，英国健康安全局 (UKHSA) 警告说，虽然大多数志贺氏菌病例无需治疗即可痊愈，但更严重的病例确实需要治疗，而且“可用的选择越来越有限”。

paras.en: In 2025, 86 percent of Shigella sonnei samples and 94 percent of Shigella flexneri samples tested by UKHSA researchers showed resistance to antibiotics.
paras.zh: 2025 年，UKHSA 研究人员测试的 86% 宋内志贺菌样本和 94% 福氏志贺菌样本显示出对抗生素的耐药性。

paras.en: These are the two most commonly spread strains through sexual contact among GBMSM in England.
paras.zh: 这是英格兰 GBMSM 中最常通过性接触传播的两种病毒。

paras.en: In previous research by Baker and others, up to a third of patients with sexually transmitted Shigella were hospitalized for an average of four to five days.
paras.zh: 在贝克等人之前的研究中，多达三分之一的性传播志贺氏菌患者平均住院四到五天。

paras.en: "This isn't just one form of sexually transmissible diarrhea," says Baker.
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是性传播腹泻的一种形式，”贝克说。

paras.en: "This is multiple overlapping variants emerging that are all quickly becoming resistant to the drugs we use to treat them. It's highly likely that if you contracted your Shigella through sex, you require different treatment to someone who contracted it through travel."
paras.zh: “这是多种重叠的变异体的出现，它们很快就会对我们用来治疗它们的药物产生耐药性。如果你通过性行为感染了志贺氏菌，那么你很可能需要与通过旅行感染志贺氏菌的人不同的治疗方法。”

paras.en: No one knows why that is, but Baker's 2026 study points to 'bystander resistance' as one driver.
paras.zh: 没有人知道这是为什么，但贝克 2026 年的研究指出，作为一名司机，“旁观者的抵制”。

paras.en: This means that an antibiotic meant for one pathogen may not be the right drug or dose for another present pathogen, thereby breeding resistance as a side effect.
paras.zh: 这意味着针对一种病原体的抗生素可能不是另一种现有病原体的正确药物或剂量，从而产生耐药性作为副作用。

paras.en: In response to the recent study, Alicia Calvo-Villamañán, a researcher at the Gulbenkian Institute for Molecular Medicine in Lisbon, Portugal, pointed out an intriguing association.
paras.zh: 针对最近的研究，葡萄牙里斯本古尔本基安分子医学研究所的研究员 Alicia Calvo-Villamañán 指出了一个有趣的关联。

paras.en: "When the UK's national treatment guidelines stopped recommending the use of [azithromycin] to treat gonorrhea infections," they wrote, "the emergence of azithromycin resistance in Shigella slowed down."
paras.zh: “当英国国家治疗指南停止推荐使用[阿奇霉素]治疗淋病感染时，”他们写道，“志贺菌对阿奇霉素耐药性的出现减缓了。”

paras.en: That doesn't mean one is causing the other, but it suggests that treating other STIs may be a risk factor for drug-resistant Shigella infections, which aren't often screened as STIs.
paras.zh: 这并不意味着一种疾病会导致另一种疾病，但它表明治疗其他性传播感染可能是耐药志贺氏菌感染的一个危险因素，而这种感染通常不会被筛查为性传播感染。

paras.en: The California Department of Public Health says that the best way to prevent Shigella infection from sex is to not have sex with someone who has had diarrhea in the last two weeks.
paras.zh: 加州公共卫生部表示，预防性交感染志贺氏菌的最佳方法是不要与过去两周患有腹泻的人发生性关系。

paras.en: Using barriers during oral and anal sex is also advised, as is washing up before and after sex.
paras.zh: 还建议在口交和肛交期间使用屏障，以及在性交前后进行清洗。

paras.en: To minimize transmission, anyone who suspects they may have Shigella should get tested and seek treatment if necessary.
paras.zh: 为了最大限度地减少传播，任何怀疑自己可能感染志贺氏菌的人都应该接受检测，并在必要时寻求治疗。

paras.en: "Clinicians should be asking patients with dysentery about sexual transmission and giving advice accordingly," said Daniel Richardson, a consultant in sexual health at University Hospitals Sussex in July.
paras.zh: 苏塞克斯大学医院的性健康顾问丹尼尔·理查森 (Daniel Richardson) 7 月表示：“临床医生应该询问痢疾患者有关性传播的情况，并给出相应的建议。”

paras.en: "They need to know that sexually transmitted Shigella has more antimicrobial resistance than other forms of the disease, and that patients may need checking for other sexually transmissible illnesses."
paras.zh: “他们需要知道，性传播志贺氏菌比其他形式的疾病具有更强的抗菌耐药性，并且患者可能需要检查其他性传播疾病。”

articles.title: One Simple Habit May Give Your Bowels a Boost Within Minutes
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: Nobody likes the feeling of being constipated, but the consequences of being backed up might be more serious than you realize.
paras.zh: 没有人喜欢便秘的感觉，但便秘的后果可能比你想象的更严重。

paras.en: Research shows that the amount of time poop sticks around in your body can have an overlooked impact on your health and quality of life, with constipation being a known risk factor for cardiovascular events, including heart attacks, heart failure, and stroke, among other complications.
paras.zh: 研究表明，粪便在体内停留的时间可能会对您的健康和生活质量产生被忽视的影响，便秘是心血管事件的已知危险因素，包括心脏病发作、心力衰竭和中风等并发症。

paras.en: Fortunately, there are steps you can take to get things moving again, and one of the easiest strategies is simply doing some light exercise.
paras.zh: 幸运的是，您可以采取一些步骤来让事情重新开始，最简单的策略之一就是做一些轻微的运动。

paras.en: We know that people who do regular exercise have less risk of developing constipation, whereas low levels of physical activity and high amounts of sedentary behavior may increase your chances of getting blocked.
paras.zh: 我们知道，经常锻炼的人患便秘的风险较小，而低水平的体力活动和大量的久坐行为可能会增加便秘的风险。

paras.en: What's less clear, though, is what exercise actually does inside the body to help prevent or alleviate constipation, but a recent study published in Scientific Reports offers some plausible explanations – and suggests physical activity has an "immediate effect" on your gut, which could help ease the problem.
paras.zh: 然而，不太清楚的是，运动在体内到底能起到什么作用来帮助预防或缓解便秘，但最近发表在《科学报告》上的一项研究提供了一些合理的解释，并表明体力活动对肠道有“直接影响”，这可能有助于缓解问题。

paras.en: In an experiment, a team of researchers from Fujita Health University in Japan recruited 21 healthy adult participants specifically to listen to the sounds of their bowels.
paras.zh: 在一项实验中，日本藤田保健大学的一组研究人员招募了 21 名健康成年参与者，专门听他们肠子的声音。

paras.en: "Walking can serve as an effective, immediate tool for stimulating bowel function." – senior author and rehabilitation physician Yohei Otaka
paras.zh: “步行可以作为刺激肠道功能的有效、直接的工具。” – 资深作者、康复医师 Yohei Otaka

paras.en: Ordinarily, other people's bowel sounds aren't something you want to hear, but in terms of medical analysis, they're an established and non-invasive indicator of gut motility – the muscle movements that move food along the gastrointestinal (GI) tract during the digestion process.
paras.zh: 通常，您不想听到其他人的肠鸣音，但从医学分析的角度来看，它们是肠道蠕动的既定且非侵入性指标，即在消化过程中沿着胃肠 (GI) 道移动食物的肌肉运动。

paras.en: "Bowel sounds have been used as indirect measurements of gut motility since the early 1900s," the team explains in their paper, led by physical therapist Kento Katagiri.
paras.zh: “自 1900 年代初以来，肠鸣音一直被用来间接测量肠道蠕动，”物理治疗师 Kento Katagiri 领导的研究小组在论文中解释道。

paras.en: "The bowel sound is produced by the turbulence caused by gut motility during the movement of liquids and gases through the intestinal tract."
paras.zh: “肠鸣音是由液体和气体通过肠道时肠道蠕动引起的湍流产生的。”

paras.en: In the experiment, the participants rested for five minutes, then had their bowel sounds measured using an electronic stethoscope to establish what their baseline level of gut motility sounded like.
paras.zh: 在实验中，参与者休息五分钟，然后使用电子听诊器测量肠鸣音，以确定他们的肠道蠕动的基线水平。

paras.en: The stethoscope readings were taken at least two hours after eating, to minimize the effects of food intake during the experiment.
paras.zh: 听诊器读数在进食后至少两个小时进行，以尽量减少实验过程中食物摄入的影响。

paras.en: Next, participants walked on a treadmill at a comfortable walking speed for 20 minutes – approximately 3,000 steps, which in previous research was a level of walking shown to improve bowel clearance in patients preparing for a colonoscopy.
paras.zh: 接下来，参与者以舒适的步行速度在跑步机上行走 20 分钟（大约 3,000 步），在之前的研究中，该步行水平被证明可以改善准备结肠镜检查的患者的肠道清除率。

paras.en: After the treadmill, the participants again had their bowel sounds measured to see how the light exercise session might have affected their gut motility.
paras.zh: 跑步机结束后，参与者再次测量肠鸣音，以了解轻度运动对他们肠道蠕动的影响。

paras.en: When the scientists analyzed the recordings, they found that three separate bowel-sound measures increased for 1–2 minutes after the physical activity, including the sound index (SI – the overall strength and amplitude of the sounds) and the duration and number of bowel sounds.
paras.zh: 当科学家分析这些录音时，他们发现三个独立的肠鸣音测量在体力活动后 1-2 分钟内增加，包括声音指数（SI - 声音的整体强度和幅度）以及肠鸣音的持续时间和数量。

paras.en: According to the researchers, the increase in the bowel sounds may reflect changes in gut motility induced by the physical activity, and could be a result of increased peristaltic movement – wave-like muscular contractions that propel food through the GI tract.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，肠鸣音的增加可能反映了体力活动引起的肠道蠕动的变化，并且可能是蠕动运动增加的结果，即推动食物通过胃肠道的波状肌肉收缩。

paras.en: As for how exercise triggers this, the researchers suggest two possible mechanisms inside the body that might play a role.
paras.zh: 至于运动如何引发这种情况，研究人员提出了体内两种可能发挥作用的机制。

paras.en: Firstly, it's possible the effects seen could relate to changes in the autonomic nervous system during physical activity, with an increase in parasympathetic nervous system activity directly after exercise stimulating gut motility.
paras.zh: 首先，所观察到的影响可能与体力活动期间自主神经系统的变化有关，在运动刺激肠道蠕动后，副交感神经系统活动立即增加。

paras.en: Another factor could be biomechanical oscillations in the body triggered by bodily movement during physical activity.
paras.zh: 另一个因素可能是身体活动期间身体运动引发的身体生物力学振荡。

paras.en: Previous research has shown that whole-body vibration can relieve constipation, and it's possible, the team thinks, that the up-and-down and side-to-side movements of the body during walking or other physical activity might trigger local reflexes in the GI tract that promote gut movement.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，全身振动可以缓解便秘，研究小组认为，步行或其他身体活动期间身体的上下和左右运动可能会触发胃肠道的局部反射，从而促进肠道运动。

paras.en: Right now, these explanations remain speculative, and the researchers note additional studies will be needed to test these hypotheses.
paras.zh: 目前，这些解释仍然是推测性的，研究人员指出需要进行更多的研究来检验这些假设。

paras.en: It's also worth noting that none of the participants in the experiment actually had constipation, and even if they did, bowel sounds aren't considered a perfect indicator of gut motility, as the method can also pick up other sounds made in the gut that might not reflect motility.
paras.zh: 还值得注意的是，实验中没有一个参与者实际上患有便秘，即使他们患有便秘，肠鸣音也不被认为是肠道蠕动的完美指标，因为该方法还可以拾取肠道中发出的其他可能无法反映蠕动的声音。

paras.en: The researchers also note that simply moving from lying down to standing may have contributed to the changes.
paras.zh: 研究人员还指出，仅仅从躺着到站着可能就导致了这些变化。

paras.en: But while we have to bear some of these limitations in mind when considering the findings, the results offer a possible explanation for why even light physical activity can help get things moving again when you're constipated – and at least in terms of the bowel sounds part of the equation, the effects appear to be virtually instantaneous.
paras.zh: 但是，虽然我们在考虑研究结果时必须牢记其中的一些局限性，但结果提供了一个可能的解释，解释为什么当你便秘时，即使是轻微的体力活动也能帮助你恢复活动——至少就肠鸣音而言，效果似乎几乎是瞬时的。

paras.en: "Our findings indicate that walking immediately enhances gut motility through measurable changes in bowel sound parameters, thereby highlighting the importance of physical activity interventions in constipation management," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“我们的研究结果表明，步行可以通过肠鸣音参数的可测量变化立即增强肠道蠕动，从而凸显身体活动干预在便秘管理中的重要性。”

paras.en: "The clinical significance of this study is that such activity can be safely performed by anyone, making it widely applicable and easy to incorporate into daily life."
paras.zh: “这项研究的临床意义在于，任何人都可以安全地进行此类活动，使其广泛适用并易于融入日常生活。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Scientific Reports.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《科学报告》中。

articles.title: Scientists changed how zoo lions eat. Their wild side came out

paras.en: Scientists changed how zoo lions eat. Their wild side came out
paras.zh: 科学家改变了动物园狮子的饮食方式。他们狂野的一面显露出来

paras.en: - Giving zoo lions whole carcasses on a feast-and-fast schedule appears to bring out more natural behavior. The lions spent nearly three times longer feeding, engaged in more tearing and manipulating of food, and rested more heavily after meals. Their activity then increased gradually during the fasting period, closely resembling the rhythm seen in wild lions.
paras.zh: - 快速地给动物园的狮子提供完整的尸体似乎可以带来更自然的行为。狮子的进食时间延长了近三倍，更多地撕扯和操纵食物，饭后休息得更充分。在禁食期间，它们的活动逐渐增加，与野生狮子的节奏非常相似。

paras.en: A new Australian study suggests that zoo lions behave more like their wild counterparts when they are given whole animal carcasses as part of a feast and fast feeding schedule.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚的一项新研究表明，当动物园狮子在盛宴和快速进食计划中获得整个动物尸体时，它们的行为更像野生狮子。

paras.en: Published in Applied Animal Behaviour Science, the research was conducted by Adelaide University and Monarto Safari Park in South Australia. Scientists studied a group of adult male African lions after animal care staff added whole carcasses every nine days to an existing feeding routine designed around periods of eating and fasting.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《应用动物行为科学》上，由阿德莱德大学和南澳大利亚莫纳托野生动物园进行。动物护理人员每九天将整个尸体添加到围绕进食和禁食时间设计的现有喂养程序中后，科学家们对一群成年雄性非洲狮进行了研究。

paras.en: Continuous video monitoring over three months showed that the lions spent much more time eating when carcasses were provided, rested for longer afterward, and gradually became more active as the fasting period continued. Together, these patterns more closely resembled the natural feeding cycles seen in wild lions.
paras.zh: 三个月的连续视频监控显示，当提供尸体时，狮子进食的时间明显增多，之后休息的时间也更长，并且随着禁食期的持续，狮子逐渐变得更加活跃。总之，这些模式更接近野生狮子的自然进食周期。

paras.en: Lead author Lesia Hryhorenko from Adelaide University's School of Animal and Veterinary Sciences said the study provides new information about how feeding routines can shape the behavior of carnivores living in human care.
paras.zh: 来自阿德莱德大学动物和兽医学院的主要作者 Lesia Hryhorenko 表示，这项研究提供了关于喂养习惯如何塑造生活在人类照顾下的食肉动物行为的新信息。

paras.en: "Wild lions don't eat at the same time every day. They experience natural periods of feasting and fasting depending on hunting success," Hryhorenko said.
paras.zh: “野生狮子不会每天在同一时间进食。它们会经历自然的盛宴和禁食期，具体取决于狩猎的成功，”赫里霍连科说。

paras.en: "We wanted to understand how African lions in human care respond when feeding routines more closely resemble those natural patterns."
paras.zh: “我们想了解人类饲养的非洲狮在进食习惯更接近自然模式时有何反应。”

paras.en: The research team - which included visiting Belgium Masters student Florence Demoulin from the University of Liege - observed three adult male lions at Monarto Safari Park before and after whole carcasses were introduced.
paras.zh: 研究小组——其中包括来自列日大学的访问比利时硕士生 Florence Demoulin——在莫纳托野生动物园观察了三只成年雄狮在引入整个尸体之前和之后的情况。

paras.en: During the experimental phase, the three lions received approximately 200 kilograms of carcasses. The food was left available for as long as three days, after which the lions entered a period of rest and digestion.
paras.zh: 在实验阶段，三头狮子收到了大约200公斤的尸体。食物可以保存长达三天，之后狮子就进入休息和消化的时期。

paras.en: Researchers used eight infrared cameras to record the animals continuously. This produced one of the most detailed 24 hour datasets yet assembled for African lions in human care under a carcass feeding regime.
paras.zh: 研究人员使用八个红外摄像机连续记录这些动物。这产生了迄今为止最详细的非洲狮 24 小时数据集之一，这些数据集是在屠体喂养制度下进行人类护理的非洲狮。

paras.en: The difference on carcass feeding days was substantial. The lions spent almost three times as long eating as they typically did. They also fed more frequently and for longer stretches as they tore apart, pulled at, manipulated, and consumed the carcasses.
paras.zh: 屠体饲养天数的差异很大。狮子进食的时间几乎是平时的三倍。它们还更频繁、更长时间地进食，同时撕扯、拉扯、操纵和吃掉尸体。

paras.en: These activities gave the animals more opportunities to perform the kinds of feeding behaviors that are part of life in the wild.
paras.zh: 这些活动为动物提供了更多的机会来进行野外生活的进食行为。

paras.en: Once the lions had finished feeding, they spent considerably more time lying down and resting. As the fasting period went on, their movement gradually increased again.
paras.zh: 狮子吃完食物后，它们会花更多的时间躺下休息。随着禁食时间的推移，他们的活动又逐渐增多。

paras.en: This repeating pattern of intense feeding, extended rest, and rising activity closely matched the feast and fast rhythm documented among wild lion populations.
paras.zh: 这种密集进食、延长休息和增加活动的重复模式与野生狮子种群中记录的盛宴和快节奏密切相关。

paras.en: "Providing whole carcasses changes much more than the nutritional content of the diet," Hryhorenko said.
paras.zh: 赫里霍伦科说：“提供整头尸体的变化远比饮食中的营养成分要大得多。”

paras.en: "It gives lions the opportunity to engage in behaviors such as tearing, pulling and manipulating food over extended periods, which are important components of their natural feeding ecology."
paras.zh: “它让狮子有机会长时间进行撕扯、拉扯和操纵食物等行为，这是它们自然进食生态的重要组成部分。”

paras.en: Pacing Appears Linked to Routine, Not Hunger
paras.zh: 节奏似乎与日常生活有关，而不是与饥饿有关

paras.en: The researchers also tracked pacing, a repetitive behavior in carnivores that is often linked to anticipation.
paras.zh: 研究人员还追踪了步调，这是食肉动物的一种重复行为，通常与预期有关。

paras.en: Pacing increased slightly over the study period, but it did not consistently rise as the lions went longer without food. Instead, the largest increases occurred around predictable events such as keeper arrivals and times when the animals were moved between areas of their habitat.
paras.zh: 在研究期间，步速略有增加，但随着狮子不吃食物的时间延长，步速并没有持续增加。相反，最大的增加发生在可预测的事件周围，例如饲养员到达以及动物在栖息地之间移动的时间。

paras.en: That pattern suggests pacing may have been more strongly connected to familiar daily routines and the expectation of feeding than to hunger itself.
paras.zh: 这种模式表明，节奏可能与熟悉的日常生活和进食预期的关系比与饥饿本身的关系更为密切。

paras.en: The researchers also found no increase in aggression or disruption to the lions' social stability during whole carcass feeding events.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，在整个屠体喂养事件中，狮子的攻击性或社会稳定性没有增加或受到破坏。

paras.en: Co-author Associate Professor Alexandra Whittaker said the findings demonstrate why animal behavior needs to be monitored over longer periods when researchers evaluate zoo management practices.
paras.zh: 合著者亚历山德拉·惠特克（Alexandra Whittaker）副教授表示，研究结果表明，当研究人员评估动物园管理实践时，为什么需要更长时间地监测动物行为。

paras.en: "Many zoo studies focus only on what happens immediately after food is provided," Associate Professor Whittaker said.
paras.zh: “许多动物园研究只关注提供食物后立即发生的情况，”惠特克副教授说。

paras.en: "Our results show that feeding schedules can influence behavior for days afterwards, making it essential to look at behavioral patterns across the entire feeding cycle rather than a single feeding event."
paras.zh: “我们的结果表明，喂食时间表可以影响随后几天的行为，因此有必要研究整个喂食周期而不是单个喂食事件的行为模式。”

paras.en: The researchers say future work could combine behavioral monitoring with physiological measurements to provide a more complete picture of how different feeding strategies affect animal welfare and well-being.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，未来的工作可以将行为监测与生理测量结合起来，以更全面地了解不同的喂养策略如何影响动物福利和福祉。

paras.zh: 材料由阿德莱德大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Taking antibiotics? Sugar may be making the damage worse

paras.en: Taking antibiotics? Sugar may be making the damage worse
paras.zh: 服用抗生素？糖可能会使损害更严重

paras.en: - NYU Langone Health / NYU Grossman School of Medicine
paras.zh: - 纽约大学朗格健康中心/纽约大学格罗斯曼医学院

paras.en: - Eating more sugar while taking antibiotics was linked to greater disruption of the gut microbiome and increased growth of potentially harmful bacteria. Researchers say temporarily cutting back on sweets during and after antibiotic treatment could be a simple way to reduce this damage, though clinical trials are still needed.
paras.zh: - 在服用抗生​​素的同时吃更多的糖与肠道微生物组的更大破坏和潜在有害细菌的生长增加有关。研究人员表示，在抗生素治疗期间和之后暂时减少甜食可能是减少这种损害的简单方法，但仍需要进行临床试验。

paras.en: Eating more sugar while taking antibiotics may intensify the disruption those drugs cause to beneficial gut bacteria, according to new research.
paras.zh: 最新研究表明，在服用抗生​​素的同时吃更多的糖可能会加剧这些药物对有益肠道细菌造成的破坏。

paras.en: The study focused on the intestinal microbiome, the vast community of bacteria that has evolved alongside humans and helps with digestion, immune function, and other essential processes. Antibiotics are among the most commonly prescribed medicines worldwide, but they can kill beneficial bacteria as well as harmful ones. In some cases, that disruption allows potentially dangerous species to gain an advantage.
paras.zh: 这项研究的重点是肠道微生物组，这是一个与人类一起进化的庞大细菌群落，有助于消化、免疫功能和其他重要过程。抗生素是全世界最常用的处方药物之一，但它们可以杀死有益细菌和有害细菌。在某些情况下，这种破坏使得潜在危险的物种获得了优势。

paras.en: A diverse microbiome is generally better able to resist the expansion of harmful pathogens. Antibiotic treatment can reduce that diversity, leaving the gut ecosystem more vulnerable to disease, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 多样化的微生物组通常能够更好地抵抗有害病原体的扩张。研究人员表示，抗生素治疗会降低这种多样性，使肠道生态系统更容易受到疾病的影响。

paras.en: Sugar Linked to Greater Microbiome Damage
paras.zh: 糖与更大的微生物组损伤有关

paras.en: Researchers from NYU Langone Health, City of Hope, and Memorial Sloan Kettering closely monitored 9,419 meals consumed by 173 hospitalized cancer patients and tracked changes in their gut microbiomes.
paras.zh: 来自纽约大学兰格尼健康中心、希望之城和纪念斯隆凯特琳大学的研究人员密切监测了 173 名住院癌症患者消耗的 9,419 份膳食，并跟踪了他们肠道微生物组的变化。

paras.en: For every additional 100 grams of sugar eaten during the 48 hours before treatment, the researchers observed an additional 21% decline in alpha diversity, a measure of the variety of beneficial bacterial species found in the gut.
paras.zh: 在治疗前 48 小时内，每多吃 100 克糖，研究人员观察到，α 多样性就会额外下降 21%，α 多样性是衡量肠道中有益细菌种类多样性的指标。

paras.en: The findings, published online Sept. 30 in the journal Nature, also showed that sugary diets combined with antibiotic treatment were associated with increases in Enterococcus faecium among patients. This bacterial species has been linked to infections that can be difficult to treat.
paras.zh: 9 月 30 日在线发表在《自然》杂志上的研究结果还表明，含糖饮食与抗生素治疗相结合与患者中屎肠球菌的增加有关。这种细菌与难以治疗的感染有关。

paras.en: Mouse experiments produced a similar result. Animals exposed to the antibiotic biapenem while consuming dietary sucrose experienced a 16.3-fold increase in the gut Enterococcus population by day 3 of the study. By day 6, the bacterial burden was 33.4-fold higher.
paras.zh: 小鼠实验也得出了类似的结果。在研究的第 3 天，在食用蔗糖的同时接触抗生素比阿培南的动物肠道肠球菌数量增加了 16.3 倍。到第 6 天，细菌负荷增加了 33.4 倍。

paras.en: "As we are learning how collateral damage of antibiotics to the microbiome are linked with long-term health problems, it's important to identify factors that limit these unintended health risks," said the study's co-senior author Jonas Schluter, PhD, assistant professor in the Department of Microbiology at NYU Langone. "Our study, which used more than 9,000 recorded meals, suggests that modifying diet during and after antibiotics, specifically by reducing sweets intake, could help with that."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同资深作者、纽约大学朗格尼分校微生物学系助理教授 Jonas Schluter 博士表示：“当我们了解抗生素对微生物群的附带损害如何与长期健康问题相关时，确定限制这些意外健康风险的因素非常重要。” “我们的研究使用了超过 9,000 份记录的膳食，结果表明，在服用抗生​​素期间和之后改变饮食，特别是减少甜食摄入量，可能会有所帮助。”

paras.en: Why Researchers Studied Blood Cancer Patients
paras.zh: 为什么研究人员研究血癌患者

paras.en: The team focused on people with blood cancers because these patients frequently receive antibiotics and their food intake can be monitored closely during hospitalization. Researchers recorded what patients ate at every meal and collected microbiome samples each day.
paras.zh: 该团队重点关注血癌患者，因为这些患者经常接受抗生素治疗，并且在住院期间可以密切监测他们的食物摄入量。研究人员记录了患者每顿饭吃的东西，并每天收集微生物组样本。

paras.en: That combination of detailed diet records and daily biological sampling made the project one of the largest and most detailed studies of its kind to date.
paras.zh: 详细的饮食记录和每日生物采样的结合使该项目成为迄今为止规模最大、最详细的同类研究之一。

paras.en: "The microbiome is emerging as an important factor in cancer care," said co-senior study author Marcel van den Brink, MD, PhD, chief physician executive at City of Hope. "For patients undergoing intensive treatments such as bone marrow transplantation, the healthy diversity of the gut microbiome can have important implications for outcomes. Studies like this help us better understand how everyday factors, including diet, may affect a delicate balance that influences how patients respond to treatment, recover, and experience side effects."
paras.zh: “微生物组正在成为癌症治疗中的一个重要因素，”该研究的共同高级作者、希望之城首席医师执行官 Marcel van den Brink 博士说。 “对于接受骨髓移植等强化治疗的患者来说，肠道微生物组的健康多样性可能对结果产生重要影响。这样的研究有助于我们更好地了解包括饮食在内的日常因素如何影响微妙的平衡，从而影响患者对治疗、康复和副作用的反应。”

paras.en: Patients with blood cancers who receive stem cell transplants are often hospitalized for several weeks while undergoing chemotherapy and antibiotic treatment. During that period, both their diets and their gut microbiomes can change dramatically.
paras.zh: 接受干细胞移植的血癌患者通常需要住院数周，同时接受化疗和抗生素治疗。在此期间，他们的饮食和肠道微生物群都会发生巨大变化。

paras.en: In these patients, potentially harmful species such as Enterococcus faecium can flourish after much of the surrounding microbial ecosystem has been "destroyed."
paras.zh: 在这些患者体内，当周围的大部分微生物生态系统被“破坏”后，粪肠球菌等潜在有害物种可能会大量繁殖。

paras.en: Gut Microbiome Damage and Cancer Outcomes
paras.zh: 肠道微生物组损伤和癌症结果

paras.en: "Especially in blood cancer patients, microbiome injury is associated with worse outcomes, including higher overall mortality and infections," said Jonathan Peled, co-senior author on the study and associate director of the Center for Hematological Malignancies at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center. "An important next step will be to design clinical trials to test whether short-term dietary changes can improve clinical outcomes in patients."
paras.zh: 该研究的共同资深作者、纪念斯隆凯特琳癌症中心血液恶性肿瘤中心副主任 Jonathan Peled 表示：“特别是在血癌患者中，微生物组损伤与更糟糕的结果相关，包括更高的总体死亡率和感染率。” “下一步重要的一步是设计临床试验，以测试短期饮食改变是否可以改善患者的临床结果。”

paras.en: The researchers say dietary sugar may magnify the microbiome disruption caused by antibiotics because potentially harmful bacteria that survive treatment may be able to use those sugars to expand.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，饮食中的糖可能会放大抗生素引起的微生物组破坏，因为在治疗中存活下来的潜在有害细菌可能能够利用这些糖来扩张。

paras.en: "The new work identifies dietary sugars as an amplifier of antibiotic-induced microbiome disruption, probably because the potentially harmful bacteria that survive the antibiotics are benefiting from the dietary sugars that they can use to expand," said study second author William Jogia, a PhD student in Dr. Schluter's lab in the Institute for Systems Genetics. "While the findings suggest that reducing simple sugars may limit microbiome injury, whether sugar directly supports Enterococcus, weakens competing bacteria, or acts through another mechanism in patients remains to be seen."
paras.zh: 该研究的第二作者、系统遗传学研究所 Schluter 博士实验室的博士生 William Jogia 说：“这项新研究确定膳食糖是抗生素引起的微生物组破坏的放大器，这可能是因为在抗生素中存活下来的潜在有害细菌正在从膳食糖中受益，它们可以利用这些糖进行扩张。” “虽然研究结果表明，减少单糖可能会限制微生物组损伤，但糖是否直接支持肠球菌、削弱竞争细菌，还是通过另一种机制对患者起作用，还有待观察。”

paras.en: The findings therefore suggest that cutting back on simple sugars during and after antibiotic treatment could potentially reduce microbiome damage. However, the researchers emphasize that more work is needed to determine exactly how sugar produces the effect and whether dietary changes will improve outcomes in patients.
paras.zh: 因此，研究结果表明，在抗生素治疗期间和之后减少单糖的摄入可能会减少微生物组的损伤。然而，研究人员强调，还需要做更多的工作来确定糖到底如何产生作用以及饮食改变是否会改善患者的预后。

paras.en: Along with Drs. Schluter and Jogia, study authors from the Schluter lab at the Department of Microbiology and Institute for Systems Genetics at NYU Langone Health were Caichen Duan, Chenzhen Zhang, Fanny Matheis, and Alexis Sullivan.
paras.zh: 与博士一起。 Schluter 和 Jogia 是来自纽约大学 Langone Health 微生物学系和系统遗传学研究所 Schluter 实验室的研究作者，他们是 Caichen Duan、Chenzhen Zhang、Fanny Matheis 和 Alexis Sullivan。

paras.en: Authors from the Adult Bone Marrow Transplantation Service in the Department of Medicine at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center were co-senior author Jonathan Peled, co-first authors Anqi Dai and Annamaria Ballweg, along with Madhumitha Rangesa, Peter Adintori, Mirae Baichoo, Nicholas Waters, Abrielle Swartz, Sukanya Sahu, Brianna Gipson, Sandeep Raj, Zoe Pierce, Kenton Wu, Justin Neuberger, Adam Warren, Marissa Lubin Buchan, Ana Gradissimo, Luigi Amoretti, Annelie Clurman, Daniel Brereton, Paul Giardina, Miguel-Angel Perales, and Sergio Giralt. Also authors from Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center were Teng Fei in the Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics, Oriana Miltiadous in the Department of Pediatrics, Tatanisha Peets in Food and Nutrition Services, and Marina Burgos da Silva in the Human Oncology & Pathogenesis Program.
paras.zh: 来自纪念斯隆·凯特琳癌症中心医学部成人骨髓移植服务中心的作者包括：共同资深作者 Jonathan Peled、共同第一作者 Anqi Dai 和 Annamaria Ballweg，以及 Madhumitha Rangesa、Peter Adintori、Mirae Baichoo、Nicholas Waters、Abrielle Swartz、Sukanya Sahu、Brianna Gipson、Sandeep Raj、Zoe Pierce、Kenton Wu、Justin Neuberger、Adam Warren、Marissa Lubin Buchan、Ana Gradissimo、Luigi Amoretti、Annelie Clurman、Daniel Brereton、Paul Giardina、Miguel-Angel Perales 和 Sergio Giralt。纪念斯隆·凯特琳癌症中心的作者还有流行病学和生物统计学系的滕菲、儿科的奥丽安娜·米尔蒂杜斯、食品和营养服务部的塔塔尼莎·皮茨以及人类肿瘤学和发病机制项目的玛丽娜·布尔戈斯·达席尔瓦。

paras.en: Other authors were Tyler Funnell, Natalie Smith, John Slingerland, Antonio Gomes, and Robert Jenq in the Department of Hematology and Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation at City of Hope National Medical Center in Los Angeles; Eiko Hayase in the Departments of Genomic Medicine and Stem Cell Transplantation Cellular Therapy in the Division of Cancer Medicine at University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center; Corrado Zuanelli Brambilla in the Hematology Unit, Department of Cellular Therapy, Hematology and Laboratory Medicine at Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria Senese in Siena, Italy; Abigail Johnson in the Division of Epidemiology and Community Health in the School of Public Health at the University of Minnesota, Minneapolis; Dan Knights in Department of Computer Science and Engineering at the University of Minnesota; and Kate Markey in the Translational Science and Therapeutics Division at Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center in Seattle.
paras.zh: 其他作者包括洛杉矶希望之城国家医疗中心血液学和造血细胞移植科的 Tyler Funnell、Natalie Smith、John Slingerland、Antonio Gomes 和 Robert Jenq； Eiko Hayase，德克萨斯大学 MD 安德森癌症中心癌症医学科基因组医学和干细胞移植细胞治疗系； Corrado Zuanelli Brambilla，意大利锡耶纳 Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria Senese 细胞治疗、血液学和实验医学系血液科；阿比盖尔·约翰逊 (Abigail Johnson)，明尼阿波利斯市明尼苏达大学公共卫生学院流行病学和社区卫生系； Dan Knights，明尼苏达大学计算机科学与工程系；和西雅图 Fred Hutchinson 癌症中心转化科学与治疗部门的 Kate Markey。

These relationships are being managed in keeping with the policies of NYU Langone Health.

articles.title: NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together

paras.en: NASAâs Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
paras.zh: 美国宇航局韦伯发现火星大小的世界粉碎在一起的迹象

paras.en: - NASAâs James Webb Space Telescope is giving astronomers a glimpse of the kinds of violent collisions that may have shaped our own solar system, including the giant impact thought to have created the Moon. By studying 21 rare âextreme debris disksâ around young stars, researchers found that their dust can reveal the scale and intensity of planetary collisions.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜让天文学家得以一睹可能塑造了我们太阳系的各种剧烈碰撞，包括被认为创造了月球的巨大撞击。通过研究年轻恒星周围的 21 个罕见的“极端碎片盘”，研究人员发现它们的尘埃可以揭示行星碰撞的规模和强度。

paras.en: Scientists think one of the most important events in the early solar system was a colossal collision between the young Earth and a Mars-sized body known as Theia. The impact likely vaporized huge quantities of rock and hurled material into space. Some of that debris eventually came together to form the Moon, where NASA's Artemis program is returning humans, preparing for Mars, and shaping the future of space exploration.
paras.zh: 科学家认为，早期太阳系中最重要的事件之一是年轻的地球与火星大小的忒伊亚天体之间的巨大碰撞。这次撞击可能会蒸发大量岩石并将物质抛入太空。其中一些碎片最终聚集在一起形成了月球，美国宇航局的阿尔忒弥斯计划正在月球上载人，为登陆火星做准备，并塑造太空探索的未来。

paras.en: That ancient impact dramatically altered Earth. Now, astronomers are using NASA's James Webb Space Telescope to investigate young star systems that appear to be experiencing similarly violent events. By studying these systems, researchers can estimate how energetic the collisions were and learn more about how rocky planets form and evolve.
paras.zh: 那场古老的撞击极大地改变了地球。现在，天文学家正在使用美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜来研究似乎正在经历类似暴力事件的年轻恒星系统。通过研究这些系统，研究人员可以估计碰撞的能量有多大，并更多地了解岩石行星如何形成和演化。

paras.en: The team's findings published Oct 1. in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究结果于 10 月 1 日发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: The material surrounding a star changes significantly over time. Young stars begin with a juvenile, gas-rich protoplanetary disk where forming planets can reside. As the system matures, that environment develops into a gas-poor debris disk.
paras.zh: 恒星周围的物质随着时间的推移发生显着变化。年轻的恒星始于一个年轻的、富含气体的原行星盘，形成的行星可以驻留在其中。随着系统的成熟，该环境会发展成为缺乏气体的碎片盘。

paras.en: During its years of operation, NASA's retired Spitzer Space Telescope studied these debris disks and identified an unusual category known as extreme debris disks. These systems contain exceptionally large amounts of warm dust close to their stars, roughly in the same region where rocky planets orbit in our own solar system.
paras.zh: 在多年的运行过程中，美国宇航局退役的斯皮策太空望远镜研究了这些碎片盘，并发现了一种不寻常的类别，称为极端碎片盘。这些系统在其恒星附近含有异常大量的温暖尘埃，大致位于我们太阳系中岩石行星绕轨道运行的同一区域。

paras.en: Kate Su of the Space Science Institute in Boulder, Colorado, led a team of astronomers that used Webb to investigate these unusual systems in greater detail.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州博尔德空间科学研究所的凯特·苏（Kate Su）领导了一个天文学家小组，利用韦伯对这些不寻常的系统进行了更详细的研究。

paras.en: Theoretical models suggest extreme debris disks should be relatively common, but observations tell a different story. Based on data gathered so far, scientists estimate that only about 1% of young stars display observable signs of this stage. Our own solar system may also have passed through such a phase while it was forming.
paras.zh: 理论模型表明极端碎片盘应该相对常见，但观察结果却讲述了不同的故事。根据迄今为止收集到的数据，科学家估计只有约 1% 的年轻恒星表现出可观测到的这一阶段的迹象。我们自己的太阳系在形成时也可能经历过这样的阶段。

paras.en: Even though these systems are uncommon, the researchers assembled a sample of 21 extreme debris disks. Five came from archival Spitzer observations, and 16 were studied with Webb. Of the Webb sample, 12 disks were newly observed, while four were follow-up observations of systems previously examined by Spitzer.
paras.zh: 尽管这些系统并不常见，研究人员还是组装了 21 个极端碎片盘的样本。其中 5 个来自斯皮策望远镜的观测档案，16 个是与韦伯一起研究的。在韦伯样本中，有 12 个圆盘是新观察到的，另外 4 个是对斯皮策先前检查过的系统进行的后续观察。

paras.en: "This is the first time we have gathered enough systems to truly understand this subclass that we call extreme debris disks," said Su, lead author of the paper. "Before Webb, we had limited information. We knew that they are weird and very different from the typical cold debris disks that we know, like Vega and Fomalhaut. Now that we have more data, we can pin down what these disks represent for planet formation and evolution."
paras.zh: 该论文的主要作者苏说：“这是我们第一次收集到足够的系统来真正了解这个我们称之为极端碎片盘的子类。” “在韦伯之前，我们掌握的信息有限。我们知道它们很奇怪，与我们所知道的典型冷碎片盘（如织女星和北落师门）非常不同。现在我们有了更多数据，我们可以确定这些盘对行星形成和演化的代表意义。”

paras.en: Dust Reveals the Nature of Planetary Collisions
paras.zh: 尘埃揭示了行星碰撞的本质

paras.en: The researchers confirmed that extreme debris disks have three defining characteristics. Their dust grains are smaller than those found in protoplanetary or more typical debris disks, they contain unusually high concentrations of warm dust, and their brightness changes irregularly over time. Webb and Spitzer revealed these features through mid-infrared spectra.
paras.zh: 研究人员证实，极端碎片盘具有三个定义特征。它们的尘埃颗粒比原行星或更典型的碎片盘中发现的尘埃颗粒更小，它们含有异常高浓度的温暖尘埃，并且它们的亮度随着时间的推移不规则地变化。韦伯和斯皮策通过中红外光谱揭示了这些特征。

paras.en: To understand what might be producing these unusual traits, the researchers examined the minerals present in the disks. Their analysis showed that the systems could be divided into two broad groups: silica-rich disks and silica-poor disks.
paras.zh: 为了了解可能产生这些不寻常特征的原因，研究人员检查了圆盘中存在的矿物质。他们的分析表明，这些系统可以分为两大类：富含二氧化硅的盘和缺乏二氧化硅的盘。

paras.en: On Earth, volcanic glass such as obsidian is an example of silica-rich material. The silica-poor mineral forsterite, meanwhile, can be seen as green sand grains on certain beaches in Hawaii.
paras.zh: 在地球上，黑曜石等火山玻璃是富含二氧化硅的材料的一个例子。与此同时，在夏威夷的某些海滩上，贫硅矿物镁橄榄石可以被视为绿色沙粒。

paras.en: Whether a disk is rich or poor in silica can reveal important information about the collision that created its debris. The distinction may also help explain why some of the disks fluctuate more dramatically in infrared brightness.
paras.zh: 圆盘中二氧化硅的含量是否丰富，可以揭示有关产生其碎片的碰撞的重要信息。这种区别也可能有助于解释为什么某些圆盘的红外亮度波动更剧烈。

paras.en: "To just see their mid-infrared emission and beautiful spectral features with Webb, which allowed us to identify their compositions, was the most exciting thing for me," said Agnes Kospal of Konkoly Observatory in Budapest, Hungary, and a coauthor of the study. "We have no other way to study these planetary embryos directly because they are too small."
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、匈牙利布达佩斯康科利天文台的艾格尼丝·科斯帕尔（Agnes Kospal）表示：“用韦伯望远镜观察它们的中红外发射和美丽的光谱特征，这使我们能够识别它们的成分，这对我来说是最令人兴奋的事情。” “我们没有其他方法来直接研究这些行星胚胎，因为它们太小了。”

paras.en: Mars-Sized Worlds May Be Smashing Together
paras.zh: 火星大小的世界可能正在粉碎在一起

paras.en: Roughly one-third of the disks in the sample are silica-rich. The researchers say these systems likely formed after extremely energetic collisions between Mars-sized bodies. Such impacts would be powerful enough to vaporize a substantial amount of rocky material.
paras.zh: 样本中大约三分之一的圆盘富含二氧化硅。研究人员表示，这些系统可能是在火星大小的天体之间发生极其剧烈的碰撞后形成的。这种撞击的威力足以使大量岩石物质蒸发。

paras.en: The other two-thirds are silica-poor. These systems appear to result from lower-energy collisions, including grazing impacts between Moon-sized objects.
paras.zh: 另外三分之二缺乏二氧化硅。这些系统似乎是低能量碰撞的结果，包括月球大小物体之间的掠过碰撞。

paras.en: The researchers also found an important age difference between the two groups. Silica-rich disks have only been identified around stars younger than 300 million years. Silica-poor disks, however, occur around stars spanning a much wider range of ages and tend to show stronger changes in brightness.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现两组之间存在重要的年龄差异。仅在年龄小于 3 亿年的恒星周围发现了富含二氧化硅的圆盘。然而，贫硅盘出现在年龄范围更广的恒星周围，并且往往表现出更强的亮度变化。

paras.en: The team suggests that this variability may come from the rapid evolution of newly created debris. Changes in the material's orbit, along with additional collisions, could cause the infrared brightness to rise and fall over time.
paras.zh: 研究小组认为，这种变化可能来自新产生的碎片的快速演化。材料轨道的变化以及额外的碰撞可能会导致红外亮度随着时间的推移而上升和下降。

paras.en: The findings may also help scientists reconstruct the history of our own solar system, which could have passed through more than one extreme debris disk phase.
paras.zh: 这些发现还可能帮助科学家重建我们太阳系的历史，太阳系可能经历了不止一个极端的碎片盘阶段。

paras.en: "How rocky planets formed and giant planets evolved are part of the broader story of the solar system's formation. It's all one story," said Su. "Our work on extreme debris disks helps us bring together the big picture of what we currently understand."
paras.zh: “岩石行星的形成和巨行星的演化是太阳系形成更广泛故事的一部分。这都是一个故事，”苏说。 “我们对极端碎片盘的研究有助于我们了解目前所了解的情况。”

paras.en: Clues to the Collision That Formed the Moon
paras.zh: 形成月球的碰撞的线索

paras.en: Computer simulations suggest terrestrial planets, including Earth, should emerge within the first few hundred million years after a solar system begins forming.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟表明，包括地球在内的类地行星应该在太阳系开始形成后的最初几亿年内出现。

paras.en: That timeline matches the ages of the silica-rich extreme debris disks observed so far. It is also consistent with estimates that Earth and the Moon formed roughly 100 million years after the Sun, with the Moon likely being the result of a collision between Earth and a Mars-sized object.
paras.zh: 该时间线与迄今为止观察到的富含二氧化硅的极端碎片盘的年龄相符。这也与地球和月球在太阳形成后大约一亿年的估计相一致，月球很可能是地球和火星大小的物体碰撞的结果。

paras.en: Scientists are also interested in whether the Sun may once have passed through a silica-poor extreme debris disk phase.
paras.zh: 科学家们还对太阳是否曾经经历过贫硅极端碎片盘阶段感兴趣。

paras.en: If the older silica-poor disks and their seemingly random periods of changing infrared brightness are caused by orbital instability, the pattern would be broadly compatible with the Late Heavy Bombardment hypothesis for our solar system.
paras.zh: 如果较旧的贫硅盘及其看似随机的红外亮度变化周期是由轨道不稳定引起的，那么这种模式将与我们太阳系的晚期重轰炸假说大致兼容。

paras.en: Under that scenario, the giant planets shifted significantly from their original positions. Their movement disturbed the orbits of smaller objects, setting off catastrophic collisions and producing brief periods filled with large amounts of dust, similar to what astronomers now observe in extreme debris disks.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，巨行星明显偏离了原来的位置。它们的运动扰乱了较小物体的轨道，引发了灾难性的碰撞，并产生了充满大量尘埃的短暂时期，类似于天文学家现在在极端碎片盘中观察到的情况。

paras.en: "Of course, there's many things we still don't know about these disks," said Attila Moor of Konkoly Observatory, a coauthor of the study. "We expect no silica-rich systems among older extreme debris disks. We only have three disks in our sample that fit that age criteria, so it'll be nice to observe more of these systems to confirm our hypothesis."
paras.zh: “当然，关于这些圆盘，我们还有很多事情不知道，”该研究的合著者、康科利天文台的阿蒂拉·摩尔说。 “我们预计在较古老的极端碎片盘中不会存在富含二氧化硅的系统。我们的样本中只有三个符合该年龄标准的盘，因此观察更多这些系统以证实我们的假设将是很好的。”

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope is the world's premier space science observatory. Webb is solving mysteries in our solar system, looking beyond to distant worlds around other stars, and probing the mysterious structures and origins of our universe and our place in it. Webb is an international program led by NASA with its partners, ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency).
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜是世界上首屈一指的太空科学天文台。韦伯正在解开太阳系中的谜团，展望其他恒星周围的遥远世界，并探索宇宙的神秘结构和起源以及我们在其中的位置。韦伯是由 NASA 及其合作伙伴 ESA（欧洲航天局）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）领导的一项国际计划。

articles.title: Rethinking risk with electronics for space
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Ken Stoler, the space business development lead for Arrow. They discuss how spacecraft designers and operators have changed their attitudes toward risk, how the move toward massive megaconstellations has started to impact purchasing behavior in the space supply chain and the challenges and constraints of adding more AI-enabling computing power to spacecraft.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Arrow 太空业务开发主管 Ken Stoler 进行了交谈。他们讨论了航天器设计者和运营商如何改变对风险的态度，向巨型星座的转变如何开始影响航天供应链中的购买行为，以及为航天器增加更多支持人工智能的计算能力的挑战和限制。

paras.en: Arrow Electronics is a Fortune 500-ranked distributor of electronic components and enterprise computing products that helps thousands of leading manufacturers and service providers turn technology ideas into market-ready solutions. From concept and design through sourcing, integration, manufacturing, and lifecycle management, Arrow comes alongside innovators with deep engineering expertise, comprehensive supply chain services and one of the industry’s most extensive product portfolios. Whether helping enable next-generation aerospace and defense systems, AI-driven applications, industrial automation, robotics platforms or connected devices, Arrow helps its customers accelerate innovation, solve complex design challenges, and bring mission-critical technologies to market faster.
paras.zh: Arrow Electronics 是财富 500 强电子元件和企业计算产品分销商，帮助数千家领先制造商和服务提供商将技术理念转化为市场就绪的解决方案。从概念和设计到采购、集成、制造和生命周期管理，Arrow 与拥有深厚工程专业知识、全面供应链服务和业界最广泛产品组合之一的创新者并肩作战。无论是帮助实现下一代航空航天和国防系统、人工智能驱动的应用、工业自动化、机器人平台还是互联设备，Arrow 都可以帮助客户加速创新、解决复杂的设计挑战，并更快地将关键任务技术推向市场。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join David Ariosto, Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 David Ariosto、Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！
