paras.en: It said more than 90% of the people who had been in contact with the victim had "completed medical observation" and "no health disorders associated with infectious pathology were detected".
paras.zh: 声明称，90%以上与受害者有过接触的人已经“完成了医学观察”，并且“没有发现与传染性病理学相关的健康问题”。

paras.en: Neighbouring Mongolia's government has ordered "health surveillance" measures on its border with Russia, AFP news agency reported. The country's health ministry said it would "maintain continuous surveillance and monitoring to prevent potential risks".
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，邻国蒙古政府已下令在其与俄罗斯的边境采取“健康监测”措施。该国卫生部表示将“保持持续监测和监测，以防止潜在风险”。

paras.en: This was a precautionary measure, it said, adding "the current risk level is low."
paras.zh: 它表示，这是一项预防措施，并补充说“目前的风险水平较低”。

paras.en: Lithuania's health ministry said it has made preparations to manage any possible case in the country.
paras.zh: 立陶宛卫生部表示，已做好准备应对该国任何可能出现的病例。

paras.en: Laboratory testing is available, patients would be isolated in infectious disease hospitals, contacts would be identified, and the country has the stocks of medicines suitable for treatment, according to Nerija Kaulakien, an adviser at the Ministry of Health's Communications Division, in an interview with ELTA news agency.
paras.zh: 卫生部通讯司顾问内里贾·考拉金 (Nerija Kaulakien) 在接受 ELTA 通讯社采访时表示，已经可以进行实验室检测，患者将被隔离在传染病医院，确定接触者，并且该国拥有适合治疗的药物库存。

paras.en: There was no evidence of "an increased risk of plague" at the moment, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，目前没有证据表明“鼠疫风险增加”。

paras.en: In the immediate wake of the laboratory worker's death, Russia's health watchdog had issued a statement saying the woman had died of "pneumonia of an undetermined etiology" and that testing found "no microorganisms related to her professional activities".
paras.zh: 实验室工作人员死亡后，俄罗斯卫生监督机构立即发表声明称，该妇女死于“病因不明的肺炎”，检测结果“没有发现与她的职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: However, after this announcement, a pro-government federal news outlet deleted five posts mentioning a possible plague case, and authorities in the town of Baikalsk deleted a message advising against travel to Shelekhov because of a possible plague infection.
paras.zh: 然而，在这一消息发布后，一家亲政府的联邦新闻媒体删除了五篇提到可能发生鼠疫病例的帖子，贝加尔斯克镇当局删除了一条建议不要前往谢列霍夫旅行的消息，因为可能感染鼠疫。

paras.en: Ongoing speculation into the lab worker's death has sparked a back and forth between Russia and the US, with questions about a possible spread outside of Russia.
paras.zh: 对这名实验室工作人员死亡的持续猜测引发了俄罗斯和美国之间的争论，人们质疑病毒是否可能传播到俄罗斯境外。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US had "measures" available to help Russia if the situation turned out to be more serious than claimed.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，如果情况比声称的更严重，美国可以采取“措施”帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: According to the WHO, pneumonic plague has a very short incubation period - sometimes just 24 hours - and can be fatal, if not diagnosed and treated early.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，肺鼠疫的潜伏期非常短，有时仅为 24 小时，如果不及早诊断和治疗，可能会致命。

paras.en: - contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials
paras.zh: - 接触体液或受污染的材料

paras.en: - the inhalation of respiratory particles
paras.zh: - 吸入呼吸道颗粒

paras.en: Symptoms include shortness of breath and coughing, often with blood-tainted phlegm.
paras.zh: 症状包括呼吸短促和咳嗽，常伴有带血的痰。

paras.en: The bacterium that causes the plague, Yersinia pestis, found among rodents such as marmots in the area.
paras.zh: 引起鼠疫的细菌是鼠疫耶尔森氏菌，在该地区的土拨鼠等啮齿动物中发现。

paras.en: It killed up to half the population of Europe in the 14th Century when it was known as the Black Death.
paras.zh: 它在 14 世纪杀死了欧洲一半的人口，当时它被称为黑死病。

paras.en: It was in response to an outbreak in the 1920s that the Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East, was founded just over 100 years ago.
paras.zh: 100 多年前，为了应对 20 年代的鼠疫疫情，西伯利亚和远东抗鼠疫研究所成立。

articles.title: Mpox is still spreading in the US — here's what to know about vaccines, symptoms and treatment
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Mpox is an infectious disease caused by a poxvirus, meaning a virus in the same family as smallpox. The infection was formerly known as monkeypox.
paras.zh: Mpox 是一种由痘病毒引起的传染病，痘病毒是与天花属于同一家族的病毒。这种感染以前被称为猴痘。

paras.en: Historically, mpox was endemic to Africa, and the virus consistently spread in the continent's central, eastern and western regions. In 2022, an unprecedented global outbreak spurred the widespread transmission of mpox in places that had seen only sporadic cases in the past.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，mpox是非洲的地方病，该病毒一直在非洲大陆的中部、东部和西部地区传播。 2022年，一场史无前例的全球疫情导致MPOX在过去仅出现零星病例的地区广泛传播。

paras.en: Today, many countries affected by that outbreak — including Germany, Portugal and the United States — are still contending with local mpox transmission. Here's what to know about the virus, how it spreads and how to prevent infection.
paras.zh: 如今，许多受此次疫情影响的国家——包括德国、葡萄牙和美国——仍在与当地的 MPOX 传播作斗争。以下是有关该病毒、其传播方式以及如何预防感染的信息。

paras.en: Mpox is still spreading at low levels in the United States and may soon be considered endemic to the country. While case counts have fallen dramatically since the peak of the global outbreak in summer 2022, some people are still advised to get vaccinated against the virus.
paras.zh: Mpox 在美国仍处于低水平传播，可能很快就会成为该国的地方病。尽管自 2022 年夏季全球疫情爆发高峰以来，病例数已大幅下降，但仍建议一些人接种该病毒疫苗。

paras.en: The mpox vaccine currently used in the U.S. is called JYNNEOS. One dose is about 35% to 86% effective, while the complete two-dose series is 66% to 90% effective. (The effectiveness varies, in part, because some studies include people with HIV and people without HIV, and inadequately treated HIV can undermine the body's response to vaccines.)
paras.zh: 美国目前使用的mpox疫苗称为JYNNEOS。一剂的有效率约为 35% 至 86%，而完整的两剂系列的有效率为 66% 至 90%。 （效果有所不同，部分原因是一些研究包括艾滋病毒感染者和未感染艾滋病毒的人，而治疗不当的艾滋病毒可能会破坏身体对疫苗的反应。）

paras.en: The JYNNEOS vaccine is not currently recommended for routine use in the general population because, beyond vulnerable groups, the risk is not high enough to warrant a universal vaccination strategy. The current outbreak is primarily affecting men who have sex with men, and those sexual networks are the primary targets for JYNNEOS vaccination.
paras.zh: 目前不建议在普通人群中常规使用 JYNNEOS 疫苗，因为除了弱势群体之外，风险还不够高，不足以保证采取普遍的疫苗接种策略。当前的疫情主要影响男男性行为者，而这些性网络是 JYNNEOS 疫苗接种的主要目标。

paras.en: However, not all men who have sex with men need to be vaccinated, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Instead, vaccination is recommended for a specific subset of the group, including those who, in the last six months, have had more than one sex partner, have had sex at commercial sex venues, or have been diagnosed with other sexually transmitted diseases.
paras.zh: 然而，根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的说法，并非所有男男性行为者都需要接种疫苗。相反，建议针对该群体的特定子集接种疫苗，包括在过去六个月内有过一个以上性伴侣、在商业性场所发生性行为或已被诊断患有其他性传播疾病的人。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Nonbinary and transgender people with these risk factors are also recommended to get two doses of JYNNEOS, as are any sexual partners of anyone in the above groups.
paras.zh: 还建议具有这些风险因素的非二元性别和跨性别者以及上述群体中任何人的性伴侣服用两剂 JYNNEOS。

paras.en: Vaccines are also recommended after a suspected exposure to mpox, as they can help prevent or reduce the severity of the infection.
paras.zh: 在怀疑接触过mpox后，也建议接种疫苗，因为它们可以帮助预防或减轻感染的严重程度。

paras.en: "For those who are eligible and have not yet completed vaccination, now is a good time to talk with a healthcare provider about getting protected," Dr. Demetre Daskalakis, chief medical officer of Callen-Lorde, an LGBTQ+ community health center in New York City, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 纽约市 LGBTQ+ 社区健康中心 Callen-Lorde 的首席医疗官 Demetre Daskalakis 博士在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“对于那些符合条件但尚未完成疫苗接种的人来说，现在是与医疗保健提供者讨论获得保护的好时机。”

paras.en: With the exception of laboratory researchers who work with mpox, people who have received two doses of JYNNEOS are fully vaccinated and do not need a booster, he said. And if a person has caught mpox in the past and recovered, they do not need to get a vaccine, he added.
paras.zh: 他说，除了从事 MPOX 工作的实验室研究人员之外，接受两剂 JYNNEOS 的人都已完全接种疫苗，不需要加强接种。他补充说，如果一个人过去感染过麻疹并且康复了，他们就不需要接种疫苗。

paras.en: The poxvirus family also includes smallpox, which has been eradicated worldwide. Mpox and smallpox cause some similar symptoms, but mpox tends to be far milder than smallpox. However, the viruses are closely related enough that vaccines designed to prevent smallpox can also protect against mpox.
paras.zh: 痘病毒家族还包括天花，天花已在世界范围内被消灭。痘痘和天花会引起一些相似的症状，但痘痘往往比天花温和得多。然而，这些病毒密切相关，旨在预防天花的疫苗也可以预防天花。

paras.en: Mpox was initially named monkeypox because the virus behind the disease was discovered in captive monkeys in Denmark. But monkeys are not the main hosts of the virus in the wild; rodents and small mammals mostly found in West and Central Africa likely are. Health officials changed the name to mpox in 2022.
paras.zh: Mpox 最初被命名为猴痘，因为这种疾病背后的病毒是在丹麦圈养的猴子身上发现的。但猴子并不是该病毒在野外的主要宿主。主要发现于西非和中非的啮齿动物和小型哺乳动物很可能是这样。卫生官员于 2022 年将其名称更改为 MPOX。

paras.en: There are two major branches of the mpox family tree, called clade I and clade II. These clades were historically thought to have very different death rates, with clade I being the deadlier of the two. The case-fatality rate (CFR) of clade I has been estimated to range from 1.4% to over 10%, depending on the outbreak, while the CFR for clade II has been estimated at between 0.1% and 3.6%.
paras.zh: MPOX 家族树有两个主要分支，称为进化枝 I 和进化枝 II。历史上人们认为这些进化枝具有非常不同的死亡率，其中进化枝 I 是两者中最致命的。根据疫情的不同，分支 I 的病死率 (CFR) 估计为 1.4% 至 10% 以上，而分支 II 的病死率估计为 0.1% 至 3.6% 之间。

paras.en: However, as both clades have spread beyond Africa, data suggests that the CFR for clade I may be lower than once thought, said Joel Wertheim, a professor of medicine in the Division of Infectious Diseases and Global Public Health at the University of California, San Diego.
paras.zh: 然而，由于这两个分支已传播到非洲以外的地区，数据表明分支 I 的病死率可能比以前想象的要低，加州大学圣地亚哥分校传染病和全球公共卫生部门的医学教授乔尔·沃特海姆 (Joel Wertheim) 说。

paras.en: The features of a given outbreak — such as the surrounding health infrastructure, patients' access to timely medical care, and the population's underlying risk factors for severe disease — likely play a big role in determining the virus's death toll, Wertheim told Live Science. In short, rather than being an immutable feature of the virus itself, the CFR is dependent on the underlying health of and resources available to a given population.
paras.zh: 沃特海姆告诉《生活科学》，特定疫情的特征——例如周围的卫生基础设施、患者及时获得医疗护理的情况以及人群患严重疾病的潜在风险因素——可能在决定病毒死亡人数方面发挥着重要作用。简而言之，病死率并非是病毒本身不可改变的特征，而是取决于特定人群的基本健康状况和可用资源。

paras.en: Mpox can spread from infected animals to humans through the animals' bites or scratches. Additionally, people can get the virus when they come into close contact with animals and/or their bodily fluids during hunting, skinning, trapping, cooking, eating animals or handling carcasses, the World Health Organization (WHO) notes.
paras.zh: Mpox 可以通过动物的咬伤或抓伤从受感染的动物传播给人类。此外，世界卫生组织（WHO）指出，人们在狩猎、剥皮、诱捕、烹饪、食用动物或处理动物尸体时与动物和/或其体液密切接触时也可能感染病毒。

paras.en: The virus also spreads from person to person, primarily through very close contact, including intimate contact during sex. The virus typically enters the body through broken skin, the respiratory tract or mucous membranes (thin tissues found in the eyes, nose, mouth, anus and genitals), spreading via bodily fluids such as spit, mucus or blood. People can also pick up the virus via objects, such as clothing or linen, that are contaminated with the bodily fluids of an infected person.
paras.zh: 该病毒还可以在人与人之间传播，主要通过非常密切的接触，包括性行为期间的亲密接触。该病毒通常通过破损的皮肤、呼吸道或粘膜（眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、肛门和生殖器中的薄组织）进入人体，通过唾液、粘液或血液等体液传播。人们还可以通过被感染者体液污染的物体（例如衣服或亚麻制品）感染病毒。

paras.en: The virus can spread through small respiratory droplets expelled during speaking or breathing. However, this is thought to be a less-common transmission route than close contact. There is also evidence that asymptomatic spread sometimes occurs, though it's unclear how frequently that happens.
paras.zh: 该病毒可以通过说话或呼吸时排出的小呼吸道飞沫传播。然而，与密切接触相比，这被认为是一种不太常见的传播途径。还有证据表明，有时会发生无症状传播，但尚不清楚这种情况发生的频率。

paras.en: Mpox can spread from mother to baby during pregnancy or birth. This route of infection can result in pregnancy loss, stillbirth, death of the newborn, or complications for the mother.
paras.zh: Mpox 可以在怀孕或分娩期间从母亲传播给婴儿。这种感染途径可能导致流产、死产、新生儿死亡或母亲出现并发症。

paras.en: These images of mpox rashes depict how the lesions can look on different skin tones. (The images were shared by the CDC prior to the infection's name being changed.)
paras.zh: 这些MPOX皮疹的图像描绘了不同肤色下皮损的外观。 （这些图像是在感染名称更改之前由 CDC 共享的。）

paras.en: Symptoms of mpox typically appear within a week of a person being exposed to the virus, but they can sometimes take up to 21 days to develop. Once they emerge, symptoms last about two to four weeks, although the illness can linger longer in people with weakened immune systems.
paras.zh: mpox 的症状通常会在人接触病毒后一周内出现，但有时可能需要长达 21 天的时间才能出现。一旦出现，症状会持续约两到四个星期，但在免疫系统较弱的人中，这种疾病可能会持续更长时间。

paras.en: Common symptoms include rash (see images), fever, sore throat, headache, muscle aches, back pain, swollen lymph nodes and low energy. Often, mpox rashes first appear on the face and then spread to other parts of the body; however, if a person becomes infected during sex, the rash may instead start around their genitals. The rashes begin as flat, discolored patches of skin and then progress into raised bumps, blisters, and large, pus-filled pimples that eventually scab over and fall off.
paras.zh: 常见症状包括皮疹（见图）、发烧、喉咙痛、头痛、肌肉酸痛、背痛、淋巴结肿大和精力不足。通常，痘痘皮疹首先出现在面部，然后扩散到身体的其他部位；然而，如果一个人在性行为中被感染，皮疹可能会从生殖器周围开始。皮疹开始时是扁平、变色的皮肤斑块，然后发展成凸起的肿块、水泡和大的、充满脓液的丘疹，最终结痂并脱落。

paras.en: Some people with mpox develop painful swelling of the rectum (proctitis), while others have pain and difficulty when peeing (dysuria) or when swallowing.
paras.zh: 有些患有MPOX的人会出现直肠疼痛性肿胀（直肠炎），而另一些人则在小便（排尿困难）或吞咽时感到疼痛和困难。

paras.en: Mpox rashes can make people vulnerable to bacterial skin infections, which can cause abscesses or other serious skin damage. Additional complications of the illness include pneumonia, infection of the cornea that can cause vision loss, and vomiting and diarrhea that causes dehydration or malnutrition. Mpox can also lead to blood infections, the intense immune reaction sepsis and, rarely, brain infections (encephalitis) or heart inflammation (myocarditis).
paras.zh: 痘痘皮疹会使人容易受到细菌性皮肤感染，从而导致脓肿或其他严重的皮肤损伤。该疾病的其他并发症包括肺炎、可能导致视力丧失的角膜感染以及导致脱水或营养不良的呕吐和腹泻。 Mpox 还可导致血液感染、强烈的免疫反应败血症，以及罕见的脑部感染（脑炎）或心脏炎症（心肌炎）。

paras.en: Children, pregnant people, and people with weakened immune systems, including from HIV infection, have a higher risk of serious illness and death from mpox.
paras.zh: 儿童、孕妇和免疫系统较弱的人（包括艾滋病毒感染者）患严重疾病和死于MPOX的风险较高。

paras.en: Beyond vaccination, other strategies to decrease the risk of mpox infection include washing hands frequently, avoiding contact with contaminated objects and materials used by people with mpox, avoiding contact with other people's scabs or rashes, and using condoms, although they may only reduce, not eliminate, the risk of mpox exposure during sex.
paras.zh: 除了疫苗接种外，降低MPOX感染风险的其他策略包括经常洗手、避免接触MPOX患者使用过的受污染物体和材料、避免接触他人的结痂或皮疹以及使用避孕套，尽管它们只能降低而不是消除性行为中MPOX暴露的风险。

paras.en: Mpox treatment aims to manage a person's rashes and pain while also preventing complications. "Early and supportive care is important to help manage symptoms and avoid further problems," according to the WHO.
paras.zh: Mpox 治疗旨在控制皮疹和疼痛，同时预防并发症。世界卫生组织表示，“早期支持性护理对于帮助控制症状和避免进一步的问题非常重要”。

paras.en: There is no antiviral drug approved for use in mpox, although some are available for emergency use in various countries. For example, the U.S. allows the use of certain smallpox medicines for mpox.
paras.zh: 目前还没有批准用于治疗 MPOX 的抗病毒药物，尽管一些国家有一些可供紧急使用。例如，美国允许使用某些天花药物来治疗痘痘。

paras.en: Severe mpox infections also may be treated with vaccinia immune globulin intravenous, which contains antibodies taken from the blood of people who were immunized against smallpox.
paras.zh: 严重的mpox感染也可以通过静脉注射痘苗免疫球蛋白来治疗，其中含有从天花免疫接种者血液中提取的抗体。

paras.en: People who have recently been exposed to mpox can be given an mpox vaccine to reduce the severity of their symptoms or to prevent the illness altogether. This approach is known as post-exposure prophylaxis, or PEP.
paras.zh: 最近接触过 MPOX 的人可以接种 MPOX 疫苗，以减轻症状的严重程度或完全预防疾病。这种方法称为暴露后预防 (PEP)。

paras.en: "Post-exposure vaccine should be given as soon as possible, ideally within 4 days of exposure; administration 4 through 14 days after exposure may still provide some protection against monkeypox," the CDC states.
paras.zh: CDC 指出：“暴露后疫苗应尽快接种，最好在暴露后 4 天内接种；暴露后 4 至 14 天接种仍可提供一定程度的预防猴痘的保护作用。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: Lost 'heart' of the Colorado River shines like a silver serpent in Utah
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Lake Powell, Utah [37.47537121, -110.70474226]
What's in the photo? A "sunglint" transforming a reservoir into a giant silver river
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？ “sunglint”将水库变成一条巨大的银色河流

paras.en: Who took the photo? An unnamed astronaut on board the International Space Station
paras.zh: 照片是谁拍的？国际空间站上的一名未透露姓名的宇航员

paras.en: This eye-catching astronaut photo mosaic shows a rare "sunglint" transforming a snaking reservoir into a giant silver river.
paras.zh: 这张引人注目的宇航员马赛克照片展示了罕见的“sunglint”将蜿蜒的水库变成了一条巨大的银色河流。

paras.en: The winding waterway at the heart of this image is a section of Lake Powell in southern Utah. The artifical reservoir starts around 70 miles (110 kilometers) southwest of the town of Moab and ends roughly 60 miles (100 km) northeast of the Grand Canyon in Arizona. When full, Lake Powell holds up to 1.2 billion cubic feet (33.3 million cubic meters) of water, making it the second-largest reservoir in the U.S. — close behind the nearby Lake Mead, which stretches across the Arizona-Nevada border.
paras.zh: 该图像中心的蜿蜒水道是犹他州南部鲍威尔湖的一部分。 The artifical reservoir starts around 70 miles (110 kilometers) southwest of the town of Moab and ends roughly 60 miles (100 km) northeast of the Grand Canyon in Arizona. When full, Lake Powell holds up to 1.2 billion cubic feet (33.3 million cubic meters) of water, making it the second-largest reservoir in the U.S. — close behind the nearby Lake Mead, which stretches across the Arizona-Nevada border.

paras.en: Lake Powell is located on the Colorado River, inside a steep ravine known as Glen Canyon. The reservoir emerged in the 1960s, following the construction of the Glen Canyon Dam, which caused water levels to rise by around 200 feet (60 meters) over the next two decades. In addition to generating hydroelectric power, the artificial lake has become a popular tourist destination. (Lake Mead is also located along the Colorado River and was created by the construction of the Hoover Dam.)
paras.zh: 鲍威尔湖位于科罗拉多河沿岸，位于被称为格伦峡谷的陡峭峡谷内。该水库于 20 世纪 60 年代格伦峡谷大坝建成后出现，导致水位在接下来的二十年里上升了约 200 英尺（60 米）。除了产生水力发电外，人工湖还成为一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。 （米德湖也位于科罗拉多河沿岸，是由胡佛水坝的建设而形成的。）

paras.en: This image mosaic, which stitches together several astronaut photos into a single image, was captured during a sunglint, according to NASA's Earth Observatory. This phenomenon occurs when sunlight bounces off a reflective surface directly into the line of sight of an observer in orbit, such as a satellite or an astronaut, giving the object a metallic, mirror-like gleam.
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局地球观测站称，这张马赛克图像将多张宇航员照片拼接成一张图像，是在阳光照射期间拍摄的。当阳光从反射表面直接反射到轨道上的观察者（例如卫星或宇航员）的视线时，就会发生这种现象，使物体发出金属般的镜面光泽。

paras.en: Normally, this effect would be visible only across a small section of the lake. But by combining photos taken as the sunglint moved along the reservoir's length, the entire body of water was illuminated.
paras.zh: 通常情况下，这种效应只能在湖的一小部分区域看到。但通过结合阳光沿着水库长度移动时拍摄的照片，整个水体都被照亮了。

paras.en: The reservoir is named after John Wesley Powell, an explorer and former director of the U.S. Geological Survey, who mapped out Glen Canyon and other parts of the Colorado River in the late 1860s. Powell was particularly captivated by Glen Canyon, which contained a "labyrinth of overhanging cliffs, hanging gardens, sweeping river bends, and natural arches set amidst a backdrop of colorful buttes and mesas," Earth Observatory representatives wrote.
paras.zh: 该水库以探险家、美国地质调查局前局长约翰·韦斯利·鲍威尔 (John Wesley Powell) 的名字命名，他在 1860 年代末绘制了格伦峡谷和科罗拉多河其他部分的地图。鲍威尔对格伦峡谷尤其着迷，地球观测站的代表写道，峡谷中“有一个由悬垂的悬崖、空中花园、宽阔的河湾和自然拱门组成的迷宫，背景是色彩缤纷的山丘和台地”。

paras.en: Powell later described his recollections of the canyon. "Past these towering monuments, past these mounded billows of orange sandstone, past these oak-set glens, past these fern-decked alcoves, past these mural curves, we glide hour after hour, stopping now and then, as our attention is arrested by some new wonder," Powell wrote in his 1875 book "Canyons of the Colorado."
paras.zh: 鲍威尔后来描述了他对峡谷的回忆。鲍威尔在 1875 年出版的《科罗拉多峡谷》一书中写道：“经过这些高耸的纪念碑，经过这些堆积如山的橙色砂岩，经过这些橡树丛生的峡谷，经过这些长满蕨类植物的壁龛，经过这些壁画曲线，我们滑行了一小时又一小时，时不时停下来，因为我们的注意力被一些新奇观吸引了。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Some of the sights that Powell marveled over still exist, including many smaller canyons that branch off the reservoir and are cast in deep shadow. A similar effect is seen in sections of Utah's Green River, a tributary of the Colorado River that has long perplexed geologists due to its ability to flow "uphill."
paras.zh: 鲍威尔惊叹的一些景点仍然存在，包括许多从水库分支出来并投在深深阴影中的较小峡谷。犹他州格林河的部分地区也出现了类似的现象，格林河是科罗拉多河的支流，由于其“上坡”流动的能力，长期以来一直困扰着地质学家。

paras.en: From above, one of the canyon's most striking geological features — a large, doughnut-shaped depression known as The Rincon — is visible as a dark ring surrounding a bend along one of the widest sections of the lake. This rusty doughnut, which is up to 3 miles (5 km) across, is a former section of the Colorado River that dried out thousands of years ago when part of the canyon collapsed, enabling water to bypass the rocky loop.
paras.zh: 从上方俯瞰，可以看到峡谷最引人注目的地质特征之一——一个被称为“林孔”的巨大的甜甜圈形状的凹陷——沿着湖最宽的部分之一，可以看到一个黑色的环围绕着一个弯道。这个生锈的甜甜圈直径达 3 英里（5 公里），是科罗拉多河的前一段，数千年前，由于部分峡谷塌陷，水流绕过岩石环路，该河段干涸。

paras.en: However, many of the other wonders that Powell described have been lost beneath the reservoir's elevated water level. These include a side canyon dubbed the Music Temple, which was shaped in a way that gave it remarkable acoustic properties, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 然而，鲍威尔描述的许多其他奇迹已经在水库升高的水位之下消失了。据地球观测站称，其中包括一个被称为“音乐圣殿”的侧峡谷，其形状使其具有非凡的声学特性。

paras.en: During periods of drought, when the reservoir's water levels temporarily drop, other lost geological treasures can be exposed. For example, in 2023, researchers found rare fossils from a mammal-like Jurassic creature lurking beneath the lake's high-water line.
paras.zh: 在干旱期间，当水库水位暂时下降时，其他丢失的地质宝藏可能会暴露出来。例如，2023 年，研究人员在湖水高水位线下方发现了一种类似哺乳动物的侏罗纪生物的稀有化石。

paras.en: In recent years, some environmental groups have petitioned to drain Lake Powell and return Glen Canyon to its former glory as the "heart of the Colorado River," according to Newsweek. Such a change may help to alleviate pressure on the rest of the river, which has lost a significant amount of water in recent decades. But experts told Newsweek that this is unlikely to happen.
paras.zh: 据《新闻周刊》报道，近年来，一些环保组织请求排干鲍威尔湖，让格伦峡谷恢复昔日“科罗拉多河心脏”的辉煌。这样的变化可能有助于减轻河流其他部分的压力，近几十年来，河流已经流失了大量的水。但专家告诉《新闻周刊》，这种情况不太可能发生。

paras.en: A 2020 astronaut photo shows the unusual point where two contrastingly colored Patagonian lakes meet. The duo was originally a single body of water but was split by a narrow land bridge.
paras.zh: 一张 2020 年宇航员的照片显示了两个颜色对比鲜明的巴塔哥尼亚湖泊交汇处的不寻常点。这两个水域原本是一个水域，但被一座狭窄的陆桥分开。

paras.en: A 2024 astronaut photo shows the icy surface of Pangong Lake breaking apart in the lofty Tibetan Plateau. The point where the ice meets the water almost perfectly matches a disputed border between China and India.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年宇航员拍摄的照片显示，班公湖的冰面在高耸的青藏高原上破裂。冰与水的交汇点几乎完美地符合中国和印度之间有争议的边界。

paras.en: A 2024 satellite photo shows a series of ephemeral lakes that merged into a single emerald structure in Australia's Northern Territory following two years of extreme rainfall.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年的卫星照片显示，在经历了两年的极端降雨之后，澳大利亚北领地的一系列短暂湖泊合并成一个翠绿的结构。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。

articles.title: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days 2026: Best stargazing deals on telescopes and binoculars
articles.author: Kimberley Lane

paras.en: Amazon Big Deal Days is back, and we've found some tempting deals on our favorite stargazing equipment at Amazon. For the next two days (Tuesday, Oct. 6 and Wednesday, October 7, 2026), we'll be keeping our eyes on the sales so you can keep your eyes on the skies.
paras.zh: 亚马逊大优惠日又回来了，我们在亚马逊上发现了一些我们最喜欢的观星设备的诱人优惠。在接下来的两天（2026 年 10 月 6 日星期二和 10 月 7 日星期三），我们将密切关注销售情况，以便您可以密切关注天空。

paras.en: Fall is a fantastic time to stargaze, with meteor showers, full moons, constellations and planetary oppositions — some of which you can only see with binoculars or a telescope. Shop the best deals on telescopes and binoculars below.
paras.zh: 秋天是观星的绝佳时机，有流星雨、满月、星座和行星对立——其中一些只能用双筒望远镜或天文望远镜才能看到。在下面购买望远镜和双筒望远镜的超值优惠。

paras.en: If you want a small, easy-to-use smart telescope with minimal investment, you can save $99 on the ZWO Seestar S30.
paras.zh: 如果您想要一台小型、易于使用的智能望远镜，并且投资最少，那么购买 ZWO Seestar S30 可以节省 99 美元。

paras.en: These small smart telescopes are ideal for deep-sky astrophotography, particularly for large nebulas and galaxies like the North America Nebula and the Andromeda Galaxy. They're an easy introduction to astrophotography, and you can also photograph the Moon and Sun, too.
paras.zh: 这些小型智能望远镜非常适合深空天文摄影，特别是北美星云和仙女座星系等大型星云和星系。它们是天文摄影的简单入门，您还可以拍摄月亮和太阳。

paras.en: Although we haven't reviewed this exact model, you can read our review of the S30 Pro, which we named the best portable smart telescope.
paras.zh: 虽然我们还没有评测过这个确切的型号，但您可以阅读我们对 S30 Pro 的评测，我们将其称为最佳便携式智能望远镜。

paras.en: If you want a portable smart telescope that excels at wide-angle shooting, the Dwarf Mini is the ideal choice, and you can save $59 right now at Amazon.
paras.zh: 如果您想要一款擅长广角拍摄的便携式智能望远镜，Dwarf Mini 是理想的选择，现在您可以在亚马逊节省 59 美元。

paras.en: Its portability is the killer feature here, as it's around half the weight of the Seestar S30 we mentioned above. Plus, the wide-angle camera is much wider, making it better for Milky Way landscapes, constellations and bigger portions of the sky.
paras.zh: 它的便携性是这里的杀手锏，因为它的重量约为我们上面提到的 Seestar S30 的一半。此外，广角相机更宽，更适合拍摄银河系景观、星座和更大的天空部分。

paras.en: Read our full Dwarflab Dwarf Mini review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的 Dwarflab Dwarf Mini 评论

paras.en: This small, portable Celestron telescope is ideal for beginners and younger users who want a closer look at the Moon and planets.
paras.zh: 这款小型便携式星特朗望远镜非常适合想要近距离观察月球和行星的初学者和年轻用户。

paras.en: Not to be confused with the Celestron AstroMaster LT 70AZ, which is smaller and gives you a slightly wider view. The standard AstroMaster 70AZ, which is on offer here, has a longer focal length, which is better suited to spotting planets, particularly Jupiter and Saturn. This telescope usually sits around $179, and this is the cheapest we've seen it since June.
paras.zh: 不要与星特朗 AstroMaster LT 70AZ 混淆，后者更小，视野稍宽。这里提供的标准 AstroMaster 70AZ 具有更长的焦距，更适合发现行星，特别是木星和土星。这台望远镜的价格通常约为 179 美元，这是自 6 月份以来我们见过的最便宜的价格。

paras.en: The Celestron StarSense range is really useful for total beginners, as the smartphone dock and accompanying app work out where the telescope is pointing, then show arrows on the screen to guide you towards certain objects.
paras.zh: 星特朗 StarSense 系列对于初学者来说非常有用，因为智能手机底座和随附的应用程序会计算出望远镜指向的位置，然后在屏幕上显示箭头以引导您走向某些物体。

paras.en: So, rather than "Here's a telescope, good luck finding Jupiter", the StarSense is much more "Here's what's visible tonight. Pick something, and I'll show you where it is".
paras.zh: 因此，StarSense 与其说是“这是一架望远镜，祝你好运找到木星”，不如说是“这是今晚可见的东西。选择一些东西，我会告诉你它在哪里”。

paras.en: If you can afford to stretch your budget, this is a better option than the AstroMaster 70LT we listed above. It has better light-gathering capabilities thanks to the wider aperture; it's a lighter package overall and it includes a 2x Barlow lens.
paras.zh: 如果您有足够的预算，这是比我们上面列出的 AstroMaster 70LT 更好的选择。由于光圈更大，因此具有更好的聚光能力；总体而言，它是一个更轻的包装，并且包含一个 2x Barlow 镜头。

paras.en: We've not reviewed the 80mm aperture model, but we do have a full Celestron StarSense Explorer LT 70AZ review.
paras.zh: 我们还没有评测过 80mm 光圈型号，但我们确实有完整的星特朗 StarSense Explorer LT 70AZ 评测。

paras.en: If you're looking for more of an intermediate-level telescope, the Celestron AstroMaster 130EQ-MD is a great option, and you can save $58 right now.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找更多的中级望远镜，星特朗 AstroMaster 130EQ-MD 是一个不错的选择，您现在可以节省 58 美元。

paras.en: The EQ mount has a bit of a learning curve, but once you've got it set up, it's a much more accurate way of tracking objects across the night sky. Plus, this version comes with a motor drive, so there's no manual adjusting needed.
paras.zh: EQ 安装座有一定的学习曲线，但一旦设置完毕，它就是一种更准确地跟踪夜空中物体的方法。另外，该版本配有电机驱动，因此无需手动调节。

paras.en: The 130mm aperture is great for viewing brighter deep-sky objects, and the moon looks beautiful, as do Jupiter and Saturn.
paras.zh: 130 毫米光圈非常适合观看更明亮的深空天体，月亮、木星和土星看起来都很美丽。

paras.en: If you like the intelligence of a smart telescope but want an observational telescope, a GoTo is the perfect combination. Once the telescope is aligned, you use the handset to select a celestial object from the list, and the telescope automatically orients itself toward your chosen object.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢智能望远镜的智能性，但想要一台观测望远镜，GoTo 是完美的组合。望远镜对准后，您可以使用手机从列表中选择一个天体，望远镜会自动将其朝向您选择的天体。

paras.en: This telescope has a 102mm aperture, which is excellent for observing larger deep-sky objects, the moon, and planets. It's user-friendly without feeling too much like a beginner telescope, and it's an excellent price.
paras.zh: 该望远镜的口径为 102 毫米，非常适合观测较大的深空天体、月球和行星。它用户友好，不会感觉太像初学者望远镜，而且价格也很优惠。

paras.en: These massive, powerful astronomy binoculars are the closest thing to a telescope that isn't actually a telescope. With 25x magnification and 100mm objective lens diameter, they're perfect for getting detailed views of the moon and night sky.
paras.zh: 这些巨大而强大的天文双筒望远镜是最接近望远镜的东西，但实际上并不是望远镜。它们具有 25 倍放大倍率和 100 毫米物镜直径，非常适合获取月亮和夜空的详细视图。

paras.en: Be warned, they're very big and very heavy, so you'll need to mount them on a tripod. They're for dedicated astronomy users, so if you want something lightweight and portable, check out some of the other options in this guide.
paras.zh: 请注意，它们非常大且非常重，因此您需要将它们安装在三脚架上。它们适用于专门的天文学用户，因此如果您想要轻巧便携的东西，请查看本指南中的一些其他选项。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron SkyMaster 25x100 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 SkyMaster 25x100 评论

paras.en: If you're looking for astronomy binoculars on a budget, these 12x60s from Celestron are ideal. They're a little big to use handheld, but they'll give you great views of the moon and stars, and you'll be able to spot Jupiter's moons.
paras.zh: 如果您正在寻找预算有限的天文双筒望远镜，星特朗的这些 12x60 双筒望远镜是您的理想选择。它们对于手持使用来说有点大，但它们可以让你看到月亮和星星的美景，而且你还可以发现木星的卫星。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron SkyMaster 12x60 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 SkyMaster 12x60 评论

paras.en: Binoculars with viewing power and excellent optical quality. These binoculars have ED glass to eliminate chromatic aberration, which is particularly useful when viewing the moon. They're more of an investment than non-ED glass, but they're worth every cent and will last a long time.
paras.zh: 具有可视能力和出色光学质量的双筒望远镜。这些双筒望远镜采用 ED 玻璃来消除色差，这在观看月球时特别有用。与非 ED 玻璃相比，它们更像是一种投资，但它们物有所值，并且可以使用很长时间。

paras.en: We've not reviewed this exact variant, but we have a full review of the smaller Celestron Nature DX ED 10x42.
paras.zh: 我们还没有审查过这个确切的变体，但我们对较小的星特朗 Nature DX ED 10x42 进行了全面审查。

paras.en: The Celestron Regal ED 10x42 is one of the best multi-use binoculars we've tested. The ED glass and field-flattening technology produce clear, sharp views across the entire frame, and the 10x42 spec is good for spotting wildlife and sweeping across the sky to get a closer look at the moon and stars.
paras.zh: Celestron Regal ED 10x42 是我们测试过的最好的多用途双筒望远镜之一。 ED 玻璃和视场平坦技术可在整个画面上产生清晰锐利的视野，10x42 规格非常适合发现野生动物和扫过天空以近距离观察月亮和星星。

paras.en: Read our full Celestron Regal ED 10x42 review
paras.zh: 阅读我们完整的星特朗 Regal ED 10x42 评论

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Kimberley Lane, E-commerce writer for Live Science, has tested a wide range of optical equipment, reviewing camera gear from Sony, Canon, OM System and more. With over 6 years of photography experience, her skills span across landscape and seascape photography, wildlife, astrophotography and portrait work. Her photos have been featured in a number of national magazines, including Digital Camera World and Cosmopolitan. She has also contributed to our sister site Space.com and Tech Radar, and she regularly uses binoculars and telescopes to stargaze in the dark skies of South Wales.
paras.zh: Live Science 的电子商务撰稿人 Kimberley Lane 测试了多种光学设备，评测了索尼、佳能、OM System 等公司的相机设备。她拥有超过 6 年的摄影经验，技能涵盖风景和海景摄影、野生动物、天文摄影和肖像作品。她的照片曾出现在许多国家杂志上，包括《数码相机世界》和《Cosmopolitan》。她还为我们的姊妹网站 Space.com 和 Tech Radar 做出了贡献，她经常使用双筒望远镜和天文望远镜在南威尔士的黑暗天空中观察星空。
