articles.title: Could 2026 Be a Year With No Atlantic Hurricanes? We've Surprisingly Passed Their Peak Month Without Any, Thanks to the El Niño

paras.en: Hurricanes usually wreak havoc in the Atlantic Ocean from June through November. But four months into this year’s season, we haven’t seen a storm escalate into a hurricane—and may not at all. That’s likely thanks to the “super” El Niño, which seems to be suppressing cyclones in the Atlantic while fueling them in the Pacific Ocean.
paras.zh: 飓风通常在六月到十一月期间对大西洋造成严重破坏。但今年季节已经过去四个月了，我们还没有看到风暴升级为飓风——而且可能根本没有。这可能要归功于“超级”厄尔尼诺现象，它似乎抑制了大西洋的气旋，同时又助长了太平洋的气旋。

paras.en: “No hurricanes through September is unprecedented in the modern record, and it’s a little surreal to look at the maps every day this month and see the deep tropics basically shut off,” says Michael Lowry, a meteorologist and hurricane specialist with WPLG-TV, to Andrea Thompson at Scientific American.
paras.zh: WPLG-TV 的气象学家兼飓风专家迈克尔·劳里 (Michael Lowry) 对《科学美国人》的安德里亚·汤普森 (Andrea Thompson) 表示：“整个 9 月都没有出现飓风，这在现代记录中是史无前例的，这个月每天查看地图，看到深热带地区基本被封锁，这有点超现实。”

paras.en: A hurricane-free September is surprising because the 10th of the month is statistically the peak of Atlantic hurricane season. This marks the first time in more than 30 years that the month has passed without one of these powerful storms. According to modern records stretching back to 1950, they have occurred only in 1994, 1972 and 1962, Phil Klotzbach, a hurricane expert at Colorado State University, tells Chris Dolce at CNN.
paras.zh: 9 月没有飓风令人惊讶，因为据统计，该月 10 日是大西洋飓风季节的高峰期。这是 30 多年来第一次没有发生如此强大风暴的月份。科罗拉多州立大学的飓风专家 Phil Klotzbach 告诉 CNN 的 Chris Dolce，根据可追溯到 1950 年的现代记录，这些飓风仅在 1994 年、1972 年和 1962 年发生过。

paras.en: In recent decades, each Atlantic hurricane season has averaged seven of these storms. Just two documented seasons—1914 and 1907—went by without any. However, experts note that early weather records are unreliable given the lack of monitoring via satellites or aircraft at the time. Weather watchers could have missed hurricanes in more remote parts of the ocean.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，每个大西洋飓风季节平均有七次此类风暴。只有两个有记录的季节——1914 年和 1907 年——却没有任何进展。然而，专家指出，由于当时缺乏卫星或飞机的监测，早期的天气记录并不可靠。天气观察者可能会错过海洋更偏远地区的飓风。

paras.en: So, what does the growing El Niño have to do with all of this?
paras.zh: 那么，日益严重的厄尔尼诺现象与这一切有什么关系呢？

paras.en: “We are headed toward what will almost certainly be the strongest El Niño on record,” explains Brian McNoldy, a hurricane researcher at the University of Miami, to Ava Berger at NPR. “It has exceeded expectations” in both the Pacific and the Atlantic oceans.
paras.zh: 迈阿密大学飓风研​​究员布莱恩·麦克诺迪 (Brian McNoldy) 向美国公共广播电台 (NPR) 的艾娃·伯杰 (Ava Berger) 解释道：“我们几乎肯定会迎来有记录以来最强烈的厄尔尼诺现象。”太平洋和大西洋都“超出了预期”。

paras.en: The natural, cyclical climate pattern warms ocean waters in the Pacific, which in turn impacts the global climate in myriad ways. In the North Atlantic, it typically increases wind shear—changes in wind speed or direction in the atmosphere. These winds rip apart storms, stopping them from growing into hurricanes. Since this summer, the shear has been record-strong over parts of the Atlantic where hurricanes often form, Klotzbach tells CNN.
paras.zh: 自然的周期性气候模式使太平洋海水变暖，进而以多种方式影响全球气候。在北大西洋，它通常会增加风切变——大气中风速或风向的变化。这些风会撕裂风暴，阻止它们发展成飓风。克洛茨巴赫告诉美国有线电视新闻网，自今年夏天以来，飓风经常形成的大西洋部分地区的切变强度创历史新高。

paras.en: At the same time, warmer ocean surface temperatures in the Pacific allow more hurricanes to form there. The elevated water temperature heats the air above it, fueling more of these cyclones, writes meteorologist Matthew Cappucci for the Washington Post. As of October 1, the Pacific has experienced 20 named storms, including three hurricanes classified as Category 5—the most intense kind, with wind speeds of at least 157 miles per hour, per CNN. One of them, Hurricane Polo, had one of the fastest intensifications on record in the eastern Pacific, going from tropical storm to Category 5 hurricane within 24 hours on September 22.
paras.zh: 与此同时，太平洋海洋表面温度升高导致更多飓风在那里形成。气象学家马修·卡普奇在《华盛顿邮报》上写道，水温升高会加热其上方的空气，从而助长更多的气旋。据 CNN 报道，截至 10 月 1 日，太平洋地区已经历了 20 场命名风暴，其中包括 3 场被列为 5 级飓风，这是最强烈的飓风，风速至少为每小时 157 英里。其中之一“波罗”飓风是东太平洋有记录以来强度最快的飓风之一，于 9 月 22 日在 24 小时内从热带风暴升级为 5 级飓风。

paras.en: Quick fact: Tropical cyclones, storms, depressions and hurricanes
paras.zh: 速览：热带气旋、风暴、低气压和飓风

paras.en: A tropical cyclone is a rapidly rotating, low-pressure system that forms over tropical or subtropical ocean waters. A tropical depression is a cyclone with winds of 38 miles per hour or less, a tropical storm is one with winds ranging from 39 to 73 miles per hour, and a hurricane is a cyclone with winds of at least 74 miles per hour.
paras.zh: 热带气旋是在热带或亚热带海水上空形成的快速旋转的低压系统。热带低气压是指风速为每小时 38 英里或以下的气旋，热带风暴是指风速为每小时 39 至 73 英里的气旋，飓风是指风速至少为每小时 74 英里的气旋。

paras.en: Threats could still emerge in the Atlantic Ocean, though, since October is historically a busy month for hurricane landfalls in Florida, writes meteorologist John Morales for NBC6. “I can’t rule out a window of a few days in which these hostile conditions for hurricanes will abate.”
paras.zh: 气象学家约翰·莫拉莱斯 (John Morales) 为 NBC6 撰文称，尽管如此，大西洋仍可能出现威胁，因为历史上 10 月是佛罗里达州飓风登陆的繁忙月份。 “我不能排除几天之内飓风的不利条件将会减弱的可能性。”

paras.en: What’s more, the lack of hurricanes doesn’t mean a lack of tropical storms. These can also be destructive, especially as climate change makes cyclones wetter and more destructive. In September, Tropical Storm Fay came close to becoming the season’s first hurricane, writes Lowry on his Substack, but just missed the wind speed threshold for a hurricane. Its status might still get bumped up during a future review by the National Hurricane Center, per Scientific American.
paras.zh: 更重要的是，没有飓风并不意味着没有热带风暴。这些也可能具有破坏性，特别是当气候变化使气旋变得更加湿润和更具破坏性时。洛瑞在他的 Substack 中写道，9 月，热带风暴费伊差点成为本季首场飓风，但刚刚达不到飓风的风速阈值。据《科学美国人》报道，在国家飓风中心未来的审查中，其地位可能仍会得到提升。

paras.en: With two months left until the end of hurricane season, there’s still time for one of these windy, watery events to emerge. “Don’t tune out. Stay informed,” Morales writes. “But fingers crossed that the rest of the 2026 Atlantic hurricane season stays as dead as a doornail.”
paras.zh: 距离飓风季节结束还有两个月，这些大风多水的事件仍有时间出现。 “不要忽视。随时了解情况，”莫拉莱斯写道。 “但祝愿 2026 年大西洋飓风季的剩余时间能够保持平静。”

articles.title: A Diver Volunteered to Clean Up Trash From a Wisconsin Lake. He Discovered a 1,000-Year-Old Dugout Canoe at the Bottom Instead

paras.en: Mark Schachtner was just about to wrap up his dive session in Wisconsin’s Pewaukee Lake when he spotted a long object resting on the lake floor. Intrigued, Schachtner swam closer and began to inspect the mysterious object. Within a few seconds, he realized he was looking at a canoe, possibly an extremely old one.
paras.zh: 马克·沙赫特纳 (Mark Schachtner) 正要结束在威斯康星州皮沃基湖 (Pewaukee Lake) 的潜水课程，这时他发现湖底有一个长长的物体。出于好奇，沙赫特纳游得更近，开始检查这个神秘物体。几秒钟之内，他意识到自己看到的是一艘独木舟，可能是一艘非常古老的独木舟。

paras.en: Now, experts with the Wisconsin Historical Society have determined that the vessel is a roughly 1,000-year-old dugout canoe, likely handcrafted and used by Indigenous communities in the late 10th or early 11th century.
paras.zh: 现在，威斯康星州历史学会的专家确定，这艘船是一艘大约有 1000 年历史的独木舟，很可能是在 10 世纪末或 11 世纪初由土著社区手工制作和使用的。

paras.en: Numerous dugout canoes have been found throughout Wisconsin, including 16 in an ancient canoe “parking lot” in Lake Mendota, near the state capital Madison. But the newly discovered vessel is believed to be the first found in Pewaukee Lake, a 2,437-acre, spring-fed body of water located in Waukesha County, on the western outskirts of Milwaukee.
paras.zh: 在威斯康星州各地发现了许多独木舟，其中 16 艘位于该州首府麦迪逊附近门多塔湖的一个古老独木舟“停车场”。但这艘新发现的船只据信是在皮沃基湖 (Pewaukee Lake) 中发现的第一艘船只，皮沃基湖 (Pewaukee Lake) 是一个占地 2,437 英亩的泉水湖，位于密尔沃基西郊的沃克夏县 (Waukesha County)。

paras.en: Schachtner, a 45-year-old member of the 4 Seasons Scuba Diving Club, was participating in a volunteer trash cleanup dive in Pewaukee Lake on May 6 when he spotted the canoe. Immediately, he realized that he had stumbled upon something special. He made note of the vessel’s location and got in touch with Tamara Thomsen, a maritime archaeologist with the society.
paras.zh: 沙赫特纳 (Schachtner) 是 4 Seasons Scuba Diving Club 的 45 岁会员，5 月 6 日，他在皮沃基湖 (Pewaukee Lake) 参加志愿垃圾清理潜水活动时发现了这艘独木舟。立刻，他意识到自己偶然发现了一些特别的东西。他记下了船只的位置，并与该协会的海洋考古学家塔玛拉·汤姆森取得了联系。

paras.en: “It stuck out to me,” Schachtner tells the Wisconsin State Journal’s Barry Adams, adding that he was aware of the dugout canoes previously found by Thomsen and her colleagues in Lake Mendota. “I always keep my eyes peeled. There’s not much for big logs down there unless it’s a fish crib or something. The whole thing was sticking out.”
paras.zh: “这让我印象深刻，”沙赫特纳告诉威斯康星州日报的巴里·亚当斯，并补充说他知道汤姆森和她的同事之前在门多塔湖发现的独木舟。 “我总是睁大眼睛。那里没有太多大木头，除非是鱼床什么的。整个东西都很突出。”

paras.en: Five days after Schachtner’s initial discovery, he and Thomsen returned to the site together to take measurements, snap photos and videos, and collect a small sample of the wood. The vessel, which archaeologists say is in good condition, measures 17.3 feet long by 1.8 feet wide at its thickest point, with 2.5-inch-thick walls and a 4.8-inch-thick bottom.
paras.zh: 沙赫特纳最初发现五天后，他和汤姆森一起回到现场进行测量、拍摄照片和视频，并收集了一小部分木材样本。考古学家称，这艘船状况良好，最厚处长 17.3 英尺，宽 1.8 英尺，壁厚 2.5 英寸，底部厚 4.8 英寸。

paras.en: In August, the society received the results of radiocarbon dating and wood identification tests, which revealed that the canoe was crafted roughly a millennia ago from white oak. Testing revealed a 70 percent chance the canoe was created between 992 and 1049 C.E., an era known to archaeologists as the Late Woodland Period, when the Mississippian culture was flourishing and Indigenous groups were building effigy mounds and growing maize.
paras.zh: 八月，该协会收到了放射性碳测年和木材鉴定测试的结果，结果显示这艘独木舟是大约千年前用白橡木制成的。测试显示，独木舟有 70% 的可能性是在公元 992 年至 1049 年之间制造的，考古学家将这一时期称为林地晚期，当时密西西比文化蓬勃发展，土著群体正在建造雕像土堆并种植玉米。

paras.en: Around this same time, the Cahokia people were expanding into Wisconsin, where they established trading posts and fortified settlements like Aztalan, now Aztalan State Park.
paras.zh: 大约在同一时间，卡霍基亚人向威斯康星州扩张，在那里建立了贸易站和坚固的定居点，如阿兹塔兰（现在的阿兹塔兰州立公园）。

paras.en: To better understand the canoe, the society’s experts are consulting with Larry Plucinski, tribal historic preservation officer for the Bad River Band of Lake Superior Chippewa, and Bill Quackenbush, a retired tribal historic preservation officer for the Ho-Chunk Nation. Both are longtime tribal partners on the Wisconsin Dugout Canoe Survey Project, which is being spearheaded by Thomsen and Sissel Schroeder, an anthropologist at the University of Wisconsin, Madison.
paras.zh: 为了更好地了解独木舟，该协会的专家正在咨询苏必利尔奇珀瓦湖巴德河段的部落历史保护官员拉里·普鲁辛斯基（Larry Plucinski）和霍-琼克民族（Ho-Chunk Nation）退休部落历史保护官员比尔·奎肯布什（Bill Quackenbush）。两人都是威斯康星独木舟调查项目的长期部落合作伙伴，该项目由汤姆森和威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的人类学家西塞尔·施罗德牵头。

paras.en: Today, the canoe rests on the lake bottom, roughly 15 feet below the surface. But 1,000 years ago, experts suspect that the site was above water, located along the lake’s ancient shoreline. The vessel was probably parked there intentionally for later use, Plucinski tells the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel’s Caitlin Looby.
paras.zh: 如今，独木舟停泊在湖底，距水面约 15 英尺。但 1000 年前，专家怀疑该遗址位于水面之上，位于湖泊古老的海岸线上。普鲁辛斯基告诉《密尔沃基哨兵报》的凯特琳·卢比，这艘船可能是故意停在那里供以后使用。

paras.en: Dugout canoes were once an essential means of transportation. They were typically shared by the broader community rather than owned by individuals. “It was just common knowledge that nobody owned it,” Plucinski tells the Wisconsin State Journal. “If you needed it, you used it.”
paras.zh: 独木舟曾经是重要的交通工具。它们通常由更广泛的社区共享，而不是由个人拥有。 “众所周知，没有人拥有它，”普鲁辛斯基告诉威斯康星州日报。 “如果你需要它，你就使用它。”

paras.en: The canoe appears to have been carved by hand—possibly using shells or stone tools—and shaped using fire, a process that likely “took a lot of time,” Jon Greendeer, president of the Ho-Chunk Nation, tells Wisconsin Public Radio’s Danielle Kaeding. “You can imagine how much work went into each one of these.”
paras.zh: 独木舟似乎是手工雕刻的——可能使用贝壳或石器——并用火塑造形状，这个过程可能“花了很多时间”，Ho-Chunk Nation 的主席乔恩·格林迪尔 (Jon Greendeer) 告诉威斯康星州公共广播电台的丹尼尔·凯丁 (Danielle Kaeding)。 “你可以想象每一项都需要投入多少工作。”

paras.en: Over the centuries, the canoe was likely exposed to temperature fluctuations, dragging anchors and other disturbances. But it’s partially filled with sediment, which may have helped protect it from damage. “It’s very remarkable that it’s intact and as beautiful as it is,” Thomsen tells the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel.
paras.zh: 几个世纪以来，独木舟很可能受到温度波动、拖锚和其他干扰的影响。但它的一部分充满了沉积物，这可能有助于保护它免受损坏。汤姆森告诉《密尔沃基哨兵报》：“它完好无损，而且如此美丽，真是太了不起了。”

paras.en: In accordance with the wishes of Wisconsin’s Indigenous nations, the canoe will remain submerged in the lake. Keeping it underwater will also give the vessel the best chance of preservation, the society notes.
paras.zh: 根据威斯康星州原住民的意愿，独木舟将继续淹没在湖中。该协会指出，将其保持在水下也将为该船提供最好的保存机会。

paras.en: The exact location is being kept private, although local and regional conservation wardens know where it is. Divers may visit the site, but state law prohibits removing, defacing, displacing or destroying the vessel.
paras.zh: 尽管当地和地区的保护管理员知道它在哪里，但确切的位置仍然保密。潜水员可以参观该地点，但州法律禁止拆除、污损、移位或毁坏船只。

paras.en: While this may be the first canoe discovered in Pewaukee Lake, Plucinski suspects it won’t be the last. Given how important the vessels were for transportation, he believes that similar vessels are likely still waiting to be discovered.
paras.zh: 虽然这可能是在皮沃基湖发现的第一艘独木舟，但普鲁辛斯基怀疑这不会是最后一艘。考虑到这些船只对于运输的重要性，他认为类似的船只可能仍在等待被发现。

paras.en: “This might be one of many more people will find,” Plucinski tells the Wisconsin State Journal. “No matter what lake you go to, there’s probably canoes out there.”
paras.zh: “这可能是更多人会发现的其中之一，”普鲁辛斯基告诉威斯康星州日报。 “无论你去哪个湖，那里都可能有独木舟。”

articles.title: New Research Shows That These Ancient Egyptian Servants May Have Been Brutally Sacrificed and Buried Alongside Their Pharaohs

paras.en: Five thousand years ago, some of ancient Egypt’s first royals were laid to rest in grand tombs, accompanied by hundreds of their courtiers. Archaeologists have long puzzled over this arrangement. But a new forensic study published in the journal Frontiers in Environmental Archaeology suggests that these servants may have been prematurely dispatched to the afterlife, where they could serve their rulers for all eternity.
paras.zh: 五千年前，一些古埃及第一批王室成员被安葬在宏伟的坟墓中，身边有数百名朝臣陪伴。考古学家长期以来对这种安排感到困惑。但发表在《环境考古学前沿》杂志上的一项新法医研究表明，这些仆人可能被过早地送往来世，在那里他们可以永远为统治者服务。

paras.en: Study author Roselyn Campbell, a bioarchaeologist at Purdue University, analyzed 46 skulls from Umm el-Qaab, a royal cemetery in Abydos, where Egypt’s first pharaohs were interred.
paras.zh: 该研究的作者、普渡大学生物考古学家 Roselyn Campbell 分析了来自阿比多斯乌姆卡布皇家墓地的 46 个头骨，埃及第一位法老就埋葬在那里。

paras.en: The famed Egyptologist Flinders Petrie first excavated these skulls back in the 1920s, when he discovered hundreds of graves surrounding Abydos’ royal tombs. Reasoning that these retainers (court officials and servants) likely didn’t die of natural causes simultaneously, Petrie suspected they had been sacrificed. But he couldn’t find physical evidence of murder to back up his hunch.
paras.zh: 著名埃及古物学家弗林德斯·皮特里 (Flinders Petrie) 于 1920 年代首次挖掘了这些头骨，当时他在阿比多斯皇家陵墓周围发现了数百座坟墓。皮特里认为这些家臣（宫廷官员和仆人）很可能不会同时自然死亡，因此怀疑他们是被牺牲的。但他找不到谋杀的物证来支持他的预感。

paras.en: Campbell has now reassessed some of the preserved skulls using modern forensic methods. She found that 18 of the 46 crania had suffered significant trauma, suggesting that these individuals were “deliberately killed by blows to the head,” per a statement from Frontiers.
paras.zh: 坎贝尔现在使用现代法医方法重新评估了一些保存完好的头骨。根据 Frontiers 的一份声明，她发现 46 名颅骨中有 18 名遭受了严重创伤，这表明这些人是“故意因头部受到打击而死亡”。

paras.en: “This question of whether or not retainer sacrifice was practiced in Egypt has been debated for over a century, but this is the first study to examine the human remains from the tombs themselves,” Campbell tells the Guardian’s Nicola Davis.
paras.zh: “关于埃及是否实行家臣祭祀的问题已经争论了一个多世纪，但这是第一项对坟墓本身进行人类遗骸检查的研究，”坎贝尔告诉《卫报》的尼古拉·戴维斯。

paras.en: The retainers were interred in rows of simple “subsidiary burials” surrounding the funerary enclosures of three royals: King Djer (the third pharaoh of Egypt’s First Dynasty, who ruled around 3000 B.C.E.) and two of his successors, King Djet and Queen Meretneith.
paras.zh: 这些家臣被安葬在围绕着三位皇室成员的墓地的一排排简单的“附属墓葬”中：杰尔国王（埃及第一王朝的第三位法老，统治于公元前 3000 年左右）和他的两位继任者杰特国王和梅雷特奈斯王后。

paras.en: “In many cultures, retainer sacrifice is practiced because of beliefs that the sacrificed individuals will continue to serve the ruler in some kind of afterlife, but retainer sacrifice can also be a visceral display of the ruler’s power,” Campbell says in the statement. “Some retainers might have volunteered to die to achieve eternal life or honor. Others may have been chosen or even forced.”
paras.zh: 坎贝尔在声明中表示：“在许多文化中，进行家臣祭祀是因为人们相信牺牲者在来世将继续为统治者服务，但家臣祭祀也可以是统治者权力的发自内心的展示。” “一些家臣可能自愿死去以获得永生或荣誉。其他人可能是被选择的，甚至是被迫的。”

paras.en: The wounds that Campbell identified include multiple linear fractures across cranial vaults, a “penetrative injury” to the side of a head and a “chopping injury” to an eye, per the study. The individuals without skull injuries may have died naturally. Or maybe they were killed via methods such as asphyxiation, which wouldn’t have left skeletal marks for archaeologists to find.
paras.zh: 根据该研究，坎贝尔发现的伤口包括颅顶多处线性骨折、头部侧面的“穿透伤”和眼睛的“砍伤”。头骨没有受伤的个体可能已经自然死亡。或者也许他们是通过窒息等方法被杀死的，这样就不会留下考古学家可以找到的骨骼痕迹。

paras.en: Nobody knows what kinds of weapons the ancient Egyptians used to cause the skull injuries. “Based on comparative forensic and archaeological studies, the most likely implement would have been flat and relatively light, probably made out of something like wood rather than stone,” Campbell tells Live Science’s Owen Jarus.
paras.zh: 没有人知道古埃及人用什么武器造成头骨受伤。 “根据法医和考古学的比较研究，最有可能的工具是扁平且相对较轻的，可能是由木材而不是石头制成的，”坎贝尔告诉《生活科学》的欧文·贾鲁斯。

paras.en: According to the study, the first king of the First Dynasty, Aha, was buried with a few subsidiaries. Djer, Djet and Meretneith were then buried with hundreds, clearly taking retainer sacrifice to new heights. But by the beginning of Egypt’s Second Dynasty, around 2730 B.C.E., subsidiary graves had all but disappeared.
paras.zh: 根据研究，第一王朝的第一位国王阿哈与一些附属者一起陪葬。随后，杰尔、杰特和梅雷特内斯与数百人一起下葬，显然将家臣牺牲推向了新的高度。但到了埃及第二王朝初期，即公元前 2730 年左右，附属坟墓几乎消失了。

paras.en: “The practice was short-lived, with people being replaced by statuettes,” Salima Ikram, an Egyptologist at the American University in Cairo who wasn’t involved in the study, tells the Guardian. “Possibly some or all retainers felt that this was a boon and that they would enjoy an eternal life in the service of the god-king, though they might also have resented it, been terrified, and tried to escape this fate.”
paras.zh: “这种做法是短暂的，人们被雕像所取代，”开罗美国大学的埃及古物学家萨利玛·伊克拉姆（Salima Ikram）告诉《卫报》，她没有参与这项研究。 “可能一些或全部家臣都觉得这是一种恩惠，他们将在侍奉神王的过程中享受永生，尽管他们也可能对此感到怨恨、恐惧，并试图逃避这种命运。”

articles.title: You Probably Aren’t Going to Get the Plague
articles.author: Emily Mullin

paras.en: A mysterious death of a woman in Russia following a lab accident has stoked fears about plague spreading. But the odds of that actually happening remain very low, with the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention saying on X Tuesday afternoon that the circumstances of the case remain unconfirmed and that there is “no indication of a broader threat to the United States” at this time.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯一名妇女在实验室事故后神秘死亡，引发了人们对鼠疫蔓延的担忧。但这种情况实际发生的可能性仍然很低，美国疾病控制与预防中心周二下午表示，该病例的具体情况尚未得到证实，目前“没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁”。

paras.en: “We are working across the US government to assess developments as additional information becomes available,” the agency said. “CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely.”
paras.zh: 该机构表示：“我们正在与美国政府合作，随着更多信息的出现，评估事态发展。” “疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

paras.en: Last week, a young researcher died from severe pneumonia of “unknown” origin after reportedly breaking a test tube at her workplace, the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute in Siberia. The hospital that treated her before her death was placed under quarantine, and her coworkers at the lab were isolated, according to Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty.
paras.zh: 上周，一名年轻的研究人员因在西伯利亚伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的工作场所打破试管而死于“不明”原因的严重肺炎。据自由欧洲电台/自由电台报道，她死前接受治疗的医院已被隔离，她在实验室的同事也被隔离。

paras.en: Christian Lindmeier, a spokesperson for the World Health Organization, told reporters in Geneva on Tuesday that the group has been in touch with Russian authorities. Based on currently available information, WHO says the public health risk to the general population is very low.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织发言人克里斯蒂安·林德梅尔周二在日内瓦告诉记者，该组织已与俄罗斯当局保持联系。根据目前掌握的信息，世卫组织表示，一般人群面临的公共卫生风险非常低。

paras.en: “I think that’s the correct assessment,” says Gigi Gronvall, an immunologist and senior scholar at the Johns Hopkins Center for Health Security. “We don’t know anything about anything right now.”
paras.zh: “我认为这是正确的评估，”约翰·霍普金斯健康安全中心的免疫学家兼高级学者吉吉·格伦瓦尔说。 “我们现在什么都不知道。”

paras.en: Russian authorities have said contact tracing hasn’t yielded any signs of dangerous pathogens spreading, according to the Associated Press. Infamous for causing millions of deaths in Europe during the Middle Ages, plague is rare today. It is caused by the bacteria Yersinia pestis, which is found in wild rodents and their fleas in many parts of the world. It’s spread to humans through the bite of an infected flea and occasionally through direct contact with an infected animal. Antibiotics can cure plague, but they must be started as soon as an infection is suspected.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，俄罗斯当局表示，接触者追踪尚未发现任何危险病原体传播的迹象。鼠疫在中世纪曾在欧洲造成数百万人死亡，因而臭名昭著，但如今却很少见了。它是由鼠疫耶尔森氏菌引起的，这种细菌存在于世界许多地方的野生啮齿动物及其跳蚤中。它通过受感染跳蚤的叮咬传播给人类，偶尔也通过直接接触受感染的动物传播。抗生素可以治愈鼠疫，但一旦怀疑感染就必须立即开始使用。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague occurs when a person inhales infectious droplets that contain the bacteria. In July 2025, an Arizona man died from pneumonic plague after exposure to infected cats. It can also spread from person to person through respiratory droplets during close contact. But human-to-human transmission is rare, with the last reported occurrence happening in 1924 in Los Angeles. The possibility, though, is why the CDC says it’s important to rapidly identify cases and treat them.
paras.zh: 当一个人吸入含有细菌的传染性飞沫时，就会发生肺鼠疫。 2025 年 7 月，亚利桑那州一名男子在接触受感染的猫后死于肺鼠疫。它还可以在密切接触期间通过呼吸道飞沫在人与人之间传播。但人与人之间的传播很少见，最近一次报道发生在 1924 年的洛杉矶。不过，这种可能性正是疾病预防控制中心表示快速识别病例并治疗它们很重要的原因。

paras.en: “Once you know that somebody has been exposed to it, and even if you have a doubt that somebody has been exposed to it, you can immediately start antibiotics to prevent the person getting afflicted with the disease and to avoid the continuous spread of the disease,” says Rutul Dalal, an infectious disease physician at Penn State Health St. Joseph Medical Center.
paras.zh: “一旦你知道有人接触过这种病毒，即使你怀疑有人接触过这种病毒，你也可以立即开始使用抗生素，以防止该人感染这种疾病，并避免这种疾病的持续传播，”宾夕法尼亚州立大学圣约瑟夫医疗中心的传染病医生鲁图尔·达拉尔（Rutul Dalal）说。

paras.en: Dalal says if the Russian lab worker did die from plague, he is confident that the disease could easily be contained. “With Covid, that was a virus we had not dealt with in the past,” he says. That required novel interventions, while “here, we do have antibiotics to deal with this.”
paras.zh: 达拉尔说，如果俄罗斯实验室工作人员确实死于鼠疫，他相信这种疾病很容易得到控制。 “新冠病毒是我们过去从未处理过的病毒，”他说。这需要新的干预措施，而“在这里，我们确实有抗生素来应对这个问题。”

paras.en: The incident also occurred in a remote part of Russia, which could naturally limit its spread. “Siberia is not exactly Paris,” Gronvall says. “There’s not a lot of travel going back and forth.”
paras.zh: 该事件还发生在俄罗斯偏远地区，自然可以限制其传播。 “西伯利亚并不完全是巴黎，”格伦瓦尔说。 “来回的旅行并不多。”

paras.en: Whether plague is the culprit or not remains an open question. Rospotrebnadzor, Russia’s federal public health and consumer protection agency, said “extensive” testing found “no microorganisms associated with the patient’s professional activities.” But the US has urged the country to share as much information as possible, while other nations that share borders or are near Russia, including Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan, have set up quarantine protocols.
paras.zh: 瘟疫是否是罪魁祸首仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。俄罗斯联邦公共卫生和消费者保护机构 Rospotrebnadzor 表示，“广泛”测试发现“没有与患者职业活动相关的微生物”。但美国敦促该国分享尽可能多的信息，而哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦和塔吉克斯坦等与俄罗斯接壤或邻近的其他国家也制定了检疫协议。

articles.title: Jaguar Finally Reveals Its Biggest Gamble: the Type 01
articles.author: Jeremy White

paras.en: The day has finally arrived. Jaguar began its long road to electric reinvention in November 2024 with a firestorm of a rebrand featuring no cars. Just a month later, it revealed a prototype: the Type 00—a car so polarizing it practically broke the internet’s automotive enclave. Some loved it; others hated it so much that Jaguar’s own staff were targeted for supposedly betraying the company’s 90-year history.
paras.zh: 这一天终于到来了。捷豹于 2024 年 11 月开始了漫长的电动重塑之路，掀起了一场没有汽车的品牌重塑风暴。仅仅一个月后，它就发布了一款原型车：Type 00——一款两极分化的汽车，几乎打破了互联网的汽车飞地。有些人喜欢它，有些人则喜欢它。其他人则对此深恶痛绝，以至于捷豹自己的员工因涉嫌背叛公司 90 年的历史而成为攻击目标。

paras.en: Since this chaotic but undoubtedly viral launch, major departures have followed, including Jaguar Land Rover’s (JLR) chief creative officer Gerry McGovern, the notable car designer who signed off on Jaguar’s divisive all-electric design and the no-car ad campaign.
paras.zh: 自从这次混乱但无疑是病毒式的发布以来，随之而来的是重大离职，其中包括捷豹路虎（JLR）首席创意官格里·麦戈文（Gerry McGovern），这位著名的汽车设计师签署了捷豹分裂的全电动设计和无汽车广告活动。

paras.en: Jaguar’s managing director, Rawdon Glover, is a brave man. Through this shitstorm, and a frighteningly long period of selling no new cars whatsoever, he’s remained unflappable; utterly confident that, when people see the final car—the finished version of the luxury four-door GT that is “like no other”—everything will make sense. That moment is here. The company finally revealed the Jaguar Type 01 at an event in New York City on Tuesday—the finished version of the Type 00. (Jaguar Land Rover paid a portion of WIRED's travel expenses so we could attend the launch.)
paras.zh: 捷豹的董事总经理罗登·格洛弗 (Rawdon Glover) 是一个勇敢的人。经历了这场狗屎风暴，以及在可怕的长时间内没有出售任何新车的情况下，他仍然镇定自若。完全有信心，当人们看到最终的汽车——“独一无二”的豪华四门 GT 成品版时——一切都会变得有意义。那一刻就在这里。该公司最终在周二于纽约市举行的一次活动中展示了捷豹 Type 01，即 Type 00 的成品版本。（捷豹路虎支付了《连线》杂志的一部分差旅费，以便我们能够参加发布会。）

paras.en: “A bold grand tourer that never arrives unnoticed, like all the best Jaguars of the past,” Jaguar’s press material says. This is most certainly true: you will see this thing coming. The low roofline, short front and extended rear overhangs, long hood, and huge 23-inch wheels all remain from the prototype, just as promised. The cab-rear design hides a 50–50 weight distribution, and the huge surfaces make it hard to square the fact that this is the most aerodynamic Jag ever, with active vanes, a deployable spoiler, and airflow trickery delivering a drag coefficient of 0.23 Cd.
paras.zh: 捷豹的新闻材料称：“就像过去所有最好的捷豹一样，这是一款大胆的豪华旅行车，永远不会被忽视。”这绝对是真的：你会看到这件事的发生。正如承诺的那样，低车顶线、短前悬和加长后悬、长引擎盖和巨大的 23 英寸车轮都保留在原型车上。驾驶室后部的设计隐藏了 50-50 的重量分布，巨大的表面让人难以接受这样一个事实：这是有史以来最符合空气动力学的 Jag，配有主动叶片、可展开的扰流板和气流技巧，阻力系数为 0.23 Cd。

paras.en: Crucially, the production model’s extra doors make more sense of the design, shifting the Type 01’s look away from Thunderbirds territory to more familiar ground. The front has been softened ever so slightly as well, which again is preferable to the prototype’s exceedingly bluff nose. The rear, however, is where the exterior design really shines with hidden-until-lit, full-width lights embedded in horizontal strikethroughs.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，量产车型的额外车门使设计更具意义，将 01 型的外观从雷鸟领域转移到更熟悉的领域。前部也被稍微软化了，这又比原型机的极其陡峭的鼻子更可取。然而，后部是外观设计真正闪耀的地方，隐藏式全宽灯嵌入水平删除线中。

paras.en: Let’s get the specs out of the way: the Type 01 is the most powerful Jaguar road car, with up to 1,030 Pferdestärke (PS) and 1,365 Newton-meters. It goes from standstill to 62 mph in 3.2 seconds. Justifying the tagline of “power in reserve,” the car can rocket from 62 to 112 mph in a further 4 seconds. I’ve been driven in it, and it feels like the acceleration never ends thanks to the tri-motor setup of a 260-kilowatt (kW) front motor paired with twin 310-kW rear motors.
paras.zh: 让我们先了解一下规格：Type 01 是最强大的捷豹公路车，具有高达 1,030 Pferdestärke (PS) 和 1,365 牛顿米。从静止加速到 62 英里/小时只需 3.2 秒。该车可以在 4 秒内从 62 英里/小时加速到 112 英里/小时，这证明了“动力储备”的口号。我驾驶过它，感觉加速永无止境，这要归功于 260 千瓦 (kW) 前电机与双 310 kW 后电机配对的三电机设置。

paras.en: It stands 5,235 mm long and 1,403 mm tall, but all-wheel steering makes it feel much smaller on the road. The 850-volt bespoke Jaguar architecture and 118-kilowatt-hour usable battery supposedly deliver an EPA range of up to 400 miles (450 miles on WLTP), with a “sustained highway speed” range of up to 320 miles. Drivers can add up to 200 miles of range in 13 minutes using 350 kW rapid DC charging. So the TL;DR? It’s huge, fast, aerodynamic, powerful, and, most definitely, unique.
paras.zh: 它长 5,235 毫米，高 1,403 毫米，但全轮转向让它在路上感觉更小。 850 伏定制捷豹架构和 118 千瓦时的可用电池据称可提供高达 400 英里的 EPA 续航里程（WLTP 为 450 英里），“持续高速公路速度”续航里程可达 320 英里。使用 350 kW 快速直流充电，驾驶员可以在 13 分钟内增加最多 200 英里的行驶里程。那么，TL;DR？它巨大、速度快、符合空气动力学、功能强大，而且绝对是独一无二的。

paras.en: Inside, a dramatic central spine runs the full length of the cabin, creating a zone for each occupant. Lots of “brass-inspired” finishes are intended to underline the luxury message. A panoramic glass roof with adjustable virtual blinds brings in the light, but there’s no rear windscreen. Instead, a digital “ClearSight” rearview display is embedded centrally in the full-width panoramic soundbar at the base of the windscreen to show what’s behind. Cleverly, the feed from this rear-facing camera is positioned at the same height as the door mirrors, supposedly reducing the annoying focal adjustment these systems usually demand.
paras.zh: 在内部，一条引人注目的中央脊柱贯穿整个机舱，为每个乘客创造了一个区域。许多“黄铜风格”的饰面旨在强调奢华的信息。带有可调节虚拟百叶窗的全景玻璃屋顶带来了光线，但没有后挡风玻璃。相反，数字“ClearSight”后视显示器嵌入在挡风玻璃底部的全宽全景条形音箱的中央，以显示后面的情况。巧妙的是，该后置摄像头的图像与后视镜位于同一高度，据说可以减少这些系统通常需要的烦人的焦距调整。

paras.en: Ahead of the driver is a 24-inch OLED screen that extends toward the center of the car. A central 7-inch smartphone-style display sits between the driver and front passenger for common controls such as climate and audio, operated entirely by touchscreen with (sadly) no physical switchgear in sight. “Hot stone massage effect” seats, whatever those are, are also electrically adjustable in 12 different ways. Cabin air purification removes allergens, toxins, and particulates, and a fragrance diffuser offers a choice of scents—which seems to be the pinnacle of what Western auto companies think a luxury car interior needs these days.
paras.zh: 驾驶员前方是一块 24 英寸 OLED 屏幕，向汽车中央延伸。中央 7 英寸智能手机式显示屏位于驾驶员和前排乘客之间，用于控制气候和音频等常用控制装置，完全通过触摸屏操作，（遗憾的是）看不到任何物理开关设备。无论是什么“热石按摩效果”座椅，都可以通过 12 种不同方式进行电动调节。车内空气净化可以去除过敏原、毒素和颗粒物，香薰机可以提供多种香味选择——这似乎是西方汽车公司认为当今豪华车内饰所需要的巅峰之作。

paras.en: As a grand tourer, luggage space is important. The Type 01 offers 450 liters of load space, expanding to 1,000 liters with rear seats folded. And then there are the production stories: Jaguar built more than 150 prototypes, drove 700,000 miles, and filed more than 360 patents while developing the car.
paras.zh: 作为一辆豪华旅行车，行李空间非常重要。 01 型提供 450 升的装载空间，后排座椅折叠后可扩展至 1,000 升。然后是生产故事：捷豹在开发汽车时制造了 150 多辆原型车，行驶了 700,000 英里，并申请了 360 多项专利。

paras.en: Jaguar is most proud, and rightly so, of its “impossible panel.” It's a single, unbroken panel that runs more than 3 meters from the A-pillar to the rear of the Type 01. Pressing this huge piece with five different acute angles in it was deemed not possible by Jaguar's modeling system. After roughly 22 weeks and 1,500 hours of development (supposedly requiring someone to come out of retirement), Jaguar realized this “impossible” panel.
paras.zh: 捷豹最自豪的是它的“不可能的面板”。这是一个完整的单一面板，从 A 柱到 Type 01 的后部，长度超过 3 米。捷豹的建模系统认为将这个具有五个不同锐角的巨大部件压入其中是不可能的。经过大约 22 周和 1,500 个小时的开发（据说需要有人复出），捷豹意识到了这个“不可能”的面板。

paras.en: Pricing of the Type 01 is possibly the most important thing Jaguar has to nail. Starting at around $170,000 (or £130,000—no confirmed pricing yet), this puts the Jag well below Ferrari Luces, electric Merc G-Wagens and Lamborghinis, and even the new Bentley Torcal, exactly where Glover wants to sit. Jaguar thinks it has a sweet spot in luxury EVs, a Goldilocks zone where buyers are eager to part with cash for electric cars that aren’t astronomical but priced high enough above the premium sector to be legitimately highfalutin.
paras.zh: Type 01 的定价可能是捷豹必须解决的最重要问题。 Jag 的起价约为 170,000 美元（或 130,000 英镑——尚未确定定价），这使得 Jag 远远低于 Ferrari Luces、电动 Merc G-Wagens 和兰博基尼，甚至是新款宾利 Torcal，而这正是格洛弗想要坐的位置。捷豹认为，它在豪华电动汽车领域占据了优势，这是一个“金发姑娘区”，买家渴望花大钱购买电动汽车，这些汽车的价格虽然不是天文数字，但价格远高于高端汽车市场，足以合理地夸大其词。

paras.en: No one has really succeeded with the luxury EV market. Porsche has tried. So has Lamborghini. Mercedes has had a very tough time. Now Bentley is having a crack at it. Glover thinks that the Type 01 has a shot.
paras.zh: 没有人在豪华电动汽车市场上真正取得成功。保时捷已经尝试过。兰博基尼也是如此。梅赛德斯经历了一段非常艰难的时期。现在宾利正在尝试这一点。格洛弗认为 01 型有机会。

paras.en: “One of us is going to break through the glass ceiling and make a success of EVs at elevated price points,” Glover tells me. “The best way to do that is not to play into the tropes of EVs. You’re not going to get there because it’s an electric car. You’re going to get there because the car itself looks a certain way, feels a certain way, drives a certain way. If you can do all of those things, [it doesn’t matter] whether it’s combustion or electric. Just being an electric car was enough for such a short period. Cars have got to earn their right in somebody’s garage.”
paras.zh: 格洛弗告诉我：“我们中的一个人将突破玻璃天花板，以更高的价格在电动汽车领域取得成功。” “做到这一点的最好方法就是不要模仿电动汽车。你不会因为它是电动汽车而到达那里。你会到达那里，因为汽车本身看起来是某种方式，感觉是某种方式，以某种方式行驶。如果你能做到所有这些事情，那么无论是燃烧的还是电动的，[并不重要]。在这么短的时间内，仅仅成为一辆电动汽车就足够了。汽车必须在某人的车库中赢得自己的权利。”

paras.en: Glover has openly said the Type 01 will have to earn its place with “almost an entirely new client base,” one that is supposedly younger, more affluent, urban, independently minded, creative, and wishing to “carve their own path.” We shall see very soon exactly what kind of person signs on the dotted line to reserve a Type 01. Will they look like the youthful, vibrant characters in Jaguar’s initial launch campaign, or like traditional Jaguar, Lotus, and Aston owners with gray hair, flannel shirts, and bad shorts?
paras.zh: 格洛弗公开表示，Type 01 必须在“几乎全新的客户群”中赢得一席之地，这些客户群被认为更年轻、更富裕、城市化、思想独立、富有创造力，并希望“开辟自己的道路”。我们很快就会确切地看到什么样的人在虚线上签名预订 Type 01。他们会像捷豹最初发布活动中年轻、充满活力的角色，还是像传统的捷豹、莲花和阿斯顿车主一样，头发花白，穿着法兰绒衬衫和破烂的短裤？

paras.en: “We’ve got to make sure that new audience comes along," Glover says. “But I don’t want to alienate anybody.” The Chinese do well with that youthful audience. “I’ve driven some of the Li Autos. I’ve driven some of the XPeng cars. They’re impressive in terms of the amount of technology in them. The quality of fit and finish is increasing at a pace.”
paras.zh: “我们必须确保新观众的出现，”格洛弗说。 “但我不想疏远任何人。”中国人很受年轻观众欢迎。 “我开过一些理想汽车，也开过一些小鹏汽车。它们的技术含量令人印象深刻。装配和外观的质量正在快速提高。”

paras.en: But Glover still thinks a big gap exists between Chinese cars and established Western autos; though with Xiaomi’s achievements after only a few years of making cars, it’s hard to see this view staying true for long. “They’re playing in a commodity space," he says. "It’s about how many features, how much tech, how much range, and how can I do it at the lowest price. I’m not saying we’re immune to all of that, but it certainly validates us getting out of the volume premium market.”
paras.zh: 但格洛弗仍然认为中国汽车与西方老牌汽车之间存在很大差距；尽管小米造车仅几年就取得了成就，但这种观点很难长期成立。 “他们正在商品领域玩耍，”他说。 “问题在于有多少功能、多少技术、多少范围，以及如何以最低的价格做到这一点。我并不是说我们不受所有这些影响，但这确实证明了我们退出了批量溢价市场。”

paras.en: Like Bentley, Jaguar is leaning into its heritage to look for things the Chinese will find harder to emulate. But it could be argued that the Type 01 lacks any obvious heritage. The pioneering spirit is there, for sure, but this is an EV very much looking forward, not back. With that in mind, what does, say, two years of success look like to Glover for this electrified rebirth of the brand?
paras.zh: 与宾利一样，捷豹也在秉承其传统，寻找中国人难以效仿的东西。但也有人认为 01 型缺乏任何明显的传统。开拓精神是肯定存在的，但这是一款非常向前看的电动汽车，而不是向后看。考虑到这一点，对于格洛弗来说，品牌的电气化重生两年的成功意味着什么？

paras.en: “Success will be we’ve established ourselves at the [new] price point,” he says. “People are saying, ‘Yep, Jaguar is worth paying more for.’ I know what volumes we need to achieve. I’m not going to articulate those, but just under that we need to generate a certain level of volume to create that critical mass.”
paras.zh: “成功将是我们在[新的]价格点上确立了自己的地位，”他说。 “人们说，‘是的，捷豹值得花更多钱。’我知道我们需要达到什么销量。我不会阐明这些，但在此基础上我们需要产生一定水平的销量来创造临界质量。”

paras.en: For Glover, this level of volume requires customers to see Jaguar as a more current, culturally relevant brand, and to be genuinely interested in what the company will do next.
paras.zh: 对于格洛弗来说，这种销量水平要求客户将捷豹视为一个更流行、更具有文化相关性的品牌，并对公司下一步将做什么真正感兴趣。

paras.en: “Is it just the man in the bad shirts and bad shorts, or have we actually been successful in attracting a new audience?” Glover says. “We start seeing that in the first two years.”
paras.zh: “只是那个穿着劣质衬衫和劣质短裤的人，还是我们实际上成功地吸引了新观众？”格洛弗说。 “我们在头两年就开始看到这一点。”

articles.title: The 13 Amazon Device Deals Actually Worth Snagging This Prime Day
articles.author: Nena Farrell

paras.en: Amazon’s Prime Day is back for its fall edition, and Amazon Alexa-powered devices are already on sale. But are the sales actually any good?
paras.zh: 亚马逊秋季版 Prime Day 又回来了，亚马逊 Alexa 驱动的设备已经开始销售。但销量真的好吗？

paras.en: There’s already the question of whether you want Alexa in your house, and now it’s whether the sales are a real discount or more of a mind game. That’s thanks to Amazon raising prices across its device categories at the end of August, leaving us with the same product lineup but a worse case for recommending it.
paras.zh: 已经存在的问题是你是否希望 Alexa 出现在你的家里，现在的问题是销售是真正的折扣还是更多的心理游戏。这要归功于亚马逊在八月底提高了其设备类别的价格，让我们拥有相同的产品阵容，但推荐它的情况更糟。

paras.en: If you’re interested in Amazon’s device sales but want the real picture of what the discount is and which devices are worth it, I’ve got you covered. I’ve been testing Amazon Alexa speakers since they launched in 2012, and I am also WIRED’s resident Kindle expert, which gives me almost too much insight into the price games Amazon plays with these devices. Here’s my full breakdown of all of Amazon's on-sale gadgets and which sales are best, whether it's an Amazon Echo speaker or a Kindle e-reader. Be sure to check out our guide to the Absolute Best Prime Day Deals for more great discounts.
paras.zh: 如果您对亚马逊的设备销售感兴趣，但想了解折扣是什么以及哪些设备值得的真实情况，我已经为您提供了帮助。自 2012 年推出 Amazon Alexa 扬声器以来，我一直在测试它们，而且我也是 WIRED 的常驻 Kindle 专家，这让我对亚马逊在这些设备上玩的价格游戏有了太多的了解。以下是我对亚马逊所有在售产品的完整分类，以及哪些销售最好，无论是亚马逊 Echo 扬声器还是 Kindle 电子阅读器。请务必查看我们的绝对最佳黄金日优惠指南，了解更多折扣。

paras.en: Updated October 7, 3:52 AM ET: We've confirmed all of these deals are still live, and added a new deal on a Fire tablet , as we head into day two of Prime Day.
paras.zh: 美国东部时间 10 月 7 日凌晨 3:52 更新：我们已经确认所有这些优惠仍然有效，并在 Fire 平板电脑上添加了一项新优惠，因为我们即将进入 Prime 会员日的第二天。

paras.en: - My favorite Amazon Echo deal: Echo Spot for $55 ($55 Off)
paras.zh: - 我最喜欢的 Amazon Echo 优惠：Echo Spot 仅需 55 美元（立减 55 美元）

paras.en: - The cheapest Amazon Echo: Echo Dot (5th Gen) for $40 ($40 Off)
paras.zh: - 最便宜的 Amazon Echo：Echo Dot（第 5 代）售价 40 美元（优惠 40 美元）

paras.en: - A better version of our favorite Kindle e-reader: Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition for $170 ($80 Off)
paras.zh: - 我们最喜欢的 Kindle 电子阅读器的更好版本：Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition 售价 170 美元（优惠 80 美元）

paras.en: - A great price for a color Kindle: Kindle Colorsoft for $190 ($100 Off)
paras.zh: - 彩色 Kindle 价格实惠：Kindle Colorsoft 仅需 190 美元（优惠 100 美元）

paras.en: - An art TV powered by Amazon: Ember Artline TV (55 inches) for $500 ($400 Off)
paras.zh: - 由亚马逊提供支持的艺术电视：Ember Artline TV（55 英寸），售价 500 美元（优惠 400 美元）

paras.en: Not all deals are great, especially given the recent price increases. If you’re set on getting a new Amazon Alexa-powered speaker, though, here are the discounts (and devices themselves!) that are still worth it.
paras.zh: 并非所有优惠都很棒，尤其是考虑到最近的价格上涨。不过，如果您打算购买一台新的 Amazon Alexa 驱动的扬声器，这里的折扣（以及设备本身！）仍然值得。

paras.en: If you’re shopping for a Kindle, this is the best time to buy since most were hit with price increases. You won’t get as good a deal anymore after Amazon raised prices across its e-reader lineup, but it’s much better to buy at a discount off the new price than at full price for the same product.
paras.zh: 如果您要购买 Kindle，这是购买的最佳时机，因为大多数设备都受到了价格上涨的影响。在亚马逊提高其电子阅读器系列产品的价格后，你将不再能获得如此优惠的价格，但以新价格的折扣购买同一产品比以全价购买要好得多。

paras.en: Just about every older Kindle (specifically the 2024 line) is on sale. Brand-new Kindles were announced just last week, but we don’t expect those to go on sale during this event. Here are the sales I’d recommend checking out.
paras.zh: 几乎所有旧版 Kindle（特别是 2024 年系列）都在打折。全新的 Kindle 上周刚刚发布，但我们预计它们不会在此次活动期间上市。以下是我建议查看的销售。

paras.en: If you’re shopping for a Fire TV or streaming device, look no further. Here are our favorites from Amazon’s lineup that are also on sale.
paras.zh: 如果您正在购买 Fire TV 或流媒体设备，请不要再犹豫了。以下是亚马逊产品系列中我们最喜欢的产品，这些产品也在促销。

paras.en: If you haven’t already upgraded your home Wi-Fi router with a mesh system, then you’re long overdue. Amazon’s Eero system is one of the most popular for a reason, and Prime Day has a few versions on sale that we like.
paras.zh: 如果您还没有使用网状系统升级您的家庭 Wi-Fi 路由器，那么您早就应该这样做了。亚马逊的 Eero 系统成为最受欢迎的系统之一是有原因的，而且 Prime Day 有几个我们喜欢的版本在售。

paras.en: Other On-Sale Amazon Devices We’ve Tested
paras.zh: 我们测试过的其他在售亚马逊设备

paras.en: Looking for a different device during Amazon’s sale event? We’ve tested several other Amazon Echo and Fire TV devices that are also on sale right now. Here’s what else you can consider, and what the discount looks like.
paras.zh: 在亚马逊促销活动期间寻找不同的设备？我们测试了其他几款目前也在销售的 Amazon Echo 和 Fire TV 设备。以下是您还可以考虑的其他内容以及折扣。

paras.en: - Amazon Echo Dot Max for $80 ($40 Off): If you’re looking for a small speaker with bigger sound than the older Echo Dot, the Echo Dot Max has impressive sound for its size, plus a built-in smart home hub. Its price did increase by $20, though, so it feels like it’s just $20 off even if it looks like $40.
paras.zh: - Amazon Echo Dot Max 售价 80 美元（折扣 40 美元）：如果您正在寻找一款比旧款 Echo Dot 声音更大的小型扬声器，Echo Dot Max 的尺寸令人印象深刻，并且还内置智能家居中心。不过，它的价格确实上涨了 20 美元，所以即使看起来是 40 美元，感觉也只便宜了 20 美元。

paras.en: - Amazon Echo Show 8 (4th Gen) for $125 ($75 Off): While this model is on sale, I prefer the older Echo Show 8 (though it seems rarely available anymore) and the Echo Show 11 since both have better sound. It’s a good discount, even off the original $180 price tag, but I’d just spend $25 more and get the better Echo Show 11 if you’re set on a new Amazon Alexa-powered smart display.
paras.zh: - Amazon Echo Show 8（第 4 代）售价 125 美元（折扣 75 美元）：虽然该型号正在促销，但我更喜欢较旧的 Echo Show 8（尽管它似乎不再可用）和 Echo Show 11，因为两者都有更好的声音。这是一个很好的折扣，即使是原价 180 美元的折扣，但如果你使用的是新的 Amazon Alexa 支持的智能显示器，我只需多花 25 美元即可获得更好的 Echo Show 11。

paras.en: - Amazon Echo Show 15 for $250 ($100 Off): The Echo Show 15 and Echo Show 21 are on sale and both double as a Fire TV device, with a massive screen, a flat back for mounting, and an included Alexa Voice Remote. I don’t love the TV experience, but it works, and the homepage fits a ton of widgets if you want to see multiple at once. Both sizes are discounted, but both models also cost more now, so it’s not as good as you’d think for the same device.
paras.zh: - Amazon Echo Show 15 售价 250 美元（优惠 100 美元）：Echo Show 15 和 Echo Show 21 正在促销，两者都可用作 Fire TV 设备，具有大屏幕、用于安装的平背，并附带 Alexa 语音遥控器。我不喜欢电视体验，但它很有效，如果你想一次看到多个，主页可以容纳大量小部件。两种尺寸都有折扣，但两种型号现在的价格也更高，因此对于同一设备来说，它并不像您想象的那么好。

paras.en: - Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max for $45 ($40 Off): If you love Amazon Prime as your streaming service, this is the favorite we’ve tested of Amazon’s Fire TV streaming devices. It’s not a crazy discount since it went up $25 in August, but it’s still a really affordable streaming stick during this same event.
paras.zh: - Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max 售价 45 美元（优惠 40 美元）：如果您喜欢 Amazon Prime 作为流媒体服务，那么这是我们测试过的最喜欢的 Amazon Fire TV 流媒体设备。自从 8 月份上涨 25 美元以来，这并不是一个疯狂的折扣，但在同一活动期间它仍然是一款非常实惠的流媒体棒。

paras.en: - Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Kids for $170 ($60 Off): The Paperwhite Kids has everything we like about a Kindle Paperwhite, but adds a cover to protect it from any drops by your kiddo's hands and comes with six months of Kids+ content, which is like Kindle Unlimited but designed for kids. It’s a good device, but the discount isn’t as good as before; it used to retail for $180, so it’s really only $10 off what it used to cost. But you won’t find it new for cheaper.
paras.zh: - 亚马逊 Kindle Paperwhite Kids 售价 170 美元（折扣 60 美元）：Paperwhite Kids 拥有我们喜欢的 Kindle Paperwhite 的所有功能，但增加了一个保护套，以保护它免受孩子手上掉落的影响，并附带六个月的 Kids+ 内容，类似于 Kindle Unlimited，但专为儿童设计。设备不错，但是折扣没有以前那么好；它以前的零售价为 180 美元，所以实际上只比以前便宜了 10 美元。但你不会以更便宜的价格找到新的。

paras.en: - Amazon Kindle Kids for $123 ($57 Off): This is the cheapest Kindle Kids device, with a 6-inch screen similar to the cheapest Kindle, and it still comes with a colorful cover and six months of Kids+ content like the Paperwhite Kids above. It has the smallest discount out of the Kids devices, and it used to retail for $130, so it’s only $7 off the original price. The other Kids models are a better buy.
paras.zh: - Amazon Kindle Kids 售价 123 美元（折扣 57 美元）：这是最便宜的 Kindle Kids 设备，配备与最便宜的 Kindle 类似的 6 英寸屏幕，并且仍然配有彩色封面和六个月的 Kids+ 内容，如上面的 Paperwhite Kids。它是儿童设备中折扣最小的，以前零售价为 130 美元，所以比原价只便宜了 7 美元。其他儿童型号更值得购买。

paras.en: - Amazon Kindle Scribe Colorsoft for $480 ($150 Off): The Kindle Scribe Colorsoft has one of the biggest discounts on an Amazon device for Prime Day, but for the most expensive Kindle ever. While I really like the Kindle Scribe system if you want both an e-reader and a digital notebook, for that price I’d recommend a reMarkable Paper Pro digital notebook, which comes with a ton more features and a color screen. Otherwise, stick with the more affordable Kindle Scribes. It is a much better price right now if you really want those features and color, but it’s hard for me to recommend over other options.
paras.zh: - Amazon Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 售价 480 美元（折扣 150 美元）：Kindle Scribe Colorsoft 是 Prime Day 亚马逊设备上最大的折扣之一，也是有史以来最昂贵的 Kindle。如果你同时想要电子阅读器和数字笔记本，我真的很喜欢 Kindle Scribe 系统，但对于这个价格，我会推荐 reMarkable Paper Pro 数字笔记本，它配备了更多功能和彩色屏幕。否则，请坚持使用更实惠的 Kindle Scribes。如果你真的想要这些功能和颜色，现在的价格要好得多，但我很难推荐其他选择。

paras.en: - Amazon Fire HD 10 for $73 ($82 off): Given the steep discount here, and the timing, I expect Amazon will be updating its tablet line this fall. However, given the price hikes for the rest of the company's products, whatever new Fire tablets are coming will likely be more expensive, which makes this deal more appealing, even if it is potentially outdated tech. The Fire HD 10 is the best of Amazon’s tablets and the one we recommend. It's certainly not the fastest tablet around, but when you can snag it on sale for around $100, it's a good deal. It has the best battery life of any Fire tablet, and a 1080p screen that has a lot of glare, but looks decent when you're watching a movie in the dark. You can even set it up to work like an Echo speaker. Turn on Show Mode and you can query Alexa til your heart's content. Realize this is no iPad, but performance is good enough for browsing the web and watching movies.
paras.zh: - Amazon Fire HD 10 售价 73 美元（折扣 82 美元）：考虑到这里的大幅折扣和时机，我预计亚马逊将在今年秋天更新其平板电脑系列。然而，考虑到该公司其他产品的价格上涨，无论推出什么新的 Fire 平板电脑，价格都可能会更高，这使得这笔交易更具吸引力，即使它可能是过时的技术。 Fire HD 10 是亚马逊最好的平板电脑，也是我们推荐的一款。它当然不是最快的平板电脑，但如果你能以 100 美元左右的价格买到它，那就很划算了。它的电池续航时间是所有 Fire 平板电脑中最长的，而且 1080p 屏幕虽然有很多眩光，但在黑暗中看电影时看起来还不错。您甚至可以将其设置为像 Echo 扬声器一样工作。打开显示模式，您可以随心所欲地查询 Alexa。意识到这不是 iPad，但性能足以浏览网页和观看电影。

paras.en: Amazon raised prices across several of its device categories at the end of August. It’s not a shocking move, but it hit many affordable products and makes for a worse sale season since we’re getting discounts on a higher price tag for no other improvements. Here’s a quick breakdown of most of the price changes to help you navigate what sales are good and which are really just bringing you back to the old price.
paras.zh: 八月底，亚马逊提高了其多个设备类别的价格。这并不是一个令人震惊的举动，但它打击了许多价格实惠的产品，并导致销售季节变得更糟，因为我们在没有其他改进的情况下获得了更高价格标签的折扣。以下是大多数价格变化的快速细分，可帮助您了解哪些销售情况良好，哪些实际上只是让您回到原来的价格。

paras.en: Either way, I’d only buy an Amazon device on sale now, but it is unfortunate that the sales just won’t be as good anymore on these existing devices. I expect most, if not all, of these devices to go on sale at some point during Amazon Prime Big Deal Days.
paras.zh: 不管怎样，我只会购买现在打折的亚马逊设备，但不幸的是，这些现有设备的销量不会再那么好。我预计大多数（如果不是全部）这些设备将在亚马逊 Prime 大优惠日期间的某个时间开始销售。

articles.title: U.S. forces in Okinawa order 2-day pause after Marine homicide arrest

paras.en: Oct. 7 (UPI) -- The U.S. military in Okinawa is instituting a 48-hour operational pause, prohibiting all U.S. service members on the Japanese island from leaving the base amid growing public anger after a U.S. Marine was arrested over the weekend on accusations of killing a local woman.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日（合众社）——一名美国海军陆战队周末因涉嫌杀害当地妇女而被捕，公众愤怒日益高涨，驻冲绳美军将实行 48 小时行动暂停，禁止所有在日本岛上的美国军人离开基地。

paras.en: The 48-hour pause began at 12 a.m. local Wednesday and will be in place until 12 a.m. Friday, Lt. Gen. Benjamin T. Watson announced in a letter to all U.S. military personnel on the southern Japanese island.
paras.zh: 本杰明·T·沃森中将在致日本南部岛屿上所有美军人员的一封信中宣布，48 小时的暂停从当地时间周三中午 12 点开始，一直持续到周五中午 12 点。

paras.en: All service members will receive training on standards, discipline and "our responsibilities as members of the Okinawa community," he said, adding that a complete prohibition on alcohol consumption will be in place during the pause.
paras.zh: 他说，所有军人都将接受有关标准、纪律和“我们作为冲绳社区成员的责任”的培训，并补充说，暂停期间将全面禁止饮酒。

paras.en: Liberty policy, enforcement mechanisms, alcohol awareness, Okinawa culture and alliance responsibilities will be among the topics discussed during the training period in which leaders will set "clear expectations" and reinforce "the standards that define our profession," he said.
paras.zh: 他说，自由政策、执行机制、酒精意识、冲绳文化和联盟责任将成为培训期间讨论的主题，领导人将设定“明确的期望”并强化“定义我们职业的标准”。

paras.en: "Serving on Okinawa comes with responsibility. We live, work and socialize alongside the people of Okinawa; their home is our home. Every interaction with our neighbors builds or undermines the trust that is essential to our team. When that trust is damaged, it affects the strength of our alliance and the security of this region. Accordingly, we will take time to think hard about discipline standards and our responsibilities," he said.
paras.zh: “在冲绳服务意味着责任。我们与冲绳人民一起生活、工作和社交；他们的家就是我们的家。与邻居的每一次互动都会建立或破坏对我们团队至关重要的信任。当这种信任受损时，就会影响我们联盟的力量和该地区的安全。因此，我们将花时间认真思考纪律标准和我们的责任，”他说。

paras.en: "Every member of this force must understand that individual conduct has consequences."
paras.zh: “这支部队的每个成员都必须明白，个人行为会产生后果。”

paras.en: Public anger against the U.S. military and demands for accountability have grown since Sunday, when Okinawa police arrested Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, a U.S. service member stationed at U.S. Marine Corps Air Station Futenma.
paras.zh: 自周日以来，冲绳警方逮捕了驻扎在美国海军陆战队普天间基地的 20 岁美国军人德文·雅各布·巴拉德 (Devin Jacob Ballard)，公众对美国军方的愤怒和追究责任的要求日益高涨。

paras.en: He is accused of strangling 39-year-old Anna Yagi to death between 2 a.m. and 4 a.m. Saturday at a hotel in Naha, the capital of Okinawa Prefecture, on the island's southwestern coast. Police allege that he also stole her wallet and other belongings.
paras.zh: 他被指控于周六凌晨 2 点至 4 点之间在冲绳县首府那霸的一家酒店将 39 岁的八木安娜勒死。警方称他还偷了她的钱包和其他物品。

paras.en: Japan's Foreign and Defense ministries have both lodged protests with their respective U.S. counterparts.
paras.zh: 日本外务省和防卫省均已向美国外务省提出抗议。

paras.en: On Wednesday local time, Okinawa Gov. Genta Koja met with Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi in Tokyo, where he called for a stronger response than warnings to U.S. troops and additional training.
paras.zh: 当地时间周三，冲绳县知事小贾元太在东京会见防卫大臣小泉进二郎，呼吁对美军发出比警告更强烈的回应并进行额外训练。

paras.en: Okinawa has repeatedly called for deeper structural changes governing the U.S. military presence on the island, including a fundamental revision of the U.S.-Japan Status of Forces Agreement and more effective measures to reduce the likelihood of crimes committed by U.S. service members.
paras.zh: 冲绳一再呼吁对美国在岛上的军事存在进行更深层次的结构性改革，包括对美日部队地位协定进行根本性修改，并采取更有效的措施来减少美国军人犯罪的可能性。

paras.en: "We would like to move forward with discussions between Japan and the United States," Koizumi said in a statement following the meeting.
paras.zh: 小泉在会后的一份声明中表示：“我们希望推进日本和美国之间的讨论。”

paras.en: The U.S. military has maintained a presence on Okinawa since World War II. The island currently hosts about 30,000 U.S. service members.
paras.zh: 自二战以来，美军一直在冲绳驻军。该岛目前居住着约 30,000 名美国军人。

articles.title: On This Day, Oct. 7: Hamas attack sparks war with Israel

paras.en: Oct. 7 (UPI) -- On this date in history:
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日（UPI）——历史上的这一天：

paras.en: In 1913, for the first time, Henry Ford's entire Highland Park automobile factory was run on a continuously moving assembly line.
paras.zh: 1913 年，亨利·福特的整个高地公园汽车工厂首次在连续移动的装配线上运行。

paras.en: In 1916, Georgia Tech defeated Cumberland University 222-0 in the most lopsided college football game in American history.
paras.zh: 1916年，佐治亚理工学院以222-0击败坎伯兰大学，这是美国历史上最不平衡的大学橄榄球比赛。

paras.en: In 1949, less than five months after Britain, the United States and France established the Federal Republic of Germany in West Germany, the Democratic Republic of Germany (East Germany) was proclaimed within the Soviet occupation zone.
paras.zh: 1949年，英、美、法在西德建立德意志联邦共和国不到五个月，德意志民主共和国（东德）在苏联占领区内宣告成立。

paras.en: In 1958, the U.S. manned space-flight project, originally called Project Astronaut, was officially approved, and renamed Project Mercury.
paras.zh: 1958年，美国载人航天计划（原名“宇航员计划”）正式获得批准，并更名为“水星计划”。

paras.en: In 1963, President John F. Kennedy signed the Limited Test Ban Treaty. Signed by the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States, the treaty was developed to slow the nuclear arms race and reduce the amount of nuclear fallout in the earth's atmosphere.
paras.zh: 1963年，约翰·F·肯尼迪总统签署了《有限禁止试验条约》。该条约由苏联、英国和美国签署，旨在减缓核军备竞赛并减少地球大气中的核尘埃量。

paras.en: In 1968, the U.S. movie industry adopted a film ratings system for the first time: G (for general audiences), M (for mature audiences), R (no one under 16 admitted without an adult) and X (no one under 16 admitted).
paras.zh: 1968年，美国电影业首次采用电影分级制度：G（针对普通观众）、M（针对成熟观众）、R（未经成人陪同，16岁以下禁止入场）和X（16岁以下禁止入场）。

paras.en: In 1985, a mudslide in Ponce, Puerto Rico, killed an estimated 500 people in the island's worst disaster of the 20th century.
paras.zh: 1985 年，波多黎各庞塞发生泥石流，造成约 500 人死亡，这是该岛 20 世纪最严重的灾难。

paras.en: In 1985, Palestinian terrorists hijacked the Italian cruise ship Achille Lauro after it left Alexandria, Egypt, killing one American.
paras.zh: 1985年，巴勒斯坦恐怖分子在离开埃及亚历山大港后劫持了意大利游轮Achille Lauro，造成一名美国人死亡。

paras.en: In 1991, Slovenia and Croatia formally declared secession from Yugoslavia.
paras.zh: 1991年，斯洛文尼亚和克罗地亚正式宣布脱离南斯拉夫。

paras.en: In 2003, Californians voted to recall Democratic Gov. Gray Davis and elected actor Arnold Schwarzenegger, a Republican, as their new governor.
paras.zh: 2003年，加利福尼亚州投票罢免民主党州长格雷·戴维斯，并选举共和党演员阿诺德·施瓦辛格为新州长。

paras.en: In 2004, Cambodian King Norodom Sihanouk abdicated the throne.
paras.zh: 2004年，柬埔寨国王诺罗敦·西哈努克退位。

paras.en: In 2005, the United Nations' International Atomic Energy Agency and its chief, Mohamed ElBaradei, won the Nobel Peace Prize.
paras.zh: 2005年，联合国国际原子能机构及其负责人穆罕默德·巴拉迪荣获诺贝尔和平奖。

paras.en: In 2009, a statue of blind and deaf 7-year-old Helen Keller at the moment she got a sense of language was unveiled at the U.S. Capitol. She is shown at a pump with water running into one hand while alphabet motions on her other hand (by teacher Anne Sullivan) spell "w-a-t-e-r." Keller went on to become a world-famous speaker and author of a dozen books.
paras.zh: 2009年，一尊盲聋哑的7岁海伦·凯勒获得语言感的雕像在美国国会大厦揭幕。照片中，她站在水泵前，一只手流着水，而另一只手则用​​字母动作拼写“w-a-t-e-r”（由安妮·沙利文老师完成）。凯勒后来成为世界著名的演讲家和十几本书的作者。

paras.en: In 2023, the Israel Defense Forces declared the country at war and launched large-scale military operations against Gaza after Hamas militants launched a surprise attack on Israeli land. During the attack, Hamas killed more than 1,200 people and took some 250 people hostages. Two years later, the Israel-Hamas war is ongoing.
paras.zh: 2023年，哈马斯武装分子对以色列领土发动突然袭击后，以色列国防军宣布国家进入战争状态，并对加沙地带发动大规模军事行动。袭击期间，哈马斯杀害了 1,200 多人，并劫持了约 250 人作为人质。两年后，以色列与哈马斯的战争仍在继续。

paras.en: In 2024, U.S.-based scientists Victor Ambros and Gary Ruvkun won the Nobel Prize for medicine and physiology for discovering microRNA molecules, which determine how genes behave.
paras.zh: 2024 年，美国科学家 Victor Ambros 和 Gary Ruvkun 因发现决定基因行为的 microRNA 分子而获得诺贝尔医学和生理学奖。

articles.title: KATSEYE, Joji, Noah Kahan & More Are Getting Special Releases for Record Store Day Black Friday
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: There’s a new reason for music enthusiasts to make a pit stop at their local record store this Black Friday.
paras.zh: 音乐爱好者在这个黑色星期五来到当地的唱片店有了一个新的理由。

paras.en: Record Store Day has unveiled its 2026 Black Friday lineup, bringing a massive assortment of limited-edition releases to independent record stores on Nov. 27. And while shoppers may be used to hunting for deals on TVs and tech, this year’s slate gives music fans plenty of picks to head to their local record shop instead.
paras.zh: 唱片店日 (Record Store Day) 公布了 2026 年黑色星期五的产品阵容，将于 11 月 27 日在独立唱片店推出大量限量版唱片。虽然购物者可能习惯于在电视和科技产品上寻找优惠商品，但今年的名单为乐迷提供了很多选择，让他们可以前往当地的唱片店。

paras.en: Among the biggest pop names on the list is KATSEYE, which will release The Dance Breaks on 12-inch yellow vinyl. The special edition brings the live dance-break arrangements of “Debut,” “Gnarly” and “Gabriela” from the group’s Beautiful Chaos Tour to vinyl for the first time. The release is also pressed with a KATSEYE logo etching. Both members of KATSEYE who are currently on hiatus from the group — Manon and Sophia — were on the Beautiful Chaos Tour and should be included in the recording.
paras.zh: 名单上最知名的流行歌手包括 KATSEYE，该公司将发行 12 英寸黄色黑胶唱片《The Dance Breaks》。特别版首次将乐队 Beautiful Chaos 巡演中的“Debut”、“Gnarly”和“Gabriela”的现场舞曲改编为黑胶唱片。该版本还刻有 KATSEYE 徽标蚀刻。 KATSEYE 的两位成员——Manon 和 Sophia——目前都在脱离乐队，他们都参加了 Beautiful Chaos 巡回演唱会，应该包含在录音中。

paras.en: KATSEYE isn’t the only newer-generation artist getting a limited-edition item. keshi, CORTIS and sombr are also represented on the lineup, as well as Holly Humberstone, who is releasing a 7-inch featuring performances from her BBC Radio 1 Live Lounge session. The latter pairs her rendition of “Cruel World” with a cover of Harry Styles’ “Coming Up Roses.”
paras.zh: KATSEYE 并不是唯一一位获得限量版作品的新一代艺术家。 keshi、CORTIS 和 sombr 也出现在阵容中，还有 Holly Humberstone，她将发行一张 7 英寸的专辑，其中收录了她在 BBC Radio 1 Live Lounge 会议上的表演。后者将她演唱的《Cruel World》与翻唱的 Harry Styles 的《Coming Up Roses》结合起来。

paras.en: Joji is also getting in on the fun with a deluxe edition of Piss In The Wind, featuring new tracks and instrumentals. Noah Kahan, meanwhile, has two releases on the list: a 7-inch featuring “Draw You Out,” his contribution to The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping soundtrack, as well as The Last of the Bugs, a 12-inch EP pressed on 180-gram Alpenglow vinyl.
paras.zh: Joji 还推出了豪华版《Piss In The Wind》，其中包含新曲目和乐器，也带来了乐趣。与此同时，诺亚·卡汉 (Noah Kahan) 的两张专辑上榜：一张 7 英寸的专辑《Draw You Out》，这是他为《饥饿游戏：日出》创作的《收割》原声带；还有《The Last of the Bugs》，一张 12 英寸的 EP，采用 180 克 Alpenglow 黑胶唱片压制而成。

paras.en: For fans who like their records with a side of nostalgia, there’s also something to dig into. The Rolling Stones’ Aftermath gets a clear-vinyl edition with additional package extras, while George Harrison’s 33 1/3 and self-titled album arrive as new zoetrope editions. Bob Seger & The Silver Bullet Band’s Night Moves gets a 50th-anniversary pressing through Third Man Records, and Joan Jett & the Blackhearts’ I Love Rock ‘N Roll receives a special “Shadow Album” edition.
paras.zh: 对于那些喜欢怀旧唱片的粉丝来说，还有一些值得挖掘的东西。滚石乐队的《Aftermath》推出了带有额外套装的透明黑胶唱片版本，而乔治·哈里森的 33 1/3 和同名专辑则以新的西洋镜版本推出。 Bob Seger & The Silver Bullet Band 的《Night Moves》通过 Third Man Records 发行 50 周年纪念专辑，而 Joan Jett & the Blackhearts 的《I Love Rock 'N Roll》则获得了特别的“Shadow Album”版本。

paras.en: The list also marks vinyl debuts for Barenaked Ladies’ Born on a Pirate Ship and Rock Spectacle, while Stevie Nicks’ Bella Donna, 2Pac’s Pac’s Life and New Edition’s Candy Girl are among the other catalog titles getting special pressings.
paras.zh: 该名单还标志着 Barenaked Ladies 的《Born on a Pirate Ship》和 Rock Spectacle 的黑胶唱片首次亮相，而 Stevie Nicks 的《Bella Donna》、2Pac 的《Pac's Life》和 New Edition 的《Candy Girl》都是其他受到特别压制的专辑。

paras.en: And if live music is more your speed, the lineup is stacked there, too. Prince, Joni Mitchell, Bruce Springsteen, Marianne Faithfull, Funkadelic and Billy Joel all have live releases included, alongside sets from Brigitte Calls Me Baby, the Old ’97s and Jeff Tweedy. Billy Idol and The B-52s both take listeners back to 1982 with archival performances, while jazz releases include recordings from Stan Getz, Charlie Parker and Bill Evans.
paras.zh: 如果您更喜欢现场音乐，这里也有很多阵容。 Prince、Joni Mitchell、Bruce Springsteen、Marianne Faithfull、Funkadelic 和 Billy Joel 都现场发行了专辑，此外还有 Brigitte Calls Me Baby、the Old '97s 和 Jeff Tweedy 的作品。 Billy Idol 和 The B-52s 都通过经典表演将听众带回到 1982 年，而爵士乐版本则包括 Stan Getz、Charlie Parker 和 Bill Evans 的唱片。

paras.en: The soundtrack section is also packed. A special Wicked package brings together music from both chapters of the film musical, while KPop Demon Hunters gets a holographic-art variant with additional inclusions.
paras.zh: 配乐部分也很丰富。一个特殊的 Wicked 包汇集了电影音乐剧两个章节的音乐，而 KPop Demon Hunters 则获得了带有额外内容的全息艺术变体。

paras.en: With more than 150 limited releases making their way to independent record stores, the 2026 RSD Black Friday lineup covers just about every corner of music fandom.
paras.zh: 2026 年 RSD 黑色星期五阵容有 150 多张限量发行的唱片进入独立唱片店，几乎涵盖了音乐迷的每一个角落。

paras.en: Record Store Day Black Friday takes place Nov. 27. The full list of releases, participating stores and additional details are available through Record Store Day.
paras.zh: 唱片店日黑色星期五于 11 月 27 日举行。完整的发行列表、参与商店和其他详细信息可通过唱片店日获取。

paras.en: Prime perks are looking prettier than ever. This year’s event runs Oct. 6 through Oct. 7, and Ariana Grande’s r.e.m. beauty lineup is joining the lineup, with select products marked down by as much as 30%.
paras.zh: 高级福利看起来比以往任何时候都更美好。亚马逊的 Prime Big Deal Days 是该零售商的秋季购物活动，为 Prime 会员提供 48 小时的特别优惠，涵盖从美容到科技的各种品类。今年的活动将于 10 月 6 日至 7 日举行，Ariana Grande 的 r.e.m.美妆系列也加入其中，部分产品降价高达 30%。

paras.en: That markdown matters for a line that has built a devoted following, especially when some r.e.m. beauty picks sell in the hundreds per month. If you’ve been waiting to try the Wicked star’s vegan makeup, this could be a smart moment to shop. Prime Big Deal Days is exclusive to Prime members, but new customers can enjoy the perks with a 30-day free trial.
paras.zh: 这种降价对于一个已经拥有忠实追随者的产品线来说很重要，尤其是当一些r.e.m.美容精选每月销售数百件。如果您一直在等待尝试这位 Wicked 明星的纯素化妆品，那么现在可能是明智的购物时机。 Prime Big Deal Days 专供 Prime 会员使用，但新客户可以享受 30 天免费试用的优惠。

paras.en: At a Glance: Ariana Grande’s r.e.m. beauty Products Sale During October Prime Day
paras.zh: 概览：爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 的 r.e.m.十月黄金日期间美容产品促销

paras.en: Get Prime to Enjoy the 2026 Amazon Prime Big Deal Days
paras.zh: 获取 Prime 享受 2026 年亚马逊 Prime 大优惠日

paras.en: Prime Big Deal Days is a membership-only event, so having an Amazon Prime subscription unlocks the deals on Oct. 6 and 7. In the U.S., Prime costs $14.99 monthly or $139 annually, while eligible new members can begin with a 30-day free trial. The membership also brings everyday extras, including fast shipping, Prime Video, Amazon Music, Prime Reading and Amazon Photos storage. Eligible young adults and students can access a lower-cost Prime option after a six-month trial, paying $7.49 monthly or $69 annually. If you continue after a trial, your membership renews according to your selected plan unless you cancel today.
paras.zh: Prime Big Deal Days 是一项仅限会员参加的活动，因此订阅 Amazon Prime 即可解锁 10 月 6 日和 7 日的优惠。在美国，Prime 月费为 14.99 美元，年费为 139 美元，符合条件的新会员可以开始 30 天免费试用。会员资格还带来日常附加服务，包括快速送货、Prime 视频、亚马逊音乐、Prime 阅读和亚马逊照片存储。符合条件的年轻人和学生可以在六个月试用后获得成本较低的 Prime 选项，每月支付 7.49 美元或每年支付 69 美元。如果您在试用后继续，您的会员资格将根据您选择的计划续订，除非您今天取消。

paras.en: Founded by Ariana Grande, r.e.m. beauty centers makeup around creativity, individuality and personal expression. The collection spans eyes, lips and complexion, with shades and formulas intended to work across different skin tones, textures and beauty preferences. Its products are made for simple everyday routines as well as more imaginative looks, giving shoppers room to experiment. The brand also emphasizes thoughtful, performance-focused formulas and multi-use products that fit easily into a modern makeup bag. Furthermore, every r.e.m. beauty formula is vegan, and the brand is cruelty-free, meaning it does not test its products on animals.
paras.zh: 由爱莉安娜·格兰德 (Ariana Grande) 创立，r.e.m.美容以创造力、个性和个人表达为中心。该系列涵盖眼部、唇部和肤色，其色调和配方旨在适应不同的肤色、纹理和美容偏好。其产品既适合简单的日常生活，也适合更具想象力的外观，为购物者提供了尝试的空间。该品牌还强调深思熟虑、注重性能的配方和可轻松放入现代化妆包的多用途产品。此外，每个 re.m.美容配方是纯素的，该品牌是零残忍的，这意味着它不会在动物身上测试其产品。

paras.en: Sophie Dunne is an E-Commerce Writer at Penske Media Corporation, writing across Billboard, Rolling Stone, The Hollywood Reporter, WWD and Footwear News. Originally from Ireland and based in Los Angeles, she previously worked at Static Media as a writer and editor across all brands, covering entertainment, lifestyle, fashion, shopping, sex and relationships, travel, home and garden, tech, health and wellness, history, and food. Her bylines have appeared in Women’s Health, The List, Women.com, Islands, Grunge, WebMD, and more. Before beginning her writing career in 2019, Sophie lived in Dubai for four years working as an Emirates Cabin Crew Member. Having traveled to 71 countries with the airline, she began writing for an LA-based publication as a travel writer during her final year. Sophie has a degree in Humanities from Carlow College, St. Patrick’s (now South East Technological University) in her native Ireland. She studied English, history, philosophy, and psychology.
paras.zh: Sophie Dunne 是 Penske Media Corporation 的电子商务撰稿人，为 Billboard、Rolling Stone、The Hollywood Reporter、WWD 和 Footwear News 撰稿。她来自爱尔兰，现居洛杉矶，此前曾在 Static Media 担任所有品牌的撰稿人和编辑，涵盖娱乐、生活方式、时尚、购物、性与人际关系、旅行、家居与园艺、科技、健康与保健、历史和食品。她的署名曾出现在《Women’s Health》、《The List》、《Women.com》、《Islands》、《Grunge》、《WebMD》等杂志上。在 2019 年开始写作生涯之前，索菲在迪拜生活了四年，担任阿联酋航空空乘人员。她曾随该航空公司去过 71 个国家/地区，并在最后一年开始以旅行作家的身份为洛杉矶的一家出版物撰写文章。索菲拥有祖国爱尔兰圣帕特里克卡洛学院（现东南科技大学）的人文学位。她学习英语、历史、哲学和心理学。

articles.title: Diddy Must Pay Nearly $500,000 for Failed NBC Defamation Lawsuit Over Documentary, Judge Rules
articles.author: Rachel Scharf

paras.en: Sean “Diddy” Combs has been ordered to foot a hefty legal bill after unsuccessfully suing over the 2025 Peacock documentary The Making of a Bad Boy.
paras.zh: “吹牛老爹”肖恩·库姆斯 (Sean “Diddy” Combs) 对 2025 年孔雀纪录片《坏男孩的诞生》提起诉讼，但未获成功，因此被勒令承担巨额法律费用。

paras.en: A Tuesday (Oct. 6) court order, obtained by Billboard, says Combs must repay $478,000 that NBCUniversal spent convincing a judge to dismiss the defamation lawsuit earlier this year. This amount, while significant, is only about half of the $990,000 charged by NBC’s attorneys at the elite law firm Gibson Dunn.
paras.zh: Billboard 获得的周二（10 月 6 日）法院命令称，库姆斯必须偿还 NBCUniversal 今年早些时候说服法官驳回诽谤诉讼所花费的 478,000 美元。这一金额虽然数额巨大，但仅相当于 NBC 精英律师事务所吉布森邓恩 (Gibson Dunn) 律师收取的 99 万美元费用的一半左右。

paras.en: Combs had sued NBC in early 2025 for $100 million, alleging The Making of a Bad Boy advanced a “false narrative” that he was involved in the deaths of The Notorious B.I.G. and Kim Porter. But Judge Phaedra F. Perry-Bond ruled this April that NBC followed the proper journalistic standards by making clear that Combs denies all such claims and that the interviewees who voiced the theories, including musician Al B. Sure!, had their own biases against the now-imprisoned mogul.
paras.zh: 库姆斯于 2025 年初起诉 NBC，索赔 1 亿美元，指控《坏男孩的制作》提出了“错误的叙述”，称他参与了臭名昭著的 B.I.G. 的死亡。和金·波特。但费德拉·F·佩里-邦德法官今年四月裁定，NBC 遵循了适当的新闻标准，明确表示库姆斯否认所有此类说法，并且表达这些理论的受访者，包括音乐家 Al B. Sure！，对这位现已入狱的大亨有自己的偏见。

paras.en: Judge Perry-Bond threw out Combs’ lawsuit under New York’s anti-SLAPP statute, which quickly disposes of meritless cases that threaten First Amendment-protected free speech. Under that law, a successful defendant can recoup the legal fees that they spent in the process.
paras.zh: 佩里-邦德法官根据纽约的反 SLAPP 法规驳回了库姆斯的诉讼，该法规迅速处理了威胁受第一修正案保护的言论自由的毫无根据的案件。根据该法律，胜诉的被告可以收回他们在此过程中花费的律师费。

paras.en: The judge ruled Monday that NBC indeed qualifies for attorney fee reimbursement in this situation. The judge accepted the hourly billing rates charged by a team of six Gibson Dunn lawyers, ranging from $915 for a junior associate to $1,980 for a senior partner.
paras.zh: 法官周一裁定，在这种情况下 NBC 确实有资格获得律师费报销。法官接受了由六名 Gibson Dunn 律师组成的团队收取的每小时计费费率，从初级律师的 915 美元到高级合伙人的 1,980 美元不等。

paras.en: “Although the court is cognizant that the rates charged here are higher than the customary rates, due to the publicity, complexity, quantum of damages, caliber and experience of the attorneys, the results achieved and the quality of the submissions and performance at oral argument, the court declines any reduction of the defendants’ hourly rates,” wrote Judge Perry-Bond.
paras.zh: 佩里-邦德法官写道：“尽管法院认识到这里收取的费率高于惯常费率，但考虑到律师的公开性、复杂性、损害赔偿数额、律师的能力和经验、所取得的结果以及提交材料的质量和口头辩论的表现，法院拒绝降低被告的每小时费率。”

paras.en: However, the judge did find that the amount of hours billed by Gibson Dunn was, at times, “excessive.” She trimmed a total of $512,000 from the $990,000 bill submitted by NBC — including $269,000 spent drafting a motion and $78,000 for internal office discussions — for a final fee award of $478,000.
paras.zh: 然而，法官确实发现吉布森·邓恩收取的工时费有时“过高”。她从 NBC 提交的 990,000 美元法案中总共削减了 512,000 美元，其中包括起草动议的 269,000 美元和用于内部办公室讨论的 78,000 美元，最终费用奖励为 478,000 美元。

paras.en: Reps for NBC did not immediately return a request for comment on the ruling Tuesday. A spokesperson for Combs told Billboard, “NBCUniversal sought nearly $1 million in attorneys’ fees, and the court found substantial portions of those fees excessive and unreasonable, cutting their request by more than half.”
paras.zh: NBC 的代表没有立即回复对周二裁决发表评论的请求。库姆斯的一位发言人告诉 Billboard，“NBCUniversal 要求支付近 100 万美元的律师费，法院发现这些费用的很大一部分过高且不合理，因此将他们的要求削减了一半以上。”

paras.en: Combs previously initiated the process of appealing to reinstate his claims against NBC, but the case was one of many dropped by his former law firm due to a money dispute last month. It was not immediately clear whether Combs still intends to pursue that appeal with different lawyers.
paras.zh: 库姆斯此前曾启动上诉程序，要求恢复对 NBC 的索赔，但该案是他的前律师事务所上个月因金钱纠纷而撤销的众多案件之一。目前尚不清楚库姆斯是否仍打算与其他律师一起上诉。

paras.en: The Bad Boy Records founder is currently serving prison time for arranging cross-country prostitution events known as “freak-offs.” He’s appealing, saying the sentence was unduly harsh since jurors acquitted him of more serious sex-trafficking and racketeering charges. Meanwhile, Combs still faces dozens of ongoing civil sexual misconduct lawsuits, in which he denies all wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 这位坏男孩唱片公司的创始人目前因安排被称为“怪胎”的跨国卖淫活动而正在监狱服刑。他正在上诉，称判决过于严厉，因为陪审员宣判他无罪，罪名是更严重的性交易和敲诈勒索罪。与此同时，库姆斯仍然面临数十起正在进行的民事不当性行为诉讼，他在这些诉讼中否认所有不当行为。

paras.en: Combs’ lawsuit against NBC was one of several attempts he’s made to go on the offensive amid the harsh media scrutiny of the last several years. While his claims against NBC were unsuccessful, he’s having better luck with a different defamation case against NewsNation. In that matter, a judge ruled last month that Combs can pursue discovery over news broadcasts that suggested he laced baby oil with drugs to incapacitate alleged sexual assault victims.
paras.zh: 库姆斯对 NBC 的诉讼是他在过去几年的严厉媒体审查中发起进攻的几次尝试之一。虽然他对 NBC 的指控没有成功，但他在另一起针对 NewsNation 的诽谤案中运气较好。在这件事上，一名法官上个月裁定，库姆斯可以通过新闻广播进行发现，这些新闻广播暗示他在婴儿油中掺入药物，以使所谓的性侵犯受害者丧失行为能力。

articles.title: October Prime Day 2026: What to Snag (and Skip) During Amazon’s 48-Hour Sale
articles.author: Erin Lassner

paras.en: If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.
paras.zh: 如果您通过我们网站上的链接购买独立审查的产品或服务，《好莱坞报道》可能会收到附属佣金。

paras.en: Nothing fails to roll off the tongue quite like Prime Big Deal Days. Regardless, Prime Day‘s clunkier sibling has a solid list of savings worth snapping up.
paras.zh: 没有什么比 Prime Big Deal Days 更让人垂涎欲滴了。无论如何，Prime Day 的笨重兄弟有一系列值得抢购的优惠。

paras.en: Even better, students and young adults ages 18 to 24 can get a six-month free trial to Amazon Prime. The plan will then auto-renew at $7.49 per month, half the price of a regular monthly Prime membership.
paras.zh: 更好的是，18 至 24 岁的学生和年轻人可以免费试用 6 个月的 Amazon Prime。该计划随后将以每月 7.49 美元的价格自动续订，是普通每月 Prime 会员价格的一半。

paras.en: Amazon Prime Big Deal Days runs from Tuesday, Oct. 6 at 12:01 a.m. PT through Wednesday, Oct. 7 at 11:59 p.m. PT. The Hollywood Reporter‘s shopping team is monitoring deals and updating this story as any new and noteworthy ones are added.
paras.zh: 亚马逊 Prime Big Deal Days 活动时间为太平洋时间 10 月 6 日星期二中午 12:01 至 10 月 7 日星期三晚上 11:59。 PT。 《好莱坞报道》的购物团队正在监控交易，并在添加任何新的和值得注意的交易时更新此故事。

paras.en: As someone who’s been covering Prime Day since 2018, I have found a few key categories that consistently deliver the most significant (and timely) savings. These include:
paras.zh: 作为自 2018 年以来一直关注 Prime Day 的人，我发现几个关键类别始终能够带来最显着（且及时）的节省。这些包括：

paras.en: - Streaming deals (i.e. free trials and subscription discounts to Paramount+, Peacock, Apple TV, etc.)
paras.zh: - 流媒体优惠（即 Paramount+、Peacock、Apple TV 等的免费试用和订阅折扣）

paras.en: - Household and everyday essentials (aka the stuff you need to buy regardless of if it’s discounted)
paras.zh: - 家庭和日常必需品（也就是无论是否打折你都需要购买的东西）

paras.en: - Holiday gifting (especially toys, collectibles and advent calendars)
paras.zh: - 节日礼物（尤其是玩具、收藏品和降临节日历）

paras.en: - Amazon devices (up to 65 percent off Kindle, Echo and Alexa, Fire TV, Ring, etc.)
paras.zh: - Amazon 设备（Kindle、Echo 和 Alexa、Fire TV、Ring 等高达 65% 折扣）

paras.en: - Top fashion from Shopbop’s Amazon storefront (the Amazon-owned retailer runs a corresponding sale)
paras.zh: - Shopbop 亚马逊店面的顶级时装（亚马逊旗下零售商进行相应的促销）

paras.en: See below for 15 standouts across these key categories.
paras.zh: 请参阅下文，了解这些关键类别中的 15 名杰出人物。

paras.en: Elemis Pro-Collagen Cleansing Balm, 3-in-1 Hydrating Facial Cleanser
paras.zh: Elemis 胶原蛋白洁面膏，三合一保湿洁面乳

paras.en: Boasting its deepest discount to date, Elemis’ cult-favorite cleansing balm is available (and discounted) in all five varieties: Original, Rose, Black Cherry, Green Fig and Fragrance-Free.
paras.zh: Elemis 最受欢迎的洁面膏拥有迄今为止最大的折扣，共有五个品种可供选择（并打折）：原味、玫瑰、黑樱桃、绿无花果和无香型。

paras.en: Elemis Pro-Collagen Marine Cream SPF 30, Anti-Wrinkle Moisturizer
paras.zh: Elemis Pro-Collagen Marine Cream SPF 30，抗皱保湿霜

paras.en: Another multipurpose workhorse from Elemis, serving as a daily moisturizer, sunblock and a radiant base layer for daily makeup.
paras.zh: Elemis 的另一款多用途主力产品，可用作日常保湿霜、防晒霜和日常化妆的亮泽打底层。

paras.en: As for the savings worth skipping, it really comes down to what’s going to see even further reductions during Black Friday and Cyber Monday. While it’s never a guarantee, we’d generally say to deprioritize TVs, laptops and other big-ticket electronics (not including Amazon-branded devices) along with major household appliances. In addition to the deeper discounts expected during the months ahead, competitor retailers (like The Home Depot and Best Buy) offer a wider selection of standout brands and models in said categories.
paras.zh: 至于值得跳过的节省，实际上取决于黑色星期五和网络星期一期间将进一步减少。虽然这永远不能保证，但我们通常会说，不要优先考虑电视、笔记本电脑和其他昂贵的电子产品（不包括亚马逊品牌的设备）以及主要家用电器。除了未来几个月预计会有更大的折扣外，竞争对手零售商（如家得宝和百思买）还提供上述类别中更广泛的杰出品牌和型号选择。

paras.en: Related: 9 Sales Events Worth Shopping This Week Aside From Amazon’s October Prime Day
paras.zh: 相关：除了亚马逊 10 月 Prime Day 之外，本周还有 9 个值得购物的促销活动

articles.title: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Mariah Carey Night Ends With Another Unexpected Elimination, Season 35’s Highest Score Yet: See the Scores, Who Went Home
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: [This story contains spoilers for episode five of Dancing With the Stars season 35.]
paras.zh: [本故事包含《与星共舞》第 35 季第五集的剧透。]

paras.en: Dancing With the Stars is obsessed with Mariah Carey, as the ballroom devoted one full night to honor the legendary singer-songwriter.
paras.zh: 与星共舞对玛丽亚·凯莉 (Mariah Carey) 非常着迷，舞厅用了一整晚的时间来纪念这位传奇歌手兼作曲家。

paras.en: For the fourth week of competition, couples performed the Grammy winner’s beloved hits, including “Emotions,” “Fantasy,” “Obsessed” and “Touch My Body.”
paras.zh: 在第四周的比赛中，情侣们表演了这位格莱美奖得主深受喜爱的热门歌曲，包括“Emotions”、“Fantasy”、“Obsessed”和“Touch My Body”。

paras.en: At the end of Mariah Carey Night, Ciara Miller and Brandon Armstrong were eliminated from DWTS, marking the second week in a row the show ended with a shocking elimination.
paras.zh: 在玛丽亚·凯莉之夜结束时，席亚拉·米勒和布兰登·阿姆斯特朗被 DWTS 淘汰，这标志着该节目连续第二周以令人震惊的淘汰结束。

paras.en: Celebrities still competing on season 35 include Tatyana Ali, Tyler Cameron, Jenna Dewan, Ezra Frech, Amber Glenn, Maura Higgins, Jackson Olson, Guillermo Rodriguez, Harry Shum Jr., Julia Stiles and Connor Wood.
paras.zh: 仍在参加第 35 季比赛的名人包括塔蒂亚娜·阿里、泰勒·卡梅隆、珍娜·迪万、埃兹拉·弗雷奇、安布尔·格伦、莫拉·希金斯、杰克逊·奥尔森、吉列尔莫·罗德里格斯、小哈里·岑、朱莉娅·斯蒂尔斯和康纳·伍德。

paras.en: 24/30 was the early high score for Mariah Carey Night, with three couples earning the score consecutively. One after the other, Ezra, Harry and Jenna each earned three eight paddles from the judges, marking Ezra and Jenna’s highest scores of the season thus far, respectively.
paras.zh: 24/30是玛丽亚·凯莉之夜的早期高分，三对夫妇连续得分。埃兹拉、哈利和珍娜相继从评委手中获得了三枚八球拍，分别创下了埃兹拉和珍娜本赛季迄今为止的最高分。

paras.en: They held the top leaderboard spot until Maura and Mark Ballas took the stage, earning the first nine of the season from Carrie Ann Inaba. They performed a Waltz to “If It’s Over,” landing the highest score of DWTS season 35 so far, a 25/30.
paras.zh: 他们一直保持着排行榜第一的位置，直到莫拉和马克·巴拉斯上台，从凯莉·安·伊纳巴手中赢得了本赛季的前九名。他们在“If It’s Over”中表演了华尔兹，获得了 DWTS 第 35 季迄今为止的最高分，即 25/30。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Guillermo and Witney Carson fell to the bottom of the leaderboard, scoring a 13/30 for their samba to Carey’s beloved “Obsessed.”
paras.zh: 在其他地方，Guillermo 和 Witney Carson 的桑巴舞得分为 13/30，在凯里心爱的“Obsessed”中跌落到排行榜底部。

paras.en: Ciara and Brandon performed a jazz to “Emotions,” and scored 21/30. Their scores matched that of Tyler and Sharna Burgess; Jackson and Emma Slater; and Julia and Ezra Sosa.
paras.zh: 席亚拉 (Ciara) 和布兰登 (Brandon) 表演了一首爵士乐《Emotions》，得分为 21/30。他们的分数与泰勒·伯吉斯和莎娜·伯吉斯的分数相当。杰克逊和艾玛·斯莱特；还有朱莉娅和埃兹拉·索萨。

paras.en: During last Tuesday’s Yacht Rock Night, Taylor Hanson and Britt Stewart were shockingly eliminated from the competition.
paras.zh: 在上周二的游艇摇滚之夜中，泰勒·汉森和布里特·斯图尔特令人震惊地被淘汰出局。

paras.en: The couple with the lowest combined total of judges’ scores and viewer votes is eliminated at the end of each DWTS episode. Each viewer is allowed up to 10 votes per couple, per voting method (via ABC’s website and by text).
paras.zh: 每集 DWTS 节目结束时，评委评分和观众投票合计最低的情侣将被淘汰。每种投票方式（通过 ABC 网站和短信）每对情侣最多允许每位观众投票 10 票。
