paras.en: "This is something that many of us have argued must be there for a good many years, and that many experiments have looked for," says Rajagopal, who was not directly involved with the new study.
paras.zh: “我们许多人都认为，这种现象一定已经存在很多年了，而且许多实验都在寻找这一点，”拉贾戈帕尔说，他没有直接参与这项新研究。

paras.en: "We've gained the first direct evidence that the quark indeed drags more plasma with it as it travels," Lee adds. "This will enable us to study the properties and behavior of this exotic fluid in unprecedented detail."
paras.zh: “我们获得了第一个直接证据，表明夸克在传播时确实会拖曳更多的等离子体，”李补充道。 “这将使我们能够以前所未有的细节研究这种奇异流体的特性和行为。”

paras.en: This work was supported, in part, by the U.S. Department of Energy.
paras.zh: 这项工作得到了美国能源部的部分支持。

articles.title: Scientists say this simple habit could strengthen your marriage

paras.en: Scientists say this simple habit could strengthen your marriage
paras.zh: 科学家称这个简单的习惯可以巩固你的婚姻

paras.en: Working out together, even with a simple walk, may help couples communicate better, handle conflict more peacefully, and strengthen their marriage.
paras.zh: 一起锻炼，即使是简单的散步，也可以帮助夫妻更好地沟通，更和平地处理冲突，并巩固他们的婚姻。

paras.en: - Couples who exercise together report better communication, healthier conflict resolution, and lower marital stress than those who work out alone. Even something as simple as taking a walk together may create valuable opportunities to talk, listen, and feel more connected.
paras.zh: - 一起锻炼的夫妻比单独锻炼的夫妻有更好的沟通、更健康的冲突解决方式以及更低的婚姻压力。即使是像一起散步这样简单的事情也可能创造宝贵的交谈、倾听和感觉更紧密联系的机会。

paras.en: Exercise is well known for supporting physical fitness and mental well being. New research from BYU suggests it may also offer benefits for marriage, particularly when spouses are active together.
paras.zh: 众所周知，锻炼可以支持身体健康和心理健康。杨百翰大学的新研究表明，它也可能为婚姻带来好处，特别是当配偶在一起活跃时。

paras.en: The study, recently published in Family Relations, found that couples who exercised together reported better communication, more effective conflict resolution and less marital stress than couples who did not share physical activity.
paras.zh: 这项研究最近发表在《家庭关系》杂志上，发现一起锻炼的夫妻比不一起锻炼的夫妻沟通更好，解决冲突更有效，婚姻压力也更小。

paras.en: The research was led by BYU School of Family Life professor Jeremy Yorgason with co-author Ashlyn Hiatt Mildenhall, who first became involved in the project as an undergraduate researcher at BYU.
paras.zh: 这项研究由杨百翰大学家庭生活学院教授 Jeremy Yorgason 和合著者 Ashlyn Hiatt Mildenhall 领导，后者首次参与该项目时还是杨百翰大学的本科生研究员。

paras.en: "Our findings suggest that conjoint exercise facilitates, in a small but significant way, the ability to resolve conflict peacefully," Yorgason said. "People reported more positive outcomes in communication and conflict resolution when they exercised together."
paras.zh: 约加森说：“我们的研究结果表明，联合演习以小而重要的方式促进了和平解决冲突的能力。” “人们在一起锻炼时表示，在沟通和解决冲突方面取得了更积极的成果。”

paras.en: Exercising Together Shows Stronger Relationship Benefits
paras.zh: 一起锻炼对人际关系有更大的好处

paras.en: To investigate the connection between exercise and marriage, researchers examined survey responses from nearly 1,700 young married couples enrolled in the nationally representative Couple Relationships and Transition Experiences (CREATE) study. The BYU project has tracked newly married couples throughout the United States for more than a decade.
paras.zh: 为了调查运动与婚姻之间的联系，研究人员检查了参与全国代表性夫妻关系和过渡经历 (CREATE) 研究的近 1,700 对年轻已婚夫妇的调查回复。十多年来，杨百翰大学项目一直在追踪美国各地的新婚夫妇。

paras.en: The researchers looked at both individual exercise and physical activity done together as a couple. They then compared those habits with three measures of relationship health: communication, conflict resolution and marital stress.
paras.zh: 研究人员观察了个人锻炼和夫妻一起进行的体育活动。然后，他们将这些习惯与衡量关系健康程度的三项指标进行了比较：沟通、冲突解决和婚姻压力。

paras.en: Both individual exercise and shared exercise were associated with healthier marriages. However, physical activity done together consistently showed stronger links to positive relationship outcomes than working out separately.
paras.zh: 个人锻炼和共同锻炼都与更健康的婚姻有关。然而，与单独锻炼相比，一起进行的体育活动始终显示出与积极关系结果的联系更强。

paras.en: "About 60% of husbands and wives in the sample said they exercised, but only about a third exercised together," Yorgason said. "That means about half the people who exercise are not exercising with their spouse. While the impact is not necessarily large, it is very consistent, which gives me confidence that it is influencing relationships in some meaningful way."
paras.zh: “样本中约 60% 的丈夫和妻子表示他们锻炼过，但只有约三分之一的人一起锻炼过，”约加森说。 “这意味着大约一半的锻炼者没有与配偶一起锻炼。虽然影响不一定很大，但效果非常一致，这让我相信它正在以某种有意义的方式影响人际关系。”

paras.en: Why Shared Exercise May Help Couples Connect
paras.zh: 为什么共同锻炼可以帮助夫妻建立联系

paras.en: Previous research has shown that spending leisure time together can benefit couples. This study narrowed the focus specifically to shared physical activity.
paras.zh: 先前的研究表明，一起度过休闲时光对夫妻有益。这项研究将重点缩小到共同的身体活动上。

paras.en: Researchers suggest that exercising together may naturally create more opportunities for conversation and positive interactions. Repeated moments of connection like these could help strengthen a relationship over time.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，一起锻炼自然可以创造更多对话和积极互动的机会。随着时间的推移，重复这样的联系时刻可以帮助加强关系。

paras.en: "Out of all three outcomes, exercise had the biggest impact on communication," Mildenhall said. "That's why it was interesting that walking was the number one reported exercise. It naturally provides opportunities to communicate."
paras.zh: “在所有三个结果中，锻炼对沟通的影响最大，”米尔登霍尔说。 “这就是为什么有趣的是，步行是报告中排名第一的运动。它自然提供了交流的机会。”

paras.en: Walking was the most common form of shared exercise reported by couples in the study. That finding suggests spouses may not need costly gym memberships or elaborate home workout equipment to experience the potential relationship benefits of being active together.
paras.zh: 散步是研究中夫妇报告的最常见的共同运动形式。这一发现表明，配偶可能不需要昂贵的健身房会员资格或精致的家庭健身器材来体验一起活跃对关系的潜在好处。

paras.en: Couples who exercised together also reported better listening and stronger feelings that their spouse heard and supported them. According to Yorgason, those interactions may help explain why shared physical activity was associated with healthier communication and better conflict resolution.
paras.zh: 一起锻炼的夫妻还表示，他们的配偶倾听和支持他们的声音更好，感觉更强烈。约加森认为，这些互动可能有助于解释为什么共同的身体活动与更健康的沟通和更好的冲突解决有关。

paras.en: The researchers emphasize that exercising together is not a solution for every relationship difficulty. For young couples, particularly those raising children, finding time for shared physical activity may require deliberate planning.
paras.zh: 研究人员强调，一起锻炼并不能解决所有关系问题。对于年轻夫妇，尤其是那些抚养孩子的夫妇来说，寻找时间进行共同的体育活动可能需要深思熟虑的计划。

paras.en: Still, the researchers say conjoint exercise can be one of several healthy habits that give couples regular opportunities to connect. Amid the competing demands of school, daily life and parenting, even something as simple as walking together may create valuable time for conversation and connection.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，研究人员表示，联合运动可能是为夫妻提供定期交流机会的几种健康习惯之一。在学校、日常生活和育儿的相互竞争的需求中，即使是像一起散步这样简单的事情也可以创造宝贵的交谈和联系时间。

articles.title: What happens in the brain when cannabis makes you anxious?

paras.en: What happens in the brain when cannabis makes you anxious?
paras.zh: 当大麻让你焦虑时，大脑会发生什么？

paras.en: Scientists have pinpointed brain cells that may explain why cannabis can suddenly turn a calm experience into intense anxiety.
paras.zh: 科学家们已经查明了脑细胞，这或许可以解释为什么大麻会突然将平静的经历变成强烈的焦虑。

paras.en: - Cannabinoids may intensify anxiety by removing a natural brake on specific neurons in the brainâs fear center, particularly during stressful situations. In mice, shutting down those neurons sharply reduced cannabinoid-related anxious behavior.
paras.zh: - 大麻素可能会通过消除大脑恐惧中心特定神经元的自然制动来加剧焦虑，特别是在有压力的情况下。在小鼠中，关闭这些神经元可大幅减少与大麻素相关的焦虑行为。

paras.en: Northwestern scientists have identified, for the first time, a specific group of neurons -- cells in the brain -- that appear to contribute to anxiety caused by cannabinoid drugs, particularly when those drugs are combined with stressful conditions. Cannabinoids are a category of substances that includes THC, the main psychoactive ingredient in cannabis.
paras.zh: 西北大学的科学家首次发现了一组特定的神经元（大脑中的细胞），它们似乎会导致大麻素药物引起的焦虑，特别是当这些药物与压力条件相结合时。大麻素是一类物质，其中包括大麻中主要的精神活性成分四氢大麻酚 (THC)。

paras.en: To investigate how cannabinoids influence fear and anxiety, researchers exposed mice to a threatening smell derived from fox urine. Before encountering the odor, the animals were given either a placebo or a synthetic cannabinoid drug.
paras.zh: 为了研究大麻素如何影响恐惧和焦虑，研究人员让小鼠接触来自狐狸尿液的威胁气味。在遇到这种气味之前，给这些动物服用安慰剂或合成大麻素药物。

paras.en: Mice that received the cannabinoid froze more frequently and spent less time exploring the predator scent. Researchers traced these anxiety related behaviors to increased activity in a small population of brain cells known as somatostatin neurons. These neurons are located in the central amygdala, an area of the brain involved in processing fear and stress.
paras.zh: 接受大麻素的小鼠更频繁地僵住，并且花更少的时间探索捕食者的气味。研究人员将这些与焦虑相关的行为归因于一小群被称为生长抑素神经元的脑细胞活动的增加。这些神经元位于杏仁核中央，这是大脑中负责处理恐惧和压力的区域。

paras.en: When the researchers genetically silenced the somatostatin neurons, the mice that received the cannabinoid became less likely to avoid the predator odor. The result suggested that these cells play an important role in producing the anxious response.
paras.zh: 当研究人员从基因上沉默生长抑素神经元时，接受大麻素的小鼠变得不太可能避开捕食者的气味。结果表明这些细胞在产生焦虑反应中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: "The results of this study could explain why a good trip can turn bad pretty quickly if people consume too much cannabis or the situation they are in turns stressful or scary," said study senior author Dr. Sachin Patel, chair of psychiatry and behavioral sciences at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、西北大学范伯格医学院精神病学和行为科学系主任萨钦·帕特尔博士说：“这项研究的结果可以解释为什么如果人们吸食太多大麻，或者他们的处境变得紧张或可怕，一次美好的旅行很快就会变得糟糕。”

paras.en: The study was published on Oct. 2 in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 该研究于 10 月 2 日发表在《自然通讯》杂志上。

paras.en: Patel and his colleagues gave mice several different doses of the synthetic cannabinoid and measured their reactions to the predator odor. The researchers recorded how much time the animals spent near the scent and whether they responded by freezing or fleeing.
paras.zh: 帕特尔和他的同事给老鼠注射了几种不同剂量的合成大麻素，并测量了它们对捕食者气味的反应。研究人员记录了动物在气味附近停留的时间以及它们的反应是冻结还是逃跑。

paras.en: At the same time, the team monitored activity inside the brain by implanting a small microscope into the mice's brain.
paras.zh: 与此同时，研究小组通过将小型显微镜植入小鼠大脑来监测大脑内部的活动。

paras.en: Researchers also studied brain tissue to determine how cannabinoids changed communication between neurons. Their experiments showed that the drug weakened a natural brain mechanism that normally acts as a "brake" on somatostatin neurons. With that restraint reduced, the neurons became more active.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了脑组织，以确定大麻素如何改变神经元之间的通讯。他们的实验表明，这种药物削弱了通常对生长抑素神经元起“刹车”作用的自然大脑机制。随着这种限制的减少，神经元变得更加活跃。

paras.en: "Higher doses of cannabinoids and environmental stress worked together to synergistically release the 'brake' on the central amygdala, which in turn drove excessive anxiety," Patel explained.
paras.zh: “较高剂量的大麻素和环境压力共同作用，协同释放中央杏仁核的‘刹车’，进而导致过度焦虑，”帕特尔解释道。

paras.en: Cannabis use in the U.S. has steadily increased in recent years. At the same time, emergency department visits involving adverse effects from the drug have also risen.
paras.zh: 近年来，美国的大麻使用量稳步增加。与此同时，涉及药物不良反应的急诊就诊人数也有所增加。

paras.en: Previous studies have found an association between cannabis use and a higher long term risk of anxiety. Anxiety and mood disorders are also on the rise globally.
paras.zh: 先前的研究发现大麻的使用与较高的长期焦虑风险之间存在关联。全球范围内，焦虑和情绪障碍也在增加。

paras.en: "Understanding how cannabis affects brain function to generate its psychoactive effects could ultimately reveal new ways to counteract negative consequences should they arise in some people," Patel said.
paras.zh: 帕特尔说：“了解大麻如何影响大脑功能以产生其精神作用，最终可能会揭示新的方法来抵消某些人身上出现的负面后果。”

paras.en: The researchers believe the findings may also have relevance beyond cannabis related side effects. Patel said the same neurons could potentially represent a broader target for understanding or reducing anxiety.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这些发现可能还具有超越大麻相关副作用的相关性。帕特尔说，相同的神经元可能代表理解或减少焦虑的更广泛目标。

paras.en: "Suppressing the activity of somatostatin neurons in the central amygdala could represent a final pathway for reducing anxiety symptoms, not just in the context of cannabis side effects," he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说：“抑制中央杏仁核中生长抑素神经元的活动可能是减少焦虑症状的最终途径，而不仅仅是在大麻副作用的情况下。”

paras.en: Other Northwestern co-authors are Farhana Yasmin, Saptarnab Naskar, Danyal Zaidi, Isaac Kandil, Michelle Kwon and Dr. Luis Rosas-Vidal.
paras.zh: 西北大学的其他合著者包括 Farhana Yasmin、Saptarnab Naskar、Danyal Zaidi、Isaac Kandil、Michelle Kwon 和 Luis Rosas-Vidal 博士。

paras.en: The study is titled, "Cannabinoid Modulation of Central Amygdala Population Dynamics During Threat Investigation." It was supported by the National Institutes of Health (grants MH100785 and K08 MH126166) and the Brain & Behavior Research Foundation's Young Investigator Awards.
paras.zh: 该研究的标题是“威胁调查期间大麻素对中央杏仁核种群动态的调节”。它得到了美国国立卫生研究院（授予 MH100785 和 K08 MH126166）和大脑与行为研究基金会青年研究者奖的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by Northwestern University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由西北大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Farhana Yasmin, Saptarnab Naskar, Danyal Zaidi, Isaac Kandil, Michelle Kwon, Luis E. Rosas-Vidal, Sachin Patel. Cannabinoid modulation of central amygdala population dynamics during threat investigation. Nature Communications, 2026; 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-77957-4
paras.zh: - Farhana Yasmin、Saptarnab Naskar、Danyal Zaidi、Isaac Kandil、Michelle Kwon、Luis E. Rosas-Vidal、Sachin Patel。威胁调查期间大麻素对中央杏仁核种群动态的调节。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI：10.1038/s41467-026-77957-4

articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间公司正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

paras.en: The Business Combination will be submitted to shareholders of Inflection Point for their consideration. In connection with the Business Combination, IPFX Pubco, Inc., Inflection Point and Quantum Space intend to file a Registration Statement with the SEC, which will include a proxy statement/prospectus and certain other related documents, which will serve as both the proxy statement to be distributed to shareholders of Inflection Point in connection with its solicitation for proxies for the vote by its shareholders in connection with the Business Combination and other matters to be described in the Registration Statement, as well as the prospectus relating to the offer and sale of the securities to be issued to securityholders of Inflection Point and equityholders of Quantum Space in connection with the completion of the Business Combination. After the Registration Statement is declared effective, Inflection Point will mail a definitive proxy statement and other relevant documents to its shareholders as of the record date established for voting on the Business Combination. This communication is not a substitute for the Registration Statement, the definitive proxy statement/prospectus or any other document that Inflection Point will send to its shareholders in connection with the Business Combination.

articles.title: NASA’s Webb Captures Commotion From Nebula’s Stellar Jets

paras.en: NASA’s Webb Captures Commotion From Nebula’s Stellar Jets
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的韦伯捕捉到了星云恒星喷流的骚动

paras.en: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has revealed many protostars and stars within the glowing gases of NGC 7129. Hot, atomic hydrogen gas is shown here in the golden region, while cooler, molecular hydrogen gas, shocked by embedded protostars, is represented in red.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜在 NGC 7129 的发光气体中发现了许多原恒星和恒星。金色区域显示了热的原子氢气，而受到嵌入式原恒星冲击的较冷的分子氢气则以红色表示。

paras.en: A cauldron of cosmic creation is being revealed in a new image from NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope. Webb has unveiled numerous stars formerly hidden by clouds of dust in a stellar nursery known as NGC 7129, which resides about 3,300 light-years from Earth.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的新图像揭示了宇宙创造的大锅。韦伯揭示了许多以前隐藏在尘埃云中的恒星，这些恒星被称为 NGC 7129，距离地球约 3,300 光年。

paras.en: Stars, the engines of elemental creation, have life cycles that begin with their birth in molecular clouds – cold, dense regions of dust and gas. Because of these dusty cocoons, young stars are often impossible to view by many telescopes, particularly those incapable of capturing infrared light. Webb, however, has a high degree of infrared sensitivity, allowing astronomers to peer through that dust and study the beginning of the star life cycle.
paras.zh: 恒星是元素创造的引擎，其生命周期始于它们在分子云（寒冷、密集的尘埃和气体区域）中的诞生。由于这些布满灰尘的茧，许多望远镜通常无法观察到年轻的恒星，特别是那些无法捕获红外光的望远镜。然而，韦伯具有高度的红外敏感性，使天文学家能够透过灰尘观察并研究恒星生命周期的开始。

paras.en: NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope has revealed many protostars and stars within the glowing gases of NGC 7129. Hot, atomic hydrogen gas is shown here in the golden region, while cooler, molecular hydrogen gas, shocked by embedded protostars, is represented in red.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜在 NGC 7129 的发光气体中发现了许多原恒星和恒星。金色区域显示了热的原子氢气，而受到嵌入式原恒星冲击的较冷的分子氢气则以红色表示。

paras.en: Image: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; Image Processing: Alyssa Pagan (STScI)
paras.zh: 图片来源：NASA、ESA、CSA、STScI；图像处理：Alyssa Pagan (STScI)

paras.en: The stars from this cluster are in different stages of their development, as the more massive stars form and evolve the fastest. The most massive (and the most mature) is the region’s luminous central star, LkH(alpha) 234 (pronounced Lick-H-alpha). This star, which sports the image’s most prominent diffraction pattern, is a pre-main-sequence star weighing around 5 to 8 times the mass of our Sun. Pre-main-sequence stars like these have mostly finished gathering mass and are contracting under the force of gravity, causing their temperatures to rise. In time, this star will fuse its own hydrogen like our Sun.
paras.zh: 该星团中的恒星处于不同的发展阶段，质量越大的恒星形成和演化速度最快。质量最大（也是最成熟）的是该区域的发光中心恒星 LkH(alpha) 234（发音为 Lick-H-alpha）。这颗恒星具有图像中最显着的衍射图案，是一颗前主序恒星，重量约为太阳质量的 5 至 8 倍。像这样的前主序恒星大部分已经完成了质量聚集，并在重力作用下收缩，导致它们的温度升高。随着时间的推移，这颗恒星将像我们的太阳一样融合自己的氢。

paras.en: The cavity to its left, which appears in gold and spans about 3.5 light-years, is the largest demonstration of the central star’s impact. Outflows from an earlier stage of the star’s life cycle carve into the dense molecular cloud of hydrogen. Both the outflows and the star’s light energize the gas, causing it to glow. While much of this hydrogen gas is blown away, a large amount is also compressed, creating the conditions for even more stars to form.
paras.zh: 其左侧的空腔呈金色，跨度约 3.5 光年，是中央恒星撞击的最大展示。恒星生命周期早期阶段的流出物雕刻成致密的氢分子云。流出物和恒星的光都为气体提供能量，使其发光。虽然大部分氢气被吹走，但也有大量氢气被压缩，为更多恒星的形成创造了条件。

paras.en: Interactive: The Colorful Clouds of NGC 7129
paras.zh: 互动：NGC 7129 的彩云

paras.en: Explore the details of NGC 7129 in to uncover the hidden features and activity within the clouds of this young star-forming region. In this interactive, venture to individual points of interest or follow guided tours through related locations and stories. Launch in full-screen for the complete interactive experience — or view directly in your browser.
paras.zh: 探索 NGC 7129 的细节，揭示这个年轻恒星形成区域云层中隐藏的特征和活动。在这种互动中，您可以探索各个兴趣点，或者跟随导游游览相关地点和故事。以全屏启动以获得完整的交互式体验 - 或直接在浏览器中查看。

paras.en: A few of these stars are visible within the cavity. Several of them are also pre-main-sequence and emit stellar winds. The nearby bow shocks, the curved compressed gas that appears near the stars, are created as those winds push into the energetic gas and create their own, smaller cavities.
paras.zh: 其中一些恒星在空腔内可见。其中一些也是前主序并发出恒星风。附近的弓形激波，即恒星附近出现的弯曲压缩气体，是当这些风推入高能气体并形成自己的较小空腔时产生的。

paras.en: Together, the central and embedded stars also create the sharp ridge seen at the top of the golden cavity. Their light generates a hot environment that pushes against the colder and denser molecular gas outside the cavity, and creates a boundary known as a photodissociation region. In this region, the molecules of hydrogen break down into atoms. By influencing the temperature and chemistry of the region, this collection of stars offers insight into how these molecular clouds will gradually erode over millions of years.
paras.zh: 中央和嵌入的星星一起也形成了金色空腔顶部看到的尖锐脊线。它们的光产生一个热环境，推动腔外较冷且较稠密的分子气体，并形成一个称为光解离区域的边界。在这个区域，氢分子分解成原子。通过影响该区域的温度和化学成分，这组恒星让我们深入了解这些分子云将如何在数百万年的时间内逐渐侵蚀。

paras.en: The region to the right of the central star narrates a different, but equally chaotic tale. This clumpy matter represented in red hides much younger objects than those on the left: protostars. The protostar stage is earlier than the pre-main-sequence stage and occurs after molecular clouds of gas and dust initially compress and fragment.
paras.zh: 中央恒星右侧的区域讲述了一个不同但同样混乱的故事。这种用红色表示的块状物质隐藏着比左边更年轻的物体：原恒星。原恒星阶段早于前主序阶段，发生在气体和尘埃分子云最初压缩和破碎之后。

paras.en: As the protostars accumulate matter and increase their mass, they eject outflows of superheated material. These outflows interact with the dense, gray, translucent matter the protostars are wrapped within, creating shocks that cause a textured appearance. The red glow is also the result of the interaction. Multiple outflows from multiple stars overlap from our point of view, leading to the scene’s chaotic look.
paras.zh: 当原恒星积累物质并增加质量时，它们会喷射出过热物质。这些流出物与包裹着原恒星的致密、灰色、半透明物质相互作用，产生冲击，从而产生纹理外观。红光也是相互作用的结果。从我们的角度来看，来自多个恒星的多次流出重叠，导致场景看起来很混乱。

paras.en: Image: NGC 7129 Side-by-Side (Spitzer and Webb Image)
paras.zh: 图片：NGC 7129 并排（斯皮策和韦伯图像）

paras.en: NASA’s retired Spitzer Space Telescope observed the gas and dust within NGC 7129; however, NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope’s improved resolution shows more detailed gas and dust filaments, along with many background galaxies.
paras.zh: NASA 退役的斯皮策太空望远镜观察到了 NGC 7129 内的气体和尘埃；然而，美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜分辨率的提高显示了更详细的气体和尘埃丝，以及许多背景星系。

paras.en: More of these protostellar outflows can be seen at the upper left of the image, near a blue-colored nebula. The center of this blue region hosts a protostar surrounded by a donut-shaped disk of material. This disk casts a shadow against the surrounding nebula, reminiscent of a similar structure known as the “Bat Shadow” that was observed by NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope.
paras.zh: 在图像的左上方，靠近蓝色星云的地方可以看到更多的原恒星流出物。这个蓝色区域的中心有一颗原恒星，周围环绕着一个环形的物质盘。这个圆盘在周围的星云上投下阴影，让人想起美国宇航局哈勃太空望远镜观察到的被称为“蝙蝠阴影”的类似结构。

paras.en: Webb’s high spatial resolution reveals many rich structures in the region’s gas, building on research done previously by NASA’s retired Spitzer Space Telescope. Astronomers will continue to use this Webb data to study how the stars and protostars in this region influence the surrounding gas and dust.
paras.zh: 韦伯的高空间分辨率揭示了该地区气体中许多丰富的结构，这是建立在美国宇航局退役的斯皮策太空望远镜之前所做的研究的基础上的。天文学家将继续利用韦伯数据来研究该区域的恒星和原恒星如何影响周围的气体和尘埃。

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope is the world’s premier space science observatory. Webb is solving mysteries in our solar system, looking beyond to distant worlds around other stars, and probing the mysterious structures and origins of our universe and our place in it. Webb is an international program led by NASA with its partners, ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency).
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜是世界上首屈一指的太空科学天文台。韦伯正在解开太阳系中的谜团，展望其他恒星周围的遥远世界，并探索宇宙的神秘结构和起源以及我们在其中的位置。韦伯是由 NASA 及其合作伙伴 ESA（欧洲航天局）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）领导的一项国际计划。

articles.title: Lunar Grounding Challenge
articles.author: Bailey Light

paras.en: As an astronaut traverses the lunar South Pole, tribocharging from walking on the lunar surface and plasma charging from the ambient plasma generate electric charge on the spacesuit. This problem is severely compounded when entering lunar shadows and Permanently Shadowed Regions (PSRs). In these dark zones, the spacesuit can buildup a substantial negative potential due to a lack of ambient ion flux and the absence of photoelectron emission to balance ambient electron collection.
paras.zh: 当宇航员穿越月球南极时，在月球表面行走产生的摩擦充电和周围等离子体产生的等离子体充电会在宇航服上产生电荷。当进入月球阴影和永久阴影区域（PSR）时，这个问题会变得更加复杂。在这些黑暗区域中，由于缺乏环境离子通量和缺乏光电子发射来平衡环境电子收集，宇航服可能会积累大量负电势。

paras.en: The risk occurs when an astronaut returns to the spacecraft. Because the lunar surface lacks a natural environmental mechanism to bleed the charge accumulated on spacesuit away, the astronaut may become a walking, high voltage capacitor.
paras.zh: 当宇航员返回航天器时，就会出现这种风险。由于月球表面缺乏自然环境机制来排出宇航服上积累的电荷，宇航员可能会变成一个行走的高压电容器。

paras.en: In the sunlit region, the stationary lander will hold slightly positive electrical potential. When a highly negatively-charged astronaut approaches the vehicle, the extreme voltage differential can trigger electrostatic discharge (an instantaneous electrical arc, or a spark) during physical contact. A rapid discharge from the astronaut to the lander risks degrading vital suit layers, damaging sensitive suit electronics, threatening the oxygen-rich environment inside the suit, and delivering dangerous electrical shocks to the crew.
paras.zh: 在阳光照射的区域，固定着陆器将保持轻微的正电势。当带高度负电荷的宇航员接近飞行器时，极端的电压差可能会在物理接触过程中触发静电放电（瞬时电弧或火花）。从宇航员到着陆器的快速放电可能会导致重要的宇航服层退化，损坏敏感的宇航服电子设备，威胁宇航服内部的富氧环境，并给机组人员带来危险的电击。

paras.en: Through the Lunar Grounding Challenge, NASA is seeking innovative designs and operational solutions to provide a lunar bringing to equilibrium capability to safely discharge a suited astronaut from high triboelectric charge buildup during lunar surface EVAs in the South Pole. This challenge seeks innovative concepts for an Electrostatic Discharge (ESD) mitigation solution to neutralize the astronaut in a safe and timely manner under this extreme charge differential before astronauts directly interact with the lander.
paras.zh: 通过月球接地挑战，美国宇航局正在寻求创新的设计和操作解决方案，以提供月球达到平衡的能力，以便在南极的月球表面 EVA 期间安全地释放合适的宇航员从高摩擦电荷积聚中释放出来。该挑战寻求静电放电（ESD）缓解解决方案的创新概念，以便在宇航员与着陆器直接互动之前，在这种极端的电荷差异下安全及时地消除宇航员的静电。

articles.title: More than 184,000 displaced as fighting intensifies in Yemen

paras.en: More than 184,000 displaced as fighting intensifies in Yemen
paras.zh: 也门战斗加剧导致超过184,000人流离失所

paras.en: Intense fighting in Yemen has forced more than 184,000 people from their homes since the start of August, most of them since early September, the UN migration agency (IOM) said on Monday.
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构 (IOM) 周一表示，自 8 月初以来，也门的激烈战斗已迫使超过 184,000 人离开家园，其中大多数是从 9 月初开始的。

paras.en: In the week to 3 October alone, the International Organisation for Migration recorded nearly 21,800 people who had been displaced at least once – a 26 per cent increase from the previous week.
paras.zh: 仅截至 10 月 3 日的一周内，国际移民组织记录就有近 21,800 人至少流离失所一次，比前一周增加了 26%。

paras.en: A further 6,474 were displaced on 4 October. All are in need of food, shelter and other basic humanitarian aid.
paras.zh: 10 月 4 日，又有 6,474 人流离失所。所有人都需要食物、住所和其他基本人道主义援助。

paras.en: “As the conflict intensifies, more and more people are thrown into an appalling cycle of displacement, living in fear of their lives and with their futures uncertain,” said IOM Director General Amy Pope, calling on the international community to do more to secure humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织总干事艾米·波普表示：“随着冲突加剧，越来越多的人陷入令人震惊的流​​离失所循环，生活在对生命的恐惧之中，未来充满不确定性。”她呼吁国际社会采取更多行动，确保人道主义准入。

paras.en: An IOM assessment at three displacement sites in Ma’rib last week found that the lack of safe shelter was the most critical concern.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织上周对马里卜三个流离失所地点进行的评估发现，缺乏安全住所是最严重的问题。

paras.en: Some families are sleeping in the open, exposing them to violence and to the effects of the conflict, including airstrikes. Women and girls raised the shortage of appropriate latrines.
paras.zh: 一些家庭露天睡觉，使他们面临暴力和冲突的影响，包括空袭。妇女和女童提出了缺乏适当厕所的问题。

paras.en: Approximately 45 per cent of households assessed had been displaced before and had lost assets and livelihoods, leaving them less able to cope and at risk of turning to harmful strategies such as child labour, IOM warned.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织警告说，大约 45% 的接受评估的家庭之前曾流离失所，失去了资产和生计，这使得他们的应对能力较差，并面临转向童工等有害策略的风险。

paras.en: The agency is working with local authorities and partners to provide emergency shelter, household items, cash, clean water, sanitation and protection services. With the situation volatile, further displacement is possible in the coming days, it said.
paras.zh: 该机构正在与地方当局和合作伙伴合作，提供紧急住所、家居用品、现金、清洁水、卫生和保护服务。报告称，由于局势不稳定，未来几天可能会出现更多流离失所。

paras.en: The UN World Health Organization (WHO) reported more than 5,100 casualties since 6 August, including 959 deaths, according to its latest situation report.
paras.zh: 联合国世界卫生组织（WHO）最新情况报告显示，自8月6日以来，已有超过5100人伤亡，其中959人死亡。

paras.en: Cholera cases have tripled in as many weeks and measles is spreading, the agency said, while teams face challenges reaching the injured during the so-called “golden hour”; the critical period after a traumatic injury when treatment matters most.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，霍乱病例在几周内增加了两倍，麻疹正在蔓延，而在所谓的“黄金时段”，救援队面临着救助伤者的挑战；外伤后的关键时期，治疗最为重要。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the UN World Food Programme (WFP) on Monday welcomed the release of one of its staff members who had been arbitrarily detained in Yemen, saying it was relieved he had been reunited with his family.
paras.zh: 与此同时，联合国世界粮食计划署（粮食计划署）周一对一名在也门被任意拘留的工作人员获释表示欢迎，并表示对他与家人团聚感到欣慰。

paras.en: WFP said it stood in solidarity with the 72 UN personnel and five former UN personnel who remain detained, and joined the UN Secretary-General in calling for the release of all detained UN staff and other humanitarian workers.
paras.zh: 粮食计划署表示声援仍被拘留的 72 名联合国人员和 5 名前联合国人员，并与联合国秘书长一起呼吁释放所有被拘留的联合国工作人员和其他人道主义工作者。

paras.en: The agency said it supported constructive dialogue with the Houthi de facto authorities to build on the release and secure further releases.
paras.zh: 该机构表示，它支持与胡塞事实上的当局进行建设性对话，以在释放的基础上进一步释放并确保进一步释放。

paras.en: Deputy Spokesperson for the UN Secretary General, Farhan Haq, welcomed the staffer’s release and said: “The Secretary-General has called for the release of all detained UN personnel and other humanitarian personnel in Yemen.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长副发言人法尔汉·哈克对这名工作人员的释放表示欢迎，并表示：“秘书长呼吁释放也门所有被拘留的联合国人员和其他人道主义人员。”

paras.en: During his briefing he said that the UN will continue to “pursue every possible avenue to secure their immediate and safe release, including through engagements with the Houthi de facto authorities”.
paras.zh: 他在通报中表示，联合国将继续“寻求一切可能的途径，确保他们立即安全获释，包括与胡塞事实上的当局接触”。

articles.title: ‘The clock on AI regulation is ticking’, warns UN rights chief

paras.en: ‘The clock on AI regulation is ticking’, warns UN rights chief
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员警告说，“人工智能监管的时间正在流逝”

paras.en: The world is running out of time to put guardrails on artificial intelligence, UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk warned Monday, as a “ruthless race” between companies and countries raises concerns about human safety and even humanity’s survival.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周一警告说，世界已经没有时间为人工智能设置护栏了，因为公司和国家之间的“残酷竞赛”引发了对人类安全甚至人类生存的担忧。

paras.en: Speaking in the UK at an AI and Human Rights Summit in Oxford on Monday, Mr. Türk said the technology could deliver dazzling advances in science, health, education – and even human rights work.
paras.zh: 周一，蒂尔克在英国牛津举行的人工智能和人权峰会上发表讲话时表示，这项技术可以在科学、健康、教育甚至人权工作方面带来令人眼花缭乱的进步。

paras.en: But its tools are being built and controlled by a select few, without public oversight, and are already doing things their creators cannot fully predict or manage.
paras.zh: 但其工具是由少数人在没有公众监督的情况下构建和控制的，并且已经在做其创建者无法完全预测或管理的事情。

paras.en: He warned that AI could undermine equality, freedom, privacy and public debate in subtle ways, “letting dystopia creep in unnoticed”. Entire populations could be cut off from communication, clean water, heating and financial services “at the click of a button”.
paras.zh: 他警告说，人工智能可能会以微妙的方式破坏平等、自由、隐私和公共辩论，“让反乌托邦在不知不觉中蔓延”。 “只需按一下按钮”，整个人口的通讯、清洁水、供暖和金融服务就可能被切断。

paras.en: He called for urgent action to prohibit machines from deciding who lives and who dies, noting that AI is already changing the face of warfare.
paras.zh: 他呼吁采取紧急行动，禁止机器决定谁生谁死，并指出人工智能已经在改变战争的面貌。

paras.en: He also cited studies showing students who rely on AI retain less and think less independently, and asked whether the world is heading for a future in which no one can understand, question or even guide the technology.
paras.zh: 他还引用了一些研究，显示依赖人工智能的学生记忆力和独立思考能力较差，并询问世界是否正走向一个无人能理解、质疑甚至指导这项技术的未来。

paras.en: As the UN rights chief was addressing the summit in the UK, New York City Council - home to the financial heart of the US economy - was also holding a rare Committee of the Whole to examine AI risks to New Yorkers.
paras.zh: 当联合国人权事务高级专员在英国峰会上发表讲话时，美国经济的金融中心纽约市议会也罕见地召开了全体委员会会议，以审查人工智能对纽约人造成的风险。

paras.en: The council is considering 10 bills to regulate AI across the nation's largest city, with testimony from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta.
paras.zh: 该委员会正在考虑 10 项法案来监管全国最大城市的人工智能，Anthropic、OpenAI、谷歌和 Meta 都提供了证词。

paras.en: Mr. Türk called for mandatory human rights safeguards and due diligence in how AI is developed and used, adapted as the technology evolves. Countries that host AI companies, or have influence over their supply chains, must require them to act responsibly and hold them to account when they do not, he said.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生呼吁对人工智能的开发和使用方式进行强制性人权保障和尽职调查，并随着技术的发展进行调整。他说，拥有人工智能公司或对其供应链有影响力的国家必须要求他们采取负责任的行动，并在他们不这样做时追究他们的责任。

paras.en: Not every answer lies in existing law and some areas will need new legal approaches, he added. But updating rules on liability, cybersecurity and data protection could offer protection in the meantime.
paras.zh: 他补充说，并非所有答案都存在于现有法律中，某些领域需要新的法律方法。但更新责任、网络安全和数据保护规则可以同时提供保护。

paras.en: He also urged stronger collaboration on security and independent monitoring within the industry – “not in words, but in practice” – and a bigger say for civil society and people whose rights are affected.
paras.zh: 他还敦促行业内在安全和独立监控方面加强合作——“不是在口头上，而是在实践中”——并为公民社会和权利受到影响的人们提供更大的发言权。

paras.en: “We can no longer afford to wait or rely on goodwill,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们不能再等待或依赖善意，”他说。

paras.en: Mr. Türk welcomed the creation of the Global Dialogue on AI Governance and the Independent International Scientific Panel on AI – both UN initiatives – along with a joint call for tighter control of frontier AI models backed by 29 States and the European Union.
paras.zh: Türk 先生对人工智能治理全球对话和人工智能国际独立科学小组（这两项都是联合国倡议）的创建表示欢迎，并联合呼吁在 29 个国家和欧盟的支持下加强对前沿人工智能模型的控制。

paras.en: He also said AI industry leaders had taken new steps last week on safeguards, self-regulation and risk assessment – apparently a reference to a voluntary accord signed at the White House on 29 September by President Donald Trump and the heads of six AI companies.
paras.zh: 他还表示，人工智能行业领导者上周在保障措施、自我监管和风险评估方面采取了新措施——显然是指唐纳德·特朗普总统和六家人工智能公司负责人于 9 月 29 日在白宫签署的自愿协议。

paras.en: It carries no penalties for firms that ignore it, with President Trump describing it as “morally binding”.
paras.zh: 对于忽视它的公司来说，它不会受到任何处罚，特朗普总统将其描述为“具有道德约束力”。

paras.en: “Too few are walking the talk”, said the rights chief, who wrote to States and frontier AI companies three weeks ago urging them to act now to reduce risks.
paras.zh: 这位权利负责人表示，“言出必行的人太少了”。他三周前写信给各州和前沿人工智能公司，敦促他们立即采取行动以降低风险。

paras.en: “If we fail to move quickly, we risk unforeseeable consequences – for ourselves and future generations,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果我们不能迅速采取行动，我们就会面临为我们自己和子孙后代带来不可预见后果的风险。”

articles.title: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks

paras.en: ‘Nothing can justify these atrocities,’ says Guterres three years on from 7 October attacks
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日袭击发生三年后，古特雷斯表示，“没有任何理由可以证明这些暴行是正当的”

paras.en: Three years after Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups attacked Israel, UN Secretary-General António Guterres has said nothing can justify the atrocities of 7 October – calling for an end to the suffering of Israelis and Palestinians alike.
paras.zh: 在哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装组织袭击以色列三年后，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，没有任何理由可以证明 10 月 7 日的暴行是正当的，呼吁结束以色列人和巴勒斯坦人的苦难。

paras.en: In a message released on Monday, Mr. Guterres described an abhorrent, large-scale terror attack in which more than 1,200 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed.
paras.zh: 古特雷斯在周一发布的消息中描述了一场令人发指的大规模恐怖袭击，造成 1,200 多名以色列人和外国人死亡。

paras.en: Civilians were deliberately targeted in their homes, their communities and at a music festival.
paras.zh: 平民在自己的家中、社区和音乐节上成为蓄意攻击的目标。

paras.en: Another 251 people, including women, children and older people, were abducted and taken into Gaza as hostages.
paras.zh: 另有 251 人，包括妇女、儿童和老人，被绑架并带入加沙作为人质。

paras.en: He said they had suffered horrific abuse in captivity, including torture, sexual violence and other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment. Some were killed by their captors or during the hostilities that followed.
paras.zh: 他说，他们在囚禁期间遭受了可怕的虐待，包括酷刑、性暴力和其他残忍、不人道或有辱人格的待遇。有些人被绑架者或在随后的敌对行动中杀害。

paras.en: “Nothing can justify these atrocities,” he said.
paras.zh: “没有什么可以证明这些暴行是正当的，”他说。

paras.en: “I have met with Israeli families whose worlds were shattered that day and listened to survivors who continue to carry deep physical and emotional scars,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我会见了那天世界被粉碎的以色列家庭，并聆听了幸存者的心声，他们的身体和情感上仍然承受着深深的伤痕。”

paras.en: He also recalled the “untold suffering” inflicted on Palestinians in Gaza resulting from the hostilities that followed.
paras.zh: 他还回顾了随后的敌对行动给加沙巴勒斯坦人带来的“难以言状的痛苦”。

paras.en: According to UN agencies, Israeli attacks have killed more than 70,000 people, including 20,000 children, and wounded more than 100,000.
paras.zh: 据联合国机构称，以色列的袭击已造成7万多人​​死亡，其中包括2万名儿童，并造成10万多人受伤。

paras.en: Nearly all of Gaza’s 2.1 million people have been displaced and much of the territory is in ruins. It now has the highest proportion of child amputees in the world.
paras.zh: 加沙 210 万人几乎全部流离失所，大部分领土已成为废墟。它现在是世界上截肢儿童比例最高的国家。

paras.en: “Civilians continue to endure intolerable conditions,” he said. “Their suffering, too, demands an end – now.”
paras.zh: “平民继续忍受难以忍受的条件，”他说。 “他们的痛苦也需要结束——现在。”

paras.en: The October 2025 ceasefire has brought some relief, he said, but not yet security, adequate humanitarian aid or a credible path to recovery and peace.
paras.zh: 他说，2025 年 10 月的停火带来了一些缓解，但尚未带来安全、充足的人道主义援助或恢复与和平的可靠途径。

paras.en: The Secretary-General urged all parties to implement their commitments in full and move to the next phase of the ceasefire under Security Council resolution 2803.
paras.zh: 秘书长敦促各方全面履行承诺，根据安理会第2803号决议进入下一阶段停火。

paras.en: UN agencies report that Israeli aid restrictions continue, as do almost daily deadly attacks.
paras.zh: 联合国机构报告称，以色列的援助限制仍在继续，几乎每天都会发生致命袭击。

paras.en: The UN humanitarian office, OCHA, said Israeli authorities suspended the entry of cargo into Gaza on Monday and announced another suspension for Wednesday, citing security concerns linked to the anniversary.
paras.zh: 联合国人道主义办公室人道协调厅表示，以色列当局周一暂停了货物进入加沙，并宣布周三再次暂停，理由是与周年纪念有关的安全问题。

paras.en: Now, he said, it is time for the ceasefire to become permanent and for humanitarian aid to flow at scale.
paras.zh: 他说，现在是永久停火和大规模人道主义援助的时候了。

paras.en: “Let this anniversary mark not only another year of mourning, but also a renewed determination to build a different future,” he said, where Palestinians and Israelis can live together “with their rights, dignity and aspirations fulfilled.”
paras.zh: 他说：“让这个周年纪念日不仅标志着又一年的哀悼，而且标志着建设不同未来的新决心”，让巴勒斯坦人和以色列人能够“在权利、尊严和愿望得到实现的情况下”共同生活。

articles.title: Gassiev: Fury-AJ title decision 'strange', calls for winner next

paras.en: Fury vs Joshua: Murat Gassiev says WBA world title decision is 'strange' and he should be mandatory for Fury-AJ winner
paras.zh: 富里 vs 约书亚：穆拉特·加西耶夫表示 WBA 世界冠军头衔的决定“很奇怪”，他应该成为富里-AJ 冠军的强制成员

paras.en: Murat Gassiev has criticised the WBA for not elevating him to full world championship status and says it's "strange" to sanction Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua as a fight for the 'super' title; Gassiev believes he should now be made the mandatory challenger for the Fury vs Joshua winner
paras.zh: 穆拉特·加西耶夫批评 WBA 没有将他提升为正式世界冠军，并表示批准泰森·富里与安东尼·约书亚争夺“超级”冠军头衔是“奇怪的”；加西耶夫认为他现在应该成为富里对约书亚获胜者的强制挑战者

paras.en: Murat Gassiev has called for the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua victor to make a mandatory defence against him if they are going to box for the WBA ‘super’ heavyweight title.
paras.zh: 穆拉特·加西耶夫呼吁泰森·富里对阵安东尼·约书亚的胜利者如果要争夺WBA“超级”重量级拳王头衔，就必须对他进行强制防守。

paras.en: Gassiev, the WBA 'regular' titlist, believed he would be upgraded to 'super' or full world champion when Oleksandr Usyk vacated the belt.
paras.zh: 加西耶夫是 WBA 的“常规”冠军得主，他相信当奥列克桑德·乌西克腾出金腰带时，他将升级为“超级”或正式世界冠军。

paras.en: It has subsequently emerged that the WBA intend to make the Fury vs Joshua fight on December 11 for the 'super' title, essentially making Gassiev a secondary belt-holder.
paras.zh: 随后有消息称，WBA 打算让富里与约书亚在 12 月 11 日争夺“超级”冠军头衔，从而让加西耶夫成为第二金腰带持有者。

paras.en: - Denzel Bentley fighting to keep world title with WBO appeal
paras.zh: - 丹泽尔·本特利 (Denzel Bentley) 向 WBO 上诉，力争保住世界冠军头衔

paras.en: - Bentley to fight Mosley Jr on November 7 live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 本特利将于 11 月 7 日在天空体育直播对阵小莫斯利

paras.en: - Follow boxing for news and highlights in the free Sky Sports app
paras.zh: - 在免费的天空体育应用程序中关注拳击新闻和亮点

paras.en: That decision baffled the Russian. "This situation is interesting, a little bit strange, with the belt," Gassiev told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: 这个决定让俄罗斯人感到困惑。 “对于腰带来说，这种情况很有趣，有点奇怪，”加西耶夫告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "When Usyk left his belt, I wake up I'm super champion. Go to sleep, wake up, I'm again regular champion. It's okay. I'm not angry. I understand. I'm not a kid, I understand everything."
paras.zh: “当乌西克离开腰带时，我醒来，我是超级冠军。睡觉吧，醒来，我又是常规冠军了。没关系。我不生气。我明白。我不是孩子，我明白一切。”

paras.en: But he does believe the WBA must then install him as the mandatory challenger for the winner.
paras.zh: 但他确实相信 WBA 必须将他任命为获胜者的强制挑战者。

paras.en: "From me a big present for AJ and Tyson before new year. A present from me. Just only one thing. Who wins - after the fight I need to fight with this guy for sure," he declared.
paras.zh: “我在新年之前给 AJ 和泰森准备了一份大礼物。我的一份礼物。只有一件事。谁赢了 - 比赛结束后我肯定需要和这个家伙战斗，”他宣称。

paras.en: "I think it's a good option and I'm happy for this if this situation happens. I'm happy and I'm ready."
paras.zh: “我认为这是一个不错的选择，如果这种情况发生，我会很高兴。我很高兴，我已经准备好了。”

paras.en: He thinks that winner will be Fury. "Fury is my favourite fighter," Gassiev said. "I like his style. How he does everything. I think Tyson wins by decision, or AJ by knockout."
paras.zh: 他认为胜利者将是富里。 “富里是我最喜欢的战士，”加西耶夫说。 “我喜欢他的风格。他做每件事的方式。我认为泰森通过判定获胜，或者 AJ 通过击倒获胜。”

paras.en: He added: "I love him outside the ring, but inside the ring I don't love anybody. It's sport. It's nothing personal. This is only sport for me. When the fight finishes I shake hands, hug and I can be friends with this guy."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我在擂台外爱他，但在擂台内我不爱任何人。这是运动。这与个人无关。这对我来说只是运动。当比赛结束时，我握手、拥抱，我可以和这个家伙成为朋友。”

paras.en: Gassiev last boxed in June when he stopped Peter Kadiru and has no date confirmed for his next fight.
paras.zh: 加西耶夫上一次参加拳击比赛是在六月，当时他阻止了彼得·卡迪鲁，目前还没有确定下一场比赛的日期。

paras.en: "I'm only training right now. I have people who speak with WBA and right now all my focus is only for training," he said.
paras.zh: “我现在只是在训练。我有人与 WBA 交谈，现在我所有的注意力都集中在训练上，”他说。

paras.en: "I'm a fighter. I'm not manager, I'm not promoter. I just want to fight and do my job. I'm just waiting for what happens next."
paras.zh: “我是一名战士。我不是经理，我不是发起人。我只是想战斗并做好我的工作。我只是在等待接下来发生的事情。”

articles.title: 'No excuses' for Reed after injury as he looks to increase Race to Dubai lead

paras.en: Open de Espana: Patrick Reed looking to extend lead over Rory McIlroy in Race to Dubai as he makes return from injury
paras.zh: 西班牙公开赛：伤愈复出的帕特里克·里德希望在迪拜之战中扩大对罗里·麦克罗伊的领先优势

paras.en: Patrick Reed around 300 points clear of Rory McIlroy in Race to Dubai as he looks to become second American to be crowned European No 1; Reed hopes his success will encourage his countrymen to play more worldwide; watch Open de Espana live on Sky Sports from 1pm Thursday
paras.zh: 帕特里克·里德 (Patrick Reed) 在迪拜之行中领先罗里·麦克罗伊 (Rory McIlroy) 约 300 分，他有望成为第二位加冕欧洲排名第一的美国人；里德希望他的成功能够鼓励他的同胞们更多地参加世界范围内的比赛。周四下午 1 点开始在天空体育观看西班牙公开赛直播

paras.en: Race to Dubai leader Patrick Reed says becoming the second American to be crowned European No 1 would mean "a lot" and insists he has "no excuses" as he looks to extend his advantage over Rory McIlroy after returning from a shoulder injury.
paras.zh: 前往迪拜的领先者帕特里克·里德表示，成为第二位加冕欧洲第一的美国人意味着“很多”，并坚称他“没有任何借口”，因为他希望在肩伤归来后扩大对罗里·麦克罗伊的优势。

paras.en: Reed will tee it up at the Open de Espana from Thursday in his first appearance since withdrawing during the second round of the flagship BMW PGA Championship at Wentworth last month.
paras.zh: 里德将从周四开始参加西班牙公开赛，这是他自上个月在温特沃斯举行的宝马 PGA 锦标赛第二轮退出后首次亮相。

paras.en: The 36-year-old - aiming to follow in the footsteps of compatriot Collin Morikawa, who won the Race to Dubai in 2021 - is around 300 points clear of McIlroy with five DP World Tour events remaining.
paras.zh: 这位 36 岁的选手的目标是追随同胞科林·森川 (Collin Morikawa) 的脚步，科林·森川在 2021 年赢得了迪拜大赛的冠军，在还剩 5 场 DP 世界巡回赛比赛的情况下，他领先麦克罗伊约 300 分。

paras.en: - Latest DP World Tour headlines, reports, highlights and more
paras.zh: - 最新 DP 世界巡回赛头条、报告、亮点等

paras.en: - Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract
paras.zh: - 获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: - What golf is live on Sky Sports and when? Full TV listings
paras.zh: - 天空体育直播哪些高尔夫比赛以及何时直播？完整电视节目表

paras.en: McIlroy is not playing in Spain this week but is set to appear at the DP World India Championship in New Delhi from October 15.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊本周不会在西班牙比赛，但将于 10 月 15 日起参加在新德里举行的 DP 世界印度锦标赛。

paras.en: Reed has topped the standings since February after victories at the Hero Dubai Desert Classic and Qatar Masters sandwiched a play-off defeat at the Bahrain Championship, with the 2018 Masters champion also recording three further top-10 finishes.
paras.zh: 自二月份以来，里德在英雄迪拜沙漠精英赛和卡塔尔大师赛中获胜，并在巴林锦标赛附加赛中失利，自二月份以来一直位居积分榜榜首，这位2018年大师赛冠军还另外三次进入前十名。

paras.en: The Texan said: "I've always prided myself as being that American that likes to play around the world. To have the opportunity to come over here, not only just play on this tour, but also to have a chance to win the Race to Dubai, it would mean a lot.
paras.zh: 这位德克萨斯人说：“我一直为自己是一个喜欢在世界各地打球的美国人而感到自豪。有机会来到这里，不仅参加这次巡回赛，而且还有机会赢得迪拜比赛，这意义重大。”

paras.en: "[Gary Player once told me], 'if you want to be a worldwide player, you've got to go out and play outside of the PGA Tour'.
paras.zh: “[加里·普莱尔曾经告诉我]，‘如果你想成为一名世界级球员，你就必须走出去，在美巡赛之外打球’。

paras.en: "Once I got the opportunity to come over and play, I really enjoyed it. Hopefully I can bring more Americans over and more of the top players come out and play around the world, help grow the game."
paras.zh: “一旦我有机会过来打球，我真的很享受。希望我能带更多的美国人过来，让更多的顶级球员出来在世界各地打球，帮助发展这项运动。”

paras.en: Reed 'uncomfortable' but 'able to perform'
paras.zh: 里德“不舒服”但“能够表现”

paras.en: Reed, runner-up to Shane Lowry at the Amgen Irish Open in September, said of the injury he sustained at Wentworth: "Never saw it coming. It was my first time withdrawing during a round of golf due to injury. I would rather shoot a million than withdraw.
paras.zh: 9月份在安进爱尔兰公开赛上输给肖恩·洛瑞获得亚军的里德谈到他在温特沃斯的受伤时说道：“从来没有预见到会发生这样的事。这是我第一次因伤在一场高尔夫球比赛中退出。我宁愿打一百万也不愿退出。

paras.en: "When I went in, the hand was all swollen. Any time it was touched, I was in a lot of pain, so they thought I might have broken something inside the hand. The hand was OK and it ended up being a shoulder issue. The good thing is it only set me back one week.
paras.zh: “当我进去的时候，手都肿了。每次碰它，我都会很痛，所以他们认为我可能手里面有什么东西坏了。手还好，最后变成了肩膀问题。好在这只让我休息了一个星期。”

paras.en: "It might be uncomfortable but at the same time I'm able to perform and do what I'm supposed to do in swinging the golf club.
paras.zh: “这可能会不舒服，但同时我能够表现并做我应该做的挥杆高尔夫球杆的事情。

paras.en: "So no excuses - go out there, continue grinding and hopefully finish off the year strong."
paras.zh: “所以没有任何借口——走出去，继续努力，希望今年能够强势结束。”

paras.en: Three-time Open de Espana champion Jon Rahm will not play in his home tournament with Spanish media saying the 31-year-old is in the USA awaiting the birth of his daughter.
paras.zh: 三届西班牙公开赛冠军乔恩·拉姆将不会参加他的主场比赛，西班牙媒体称这位 31 岁的球员正在美国等待女儿的出生。

paras.en: England's Marco Penge is the defending champion in Madrid, while the field also includes Lowry, Justin Rose, Ludvig Åberg and Sergio Garcia, as well as Eugenio Chacarra, who sits third in the Race to Dubai standings behind Reed and McIlroy.
paras.zh: 英格兰选手马尔科·彭吉是马德里站的卫冕冠军，参赛选手还包括洛瑞、贾斯汀·罗斯、路德维格·奥伯格和塞尔吉奥·加西亚，以及在迪拜之战中排名第三的尤金尼奥·查卡拉，仅次于里德和麦克罗伊。

paras.en: Reed, who quit LIV Golf earlier this year in order to pursue a return to the PGA Tour from 2027, has not played in the Ryder Cup since the 2018 edition in France, at which he criticised captain Jim Furyk's decisions as America tumbled to a heavy defeat to Europe.
paras.zh: 里德今年早些时候退出了 LIV Golf，以寻求从 2027 年开始重返 PGA 巡回赛，自 2018 年法国莱德杯以来，他就再也没有参加过莱德杯，当时他批评了队长吉姆·福瑞克 (Jim Furyk) 的决定，当时美国队惨败于欧洲队。

paras.en: Furyk is back as US skipper for the 2027 tournament in Ireland and asked at a year-to-go press conference on Tuesday whether Reed was in his plans, he said: "We are going to put the best 12 guys, the best team of 12. If Patrick Reed is one of those, that's great."
paras.zh: 福瑞克作为美国队队长重返 2027 年爱尔兰锦标赛，并在周二的一年一度新闻发布会上被问及里德是否在他的计划中时，他说：“我们将派出最好的 12 个人，12 人中最好的球队。如果帕特里克·里德是其中之一，那就太好了。”

paras.en: Watch the Open de Espana live on Sky Sports Golf from 1pm on Thursday, with coverage also on Sky Sports Main Event from 3pm. Get the latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract.
paras.zh: 周四下午 1 点起，您可以在天空体育高尔夫频道观看西班牙公开赛的直播，并从下午 3 点开始观看天空体育主赛事的报道。获取最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播。

articles.title: Messi ends Argentina career with goal on emotional night

paras.en: Lionel Messi ends Argentina career with goal and two assists against Benin on emotional night
paras.zh: 莱昂内尔·梅西在对阵贝宁的激动人心的夜晚以进球和两次助攻结束了阿根廷队的职业生涯

paras.en: Lionel Messi finishes his international career with 208 senior caps, the most of any player in the team's history, with his 126 goals for Argentina also a record; On an emotional night against Benin, Messi also created the first two goals, before getting on the scoresheet himself
paras.zh: 莱昂内尔·梅西 (Lionel Messi) 结束了他的国家队生涯，共为国家队出场 208 次，是球队历史上出场次数最多的球员，他为阿根廷队打入的 126 个进球也创下了纪录；在对阵贝宁的激动人心的夜晚，梅西也创造了前两个进球，然后他自己也进球了

paras.en: Lionel Messi described playing for Argentina as "the most wonderful thing that can happen to you" after ending his international career with a goal in a 3-0 win over Benin in Buenos Aires.
paras.zh: 梅西在布宜诺斯艾利斯以3-0战胜贝宁的进球结束了自己的国家队生涯，他形容为阿根廷效力是“发生在你身上的最美妙的事情”。

paras.en: The 39-year-old ends his international career with 208 senior caps, the most of any player in the team's history, with his 126 goals for Argentina also a record.
paras.zh: 这位 39 岁的球员在国家队生涯中代表国家队出场 208 次，是球队历史上出场次数最多的球员，他为阿根廷队打入的 126 粒进球也创下了纪录。

paras.en: Messi won the 2022 World Cup and two Copa Americas during his 21-year spell on the international stage.
paras.zh: 梅西在国际舞台上的 21 年里赢得了 2022 年世界杯和两次美洲杯冠军。

paras.en: On an emotional night, Messi also created the first two goals, assisting first another departing Argentina player in 38-year-old centre-back Nicolas Otamendi and then Nico Paz.
paras.zh: 在这个激动人心的夜晚，梅西还创造了前两个进球，首先助攻了另一位离队的阿根廷球员38岁的中后卫尼古拉斯·奥塔门迪，然后是尼科·帕斯。

paras.en: "I feel so many emotions," Messi, who announced his international retirement following this summer's World Cup and the death of his father, said in quotes reported by the Argentinean Football Association.
paras.zh: 阿根廷足协报道称，在今年夏天的世界杯和父亲去世后，梅西宣布了自己的国家队退役，“我感受到了如此多的情感”。

paras.en: "The first thing I think about is my old man. I can only express my gratitude; it was a tremendous honour to wear this jersey for over 20 years.
paras.zh: “我首先想到的是我的老人。我只能表达我的感激之情；能够穿着这件球衣二十多年，我感到非常荣幸。

paras.en: "I never stopped fighting, never stopped giving my all. I swear to you that I'd like to come back for life, because playing for the Argentina national team is the most wonderful thing that can happen to you."
paras.zh: “我从未停止战斗，从未停止付出我的一切。我向你发誓，我想终生回来，因为为阿根廷国家队效力是发生在你身上的最美妙的事情。”

paras.en: After a goalless first half in which Benin threatened not to stick to the script, Otamendi fired home after the visitors failed to clear a Messi corner.
paras.zh: 上半场双方互交白卷，贝宁威胁不遵守剧本，但在客队未能解围梅西角球后，奥塔门迪破门破门。

paras.en: Paz doubled Argentina's lead from the edge of the area after 61 minutes and inevitably Messi had the last word when Tamimou Ouorou's clumsy challenge on Agustin Giay resulted in a penalty, which the Inter Miami forward blasted into the top corner.
paras.zh: 61分钟后，帕斯在禁区边缘将阿根廷的领先优势扩大一倍，当塔米莫·奥鲁对奥古斯丁·吉亚的笨拙挑战导致点球时，梅西不可避免地拥有了最后的发言权，这位国际迈阿密前锋将球射入上角。

paras.en: Argentina boss Lionel Scaloni said of his captain: "It's been a dream come true. I never thought I'd be the coach of the best footballer in history.
paras.zh: 阿根廷主帅莱昂内尔·斯卡洛尼在谈到他的队长时说道：“这真是梦想成真。我从来没有想过我会成为历史上最好的足球运动员的教练。

paras.en: "We are eternally grateful to him for giving us the opportunity to be with him.
paras.zh: “我们永远感谢他给我们机会和他在一起。

paras.en: "The tears are because so many things are going through my head. Not seeing him anymore will be sad; he leaves us with an incredible legacy.
paras.zh: “我流泪是因为我脑子里闪过太多事情。再也见不到他会很伤心；他给我们留下了令人难以置信的遗产。

paras.en: "The feeling of having him (Messi) on your side is incomparable- I've never seen that aura in anyone else in my life."
paras.zh: “有他（梅西）站在你身边的感觉是无与伦比的——我一生中从未在其他人身上看到过这种光环。”

articles.title: Russia pounds Kyiv during German chancellor’s visit in a new escalation
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Germany’s leader faced a grim new reality as his train pulled into Kyiv: air raid sirens and the boom of Russian strikes on the Ukrainian capital.
paras.zh: 当德国领导人的火车驶入基辅时，他面临着一个严峻的新现实：空袭警报和俄罗斯对乌克兰首都的猛烈袭击。

paras.en: During previous visits by international dignitaries of Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s stature, the Kremlin paused or dramatically reduced attacks on the city. On Sunday, the sounds of war rang out repeatedly as the German delegation made its way around Kyiv, in what looks to be a new level of escalation by Moscow.
paras.zh: 在德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨等国际政要此前访问期间，克里姆林宫暂停或大幅减少了对这座城市的袭击。周日，当德国代表团绕过基辅时，战争的声音不断响起，莫斯科的升级似乎达到了新的水平。

paras.en: On Monday, Germany’s foreign intelligence chief warned his country was at risk of becoming embroiled in a “violent conflict with Russia,” as Moscow steps up its “shadow war” against European democracies.
paras.zh: 周一，德国外交情报负责人警告称，随着莫斯科加大针对欧洲民主国家的“影子战争”力度，德国面临卷入“与俄罗斯暴力冲突”的风险。

paras.en: Germany has been one of the most ardent supporters of Ukraine since the early days of the Russian invasion, supplying both military and financial aid. The country has also taken in more than a million Ukrainian refugees fleeing the war.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯入侵初期以来，德国一直是乌克兰最热心的支持者之一，提供军事和财政援助。该国还接收了超过一百万逃离战争的乌克兰难民。

paras.en: Merz’s visit came as Russia has ramped up its around-the-clock strikes on Kyiv in recent weeks. The attacks and the air raid alerts that accompany them have severely disrupted life in the city, forcing millions to constantly seek shelter and paralyzing the capital’s businesses and transport networks.
paras.zh: 梅尔茨访问之际，俄罗斯最近几周加大了对基辅的全天候打击力度。袭击和随之而来的空袭警报严重扰乱了这座城市的生活，迫使数百万人不断寻求庇护，并使首都的商业和交通网络瘫痪。

paras.en: Over the last four days, including on the day Merz was visiting, Russia has hit several of Kyiv’s key bridges, with some strikes coming in broad daylight and as traffic was flowing through them — in what appears to be a new tactic to disrupt links between the capital’s two sides separated by the Dnipro River to further disable movement around Ukraine’s largest city.
paras.zh: 在过去四天里，包括梅尔茨访问的那天，俄罗斯袭击了基辅的几座主要桥梁，其中一些袭击是在光天化日之下，而且是在交通流经桥梁时进行的——这似乎是一种新策略，旨在破坏被第聂伯河分隔的首都两侧之间的联系，以进一步阻碍乌克兰最大城市周围的活动。

paras.en: An air raid alert went off as Merz and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy visited the site of a drone attack on the National Academy of Sciences last week. The dramatic daytime strike on the national landmark saw people clinging to windows to escape flames and thick smoke billowing out of the structure.
paras.zh: 上周，当梅尔茨和乌克兰总统泽伦斯基访问美国国家科学院无人机袭击现场时，空袭警报响起。白天，这座国家地标发生了戏剧性的袭击，人们紧紧抓住窗户躲避火焰，浓烟从建筑物中滚滚而出。

paras.en: Zelenskyy had to rush Merz off the site, calling it a “dangerous situation,” his office said in a statement.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基的办公室在一份声明中表示，他不得不将默茨赶出现场，称这是“危险的情况”。

paras.en: Merz reaffirmed Germany’s commitment to Ukraine over the weekend and announced a further $1.1 billion in military aid. Germany, he said, would not be intimidated into abandoning Ukraine because it’s a “matter of Europe’s security” amid an escalating campaign of Russian hybrid warfare on the continent.
paras.zh: 默茨周末重申了德国对乌克兰的承诺，并宣布进一步提供 11 亿美元的军事援助。他说，德国不会因为害怕而放弃乌克兰，因为在俄罗斯在欧洲大陆的混合战争不断升级之际，这是“欧洲安全问题”。

paras.en: The Russian Defense Ministry said Sunday it has been launching “massive strikes” against Kyiv in response to Ukraine’s threats to intensify attacks on Russian oil refineries. The Ukrainian Defense Ministry said Sunday it has disabled more than half of Russia’s oil refining capacity in a string of successful strikes since this summer that have precipitated a major fuel crisis.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部周日表示，正在对基辅发动“大规模袭击”，以回应乌克兰威胁加强对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。乌克兰国防部周日表示，自今年夏天以来，乌克兰国防部在一系列成功的袭击中使俄罗斯一半以上的炼油能力瘫痪，这些袭击引发了一场严重的燃料危机。

paras.en: In a separate statement, the Russian Defense Ministry said one of Kyiv’s bridges that came under attack Sunday was hit because it’s used to move troops and military cargo.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部在另一份声明中表示，基辅周日遭受袭击的一座桥梁被击中，因为它用于运送部队和军用货物。

paras.en: Earlier, the Russian Foreign Ministry warned foreign nationals, including personnel of diplomatic missions, to leave the capital, saying Russian forces “will continue to carry out large-scale retaliatory strikes.”
paras.zh: 此前，俄罗斯外交部警告包括外交使团人员在内的外国公民离开首都，并称俄罗斯军队“将继续进行大规模报复性打击”。

paras.en: A similarly worded warning was issued in May when Moscow also called for foreign diplomats to leave Kyiv, threatening an escalation.
paras.zh: 今年五月，莫斯科也发出了措辞类似的警告，要求外国外交官离开基辅，威胁局势升级。

paras.en: “We note with concern that not everyone has taken these warnings into account and that some individuals are knowingly placing themselves in mortal danger,” the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“我们关切地注意到，并非所有人都考虑到了这些警告，有些人故意将自己置于致命危险之中。”

paras.en: But like in May, Ukraine’s European allies are refusing to heed the Kremlin’s call to abandon the city.
paras.zh: 但与五月一样，乌克兰的欧洲盟友拒绝听从克里姆林宫放弃这座城市的呼吁。

paras.en: “Russia has a message for foreign diplomats in Kyiv: leave, or risk your lives,” Ambassador of the European Union Katarina Mathernova wrote on X. “Our answer: We are staying.”
paras.zh: 欧盟大使卡塔琳娜·马瑟诺娃 (Katarina Mathernova) 在 X 上写道：“俄罗斯向驻基辅的外国外交官传达了一条信息：离开，否则就冒生命危险。我们的答案是：我们留下来。”

articles.title: BA flight to Chicago drops 28,000 feet, returns to London
articles.author: Alexander Smith

paras.en: LONDON — A British Airways passenger jet flying from London to Chicago descended 28,000 feet in just seven minutes after declaring an emergency due to an unspecified “technical issue,” the airline said Monday.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国航空公司周一表示，由于未具体说明的“技术问题”，英国航空公司一架从伦敦飞往芝加哥的客机在宣布紧急状态后仅七分钟就下降了 28,000 英尺。

paras.en: The Boeing 777 took off at 12:15 p.m. local time (7:15 a.m. ET) but started descending just 30 minutes later while flying over Ireland, according to flight-tracking website FlightAware.
paras.zh: 波音777于中午12点15分起飞。据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 称，当地时间（东部时间上午 7:15），但在飞越爱尔兰时仅 30 分钟后就开始下降。

paras.en: The plane turned around and spent around four hours zigzagging over the Bristol Channel, a waterway to the west of England, before landing back at London Heathrow Airport at 5 p.m. local time (noon ET).
paras.zh: 飞机掉头，在通往英格兰西部的水道布里斯托尔海峡上蜿蜒飞行了大约四个小时，然后于下午 5 点返回伦敦希思罗机场。当地时间（东部时间中午）。

paras.en: “The aircraft landed safely after our highly-trained pilots returned to Heathrow following a technical issue,” British Airways said in an emailed statement. “Customers disembarked the aircraft normally and our teams are working to get their travel plans back on track as quickly as possible.”
paras.zh: 英国航空公司在一份电子邮件声明中表示：“我们训练有素的飞行员因技术问题返回希思罗机场后，飞机安全着陆。” “乘客正常下飞机，我们的团队正在努力让他们的旅行计划尽快回到正轨。”

paras.en: Heathrow did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
paras.zh: 希思罗机场没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Passengers will likely be put up in hotels by the airline until another flight can be arranged, as stipulated by the U.K. Civil Aviation Authority.
paras.zh: 根据英国民航局的规定，航空公司可能会将乘客安置在酒店，直到安排另一趟航班。

paras.en: Britain’s National Air Traffic Service (NATS) came under scrutiny last month after two technical problems in the space of two weeks caused major delays at several U.K. airports and hundreds of flights were canceled.
paras.zh: 英国国家空中交通服务局 (NATS) 上个月受到严格审查，两周内出现两次技术问题，导致英国多个机场出现严重延误，数百个航班被取消。

paras.en: NATS blamed software issues for the delays.
paras.zh: NATS 将延误归咎于软件问题。

paras.en: Britain’s Transport Secretary Heidi Alexander acknowledged the situation had been “deeply frustrating” for passengers.
paras.zh: 英国交通大臣海蒂·亚历山大承认，这种情况让乘客“深感沮丧”。

paras.en: With 84.5 million passengers last year, Heathrow ranked seventh in the table of the world’s busiest airports, according to data published by Airports Council International.
paras.zh: 根据国际机场协会公布的数据，希思罗机场去年客流量为 8450 万人次，在全球最繁忙机场排行榜中排名第七。

paras.en: Travel from Heathrow was severely disrupted in March last year when a massive fire at an electricity substation caused a predawn power outage at the global transport hub.
paras.zh: 去年三月，一座变电站发生大火，导致全球交通枢纽黎明前停电，从希思罗机场出发的旅行受到严重干扰。

paras.en: The closure affected more than 1,300 flights and 200,000 passengers.
paras.zh: 此次关闭影响了超过 1,300 架次航班和 20 万名乘客。

paras.en: After investigating 600 items of evidence related to the substation, the National Energy System Operator ruled out suspicious activity in a report saying a preventable moisture fault caused the fire, leaving almost 70,000 homes without power.
paras.zh: 在调查了 600 项与变电站相关的证据后，国家能源系统运营商在一份报告中排除了可疑活动，称火灾是可预防的潮湿故障引起的，导致近 70,000 户家庭断电。

articles.title: U.S. resident charged with helping Canadian school shooter in rampage that killed 8
articles.author: Phil Helsel

paras.en: A 30-year-old Washington state resident was charged with providing assistance to a teenager who killed eight people in Canada, including schoolchildren, U.S. prosecutors said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 美国检察官周二表示，一名 30 岁的华盛顿州居民被指控向一名青少年提供援助，该青少年在加拿大杀害了包括学童在内的 8 人。

paras.en: James Cody Bryant, who the FBI said identifies as female, was arrested Tuesday and is charged with conspiracy to murder persons in a foreign country in connection with the Feb. 10 shootings in the British Columbia town of Tumbler Ridge, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，联邦调查局称詹姆斯·科迪·布莱恩特 (James Cody Bryant) 为女性，他于周二被捕，并被指控与 2 月 10 日不列颠哥伦比亚省坦布勒岭 (Tumbler Ridge) 镇发生的枪击事件有关，在外国合谋谋杀他人。

paras.en: Prosecutors said Bryant had been in contact over Discord with the shooter, who killed five children and a teacher at a secondary school, as well as two other people. He gave the shooter advice and money and offered to help livestream the killings, the U.S. Justice Department said.
paras.zh: 检察官表示，科比曾因 Discord 事件与枪手保持联系，枪手杀死了五名儿童、一所中学的一名教师以及另外两人。美国司法部表示，他向枪手提供了建议和金钱，并主动提出帮助直播杀戮过程。

paras.en: Bryant “had been in repeated contact” with the shooter, the acting U.S. attorney for the Western District of Washington, Neil Floyd, said at a news conference Tuesday.
paras.zh: 华盛顿西区代理美国检察官尼尔·弗洛伊德在周二的新闻发布会上表示，科比与枪手“多次接触”。

paras.en: Bryant “had the information and ability to alert law enforcement, and even discussed that possibility with the shooter — but chose not to,” Floyd said. “Instead, he encouraged and offered assistance to a murderer.”
paras.zh: 弗洛伊德说，科比“拥有向执法部门发出警报的信息和能力，甚至与枪手讨论了这种可能性，但他选择不这样做”。 “相反，他鼓励并为凶手提供帮助。”

paras.en: About 2 p.m. Feb. 10, Jesse Van Rootselaar, 18, who was born male but had been transitioning to female for six years, killed her mother and 11-year-old stepbrother in the small town of Tumbler Ridge, officials said.
paras.zh: 下午 2 点左右官员称，2 月 10 日，18 岁的杰西·范·鲁塞拉尔 (Jesse Van Rootselaar) 在小镇 Tumbler Ridge 杀死了她的母亲和 11 岁的继兄弟，她出生时是男性，但已经转变为女性六年了。

paras.en: She then went to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and killed five children — three 12-year-old girls and two boys, one 12 and the other 13 — and a teacher, authorities said. Van Rootselaar then died by suicide.
paras.zh: 当局称，她随后前往 Tumbler Ridge 中学杀害了 5 名儿童——三名 12 岁女孩和两名男孩，一名 12 岁，另一名 13 岁——以及一名老师。范·鲁茨拉尔随后自杀身亡。

paras.en: The rampage was one of the deadliest shootings in Canada’s history. In addition to those who were killed, two other children were shot and seriously wounded, officials said.
paras.zh: 此次枪击事件是加拿大历史上最致命的枪击事件之一。官员称，除了那些被杀的人外，另外两名儿童也被枪杀并受重伤。

paras.en: Bryant tried to talk Van Rootselaar out of the attack or get her to reconsider several times but did not tell law enforcement about the plan and offered to livestream it, the U.S. Justice Department said.
paras.zh: 美国司法部表示，科比多次试图劝说范·鲁特塞拉尔停止袭击或让她重新考虑，但没有告诉执法部门该计划，并主动提出进行直播。

paras.en: The two met on the former random video chat service Omegle around three years before the shooting and kept in contact through Discord, an online communication service, said W. Mike Herrington, special agent in charge of the FBI’s Seattle office.
paras.zh: 负责联邦调查局西雅图办事处的特工 W·迈克·赫林顿 (W. Mike Herrington) 表示，两人在枪击事件发生前三年左右在前随机视频聊天服务 Omegle 上认识，并通过在线通讯服务 Discord 保持联系。

paras.en: There is no indication the two ever met in person, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，没有迹象表明两人曾经见过面。

paras.en: The back-and-forth messages on Discord cited in the complaint have a conversational and friendly tone. At one point, Bryant writes, “You believe me when I promise I won’t snitch on you, right?” At another point, Bryant tells Van Rootselaar, “if you are uncertain, maybe take it as a sign.”
paras.zh: 投诉中引用的 Discord 上的来回消息具有对话性和友好的语气。有一次，科比写道：“当我保证不会告发你时，你相信我，对吧？”在另一点上，科比告诉范鲁塞拉尔，“如果你不确定，也许可以把它当作一个标志。”

paras.en: On the day of the shootings, after Van Rootselaar killed her mother and stepbrother, she had trouble starting her car, Floyd said.
